describe("the export's moderation member", () => {
  const [decision, correction] = full.moderation.decisions;
  const [report] = full.moderation.reports;
  const [released, waiting] = report!.items;
  const withModeration = (moderation: unknown) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, moderation }).success;
  const withDecision = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [{ ...decision, ...change }], reports: [], strikes: [] });
  const withReport = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [{ ...report, ...change }], strikes: [] });
  const withItem = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReport({ items: [{ ...released, ...change }] });

  test("is part of korbat-export-1 since 3c, the last member of the document: always present, with its two lists, either of which may be empty", () => {
    // Added without a new format name, as the passkeys and the Explore switch were: a reader that skips it loses nothing.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).format).toBe("korbat-export-1");
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape).at(-1)).toBe("moderation");
    expect(withModeration(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [decision], reports: [], strikes: [] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [report], strikes: [] })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a decision carries its day, the post it concerns, its kind, outcome, ground, rule and rules version, its measures with whether each changed anything, its reversals, the texts still held and where the appeal stands", () => {
    expect(withDecision({})).toBe(true);
    // The day, never the time: the list of decisions shows a day too.
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: at })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A decision about the account names no post; the member is null then, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ postId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: "the-post" })).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]) expect(withDecision({ kind }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ kind: "order" })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ outcome: "suspended" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "other" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ruleId: "R7" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // The thirteen measures (3c's seven and 3e's six) and nothing else; a reversal is no measure, and a measure no reversal.
    for (const kind of MEASURE_KINDS) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind, mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    for (const noEffect of ["already", "deleted", null]) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect }] }), String(noEffect)).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: "no" }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["restore", "unseal_media", "restore_media", "restore_display_name", "restore_bio"]) expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind, mediaId: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A text that is not held, or that the decision never had, is null, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null })).toBe(true);
    for (const text of ["facts", "reason", "legalReference"]) expect(withDecision({ [text]: undefined }), text).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).moderation.decisions[1]).toEqual(correction);
  });

  test("an appeal is pending without a result or answered with one, and null when none was filed", () => {
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: null } })).toBe(true);
    for (const result of ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result } }), result).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: "kept" } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result: null } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "withdrawn", result: null } })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision is read with its own members and no more: nothing of who reported, who decided or how many reports there were is part of the format", () => {
    const extra = { ...decision, decidedBy: id(20), staffHandle: "mod_one", reporterId: id(21), reporterHandle: "grace", reports: 3, source: "report", caseId: id(22) };
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [extra], reports: [], strikes: [] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.decisions).toEqual([decision]);
  });

  test("a report carries its reference, when korbat received it, its ground with the rule it cited, its category and its sender's own explanation while that is held", () => {
    expect(withReport({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ ref: "N-abc" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ receivedAt: "last week" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R6", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" })).toBe(true);
    // A report on the path for child sexual abuse material records no sender, so it is in nobody's export.
    expect(withReport({ ground: "csam" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: "R9" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // Read with its own members and no more.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], reports: [{ ...report, reporterId: id(1), contactId: id(23), lookupHash: "f".repeat(64), token: "secret" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports).toEqual([report]);
  });

  test("an item carries its place in the report, its link and whether it is a re-examination; its outcome, the outcome's words and whether a re-examination is open come together, with the release, or not at all", () => {
    expect(withItem({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ items: [waiting] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ position: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ position: 21 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ link: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexamines: undefined })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withItem({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ outcome: "restricted" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: false })).toBe(true);
    // Released, all three are told; before the release, none is.
    expect(withItem({ outcome: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ outcomeText: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, reexaminationOpen: false }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, outcomeText: "no action" }] })).toBe(false);
    // An item is read with its own members and no more: the list's id of an item is not part of the export.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], reports: [{ ...report, items: [{ ...released, id: id(24), caseId: id(25), answeredBy: id(26) }] }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports[0]!.items).toEqual([released]);
  });
});

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const GRINNING = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
const E_ACUTE = String.fromCharCode(0xe9);

      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC",

      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE",
    ]);
    expect(new Set(TDB_CATEGORIES).size).toBe(16);
  });

  test("the illegal-ground form shows 14 of them: not the terms-and-conditions category, and not 'not specified'", () => {
    expect(TDB_FORM_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(14);
    expect(TDB_FORM_CATEGORIES).toEqual(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((c) => c !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" && c !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE"));
  });

  test("the CSAM path's four choices map to the three keywords, and 'abuse' to none", () => {
    expect(CSAM_KEYWORDS).toEqual({
      csam: "KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL",
      deepfake: "KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE",

describe("laneFor", () => {
  const TC: TdbCategory = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";

  test("a rule report takes its rule's lane: R2 and R5 are urgent, R3 and R4 next, R1 and R6 last", () => {
    const lanes = RULE_IDS.map((ruleId) => laneFor({ ruleId, allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category: TC }));
    expect(lanes).toEqual([2, 0, 1, 1, 0, 2]);
  });

  test("the CSAM path is lane 0 whatever else the intake says", () => {
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: true, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: false, csam: true, category: TC })).toBe(0);
  });

  test("a notice of illegality takes its category's lane, for every category", () => {
    const urgent = ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM"];
    const next = [
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE",
    ];
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      const expected = urgent.includes(category) ? 0 : next.includes(category) ? 1 : 2;
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(expected);
    }
  });

  test("a notice of illegality that also cites a rule takes the more severe of the two lanes", () => {
    // Fraud (lane 2) under R5 (lane 0), and violence (lane 0) under R1 (lane 2): both are urgent.
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R5", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(1);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R6", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE" })).toBe(2);
  });

  test("where nothing is alleged to be illegal, the category is korbat's own classification and moves no lane", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(2);
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(1);
    }
  });
});

describe("the measures", () => {
  const kinds = Object.keys(MEASURES) as ActionKind[];
  const measures = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts === null);
  const reversals = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts !== null);

  test("every action kind has an entry: 3c's seven measures and five reversals, then 3e's six measures and four reversals", () => {
    expect(kinds).toEqual([
      "withhold",
      "remove",
      "seal_media",
      "withhold_media",
      "remove_media",
      "reset_display_name",
      "reset_bio",
      "restore",
      "unseal_media",
      "restore_media",
      "restore_display_name",
      "restore_bio",
      "strike",
      "suspend",
      "terminate",
      "retire_handle",
      "warn_reporting",
      "restrict_reporting",
      "overrule",
      "lift_suspension",
      "unretire_handle",
      "lift_reporting",
    ]);
    expect(ACTION_KINDS).toEqual(kinds);
    expect(ACTION_KINDS).toHaveLength(22);
    expect(measures).toEqual([...kinds.slice(0, 7), ...kinds.slice(12, 18)]);
    expect(reversals).toEqual([...kinds.slice(7, 12), ...kinds.slice(18)]);
    expect(MEASURE_KINDS).toEqual(measures);
    expect(MEASURE_KINDS).toHaveLength(13);
    expect(REVERSAL_KINDS).toEqual(reversals);
    expect(REVERSAL_KINDS).toHaveLength(9);
  });

  test("a post or one image is withheld only while deciding and removed only when the case is decided; a seal and a reset are either; 3e's measures only when it is decided", () => {
    const when = (kind: ActionKind) => [MEASURES[kind].interim, MEASURES[kind].final];
    expect(when("withhold")).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(when("withhold_media")).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(when("remove")).toEqual([false, true]);
    expect(when("remove_media")).toEqual([false, true]);
    for (const kind of ["seal_media", "reset_display_name", "reset_bio"] as const) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([true, true]);
    for (const kind of ["strike", "suspend", "terminate", "retire_handle", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"] as const) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([false, true]);
    // A reversal is neither: which decision may hold one is the reversed measure's matter.
    for (const kind of reversals) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([false, false]);
  });

  test("each measure has its target, and each reversal lifts the measures of its own target", () => {
    expect(Object.fromEntries(kinds.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].target]))).toEqual({
      withhold: "post",
      remove: "post",
      seal_media: "images",
      withhold_media: "image",
      remove_media: "image",
      reset_display_name: "display_name",
      reset_bio: "bio",
      restore: "post",
      unseal_media: "images",
      restore_media: "image",
      restore_display_name: "display_name",
      restore_bio: "bio",
      strike: "account",
      suspend: "account",
      terminate: "account",
      retire_handle: "handle",
      warn_reporting: "reporting",
      restrict_reporting: "reporting",
      overrule: "account",
      lift_suspension: "account",
      unretire_handle: "handle",
      lift_reporting: "reporting",
    });
    expect(Object.fromEntries(reversals.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].lifts]))).toEqual({
      restore: ["withhold", "remove"],
      unseal_media: ["seal_media"],
      restore_media: ["withhold_media", "remove_media"],
      restore_display_name: ["reset_display_name"],
      restore_bio: ["reset_bio"],
      overrule: ["strike"],
      lift_suspension: ["suspend", "terminate"],
      unretire_handle: ["retire_handle"],
      lift_reporting: ["warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"],
    });
    // Every measure can be lifted, by exactly one kind of reversal, of the measure's own target.
    for (const measure of measures) expect(reversals.filter((kind) => (MEASURES[kind].lifts as readonly ActionKind[]).includes(measure)), measure).toHaveLength(1);
    for (const kind of reversals) for (const lifted of MEASURES[kind].lifts as readonly ActionKind[]) expect(MEASURES[lifted].target, kind).toBe(MEASURES[kind].target);
    // Only the three timed kinds sign their days and whether they are announced.
    expect(TIMED_KINDS).toEqual(["suspend", "terminate", "restrict_reporting"]);
  });

  test("each has a label of its own: the composer's words where the composer names the measure", () => {
    // The first seven and "Lift the seal" are the words of the decision composer; the composer, the statement and the
    // terms all take them from here. 3e's are W.1's.
    expect(Object.fromEntries(kinds.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].label]))).toEqual({
      withhold: "Withhold the post",
      remove: "Remove",
      seal_media: "Seal the images this case reaches",
      withhold_media: "Withhold one image",
      remove_media: "Remove one image",
      reset_display_name: "Reset display name",
      reset_bio: "Reset bio",
      restore: "Lift the restriction of the post",
      unseal_media: "Lift the seal",
      restore_media: "Lift the restriction of one image",
      restore_display_name: "Lift the reset of the display name",
      restore_bio: "Lift the reset of the bio",
      strike: "Strike",
      suspend: "Suspend the account",
      terminate: "Terminate the account",
      retire_handle: "Retire the handle",
      warn_reporting: "Warn about reporting",
      restrict_reporting: "Restrict reporting",
      overrule: "Overrule the strike",
      lift_suspension: "Lift the suspension",
      unretire_handle: "Give the handle back",
      lift_reporting: "Lift the reporting measure",
    });
    const labels = kinds.map((kind) => MEASURES[kind].label);
    expect(new Set(labels).size).toBe(labels.length);
  });
});

describe("the order of a decision's actions", () => {
  const a = "1a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
  const b = "2a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

  test("by kind as a string, then by image as a string, an action without an image first", () => {
    const sorted: DecisionActionParams[] = [
      { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: a },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: b },
      { kind: "reset_bio", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: a },
    ];
    for (const shuffled of [[...sorted].reverse(), [sorted[3]!, sorted[0]!, sorted[5]!, sorted[2]!, sorted[1]!, sorted[4]!]]) {
      expect([...shuffled].sort(compareDecisionActions)).toEqual(sorted);
    }
    expect(compareDecisionActions(sorted[1]!, sorted[1]!)).toBe(0);
    expect(compareDecisionActions({ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: a })).toBeLessThan(0);
  });
});

describe("textDigest", () => {
  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(TEXT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.text.v1");
  });

  test.each(TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => [vector.name, vector] as const))("%s: the sha256 of the tag, a line feed, the salt's bytes and the text's UTF-8 bytes", async (_name, vector) => {
    expect(await textDigest(vector.salt, vector.text)).toBe(vector.digest);
  });

  test("the longest vector is 5000 UTF-16 units, and the vectors hold a line feed, a character outside ASCII and one outside the basic plane", () => {
    expect(Math.max(...TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text.length))).toBe(5000);
    const all = TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text).join("");
    expect(all).toContain(LF);
    expect(all).toContain(E_ACUTE);
    expect(all).toContain(GRINNING);
  });

  test("another salt or another text gives another digest", async () => {
    const digests = await Promise.all([textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a2".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one "), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "One")]);
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(4);
  });

  test("a salt that is not 32 bytes of lower-case hex is refused, never padded or folded", async () => {
    for (const salt of ["", "a1".repeat(31), "a1".repeat(33), "A1".repeat(32), "g1".repeat(32), ` ${"a1".repeat(32)}`]) {
      await expect(textDigest(salt, "text"), JSON.stringify(salt)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    }
  });

  test("a text with a lone surrogate, which has no UTF-8 bytes, is refused rather than hashed as something else", async () => {
    const high = String.fromCharCode(0xd83d);
    const low = String.fromCharCode(0xde00);
    for (const text of [high, low, `a${high}b`, `${low}${high}`]) await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), text)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    // The pair itself is a character.
    await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), `${high}${low}`)).resolves.toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  });
});

describe("snapshotText and snapshotDigest", () => {
  const post: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "ab".repeat(32),
    targetType: "post",
    targetId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z",
    authorHandle: "ada",
    postState: "visible",
    postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z",
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36",
    body: `Line one${LF}caf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}`,
    media: [
      { id: "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555", alt: "A cat", width: 1200, height: 800 },
      { id: "66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa", alt: null, width: 640, height: 480 },
    ],
    displayName: null,
    bio: null,
    handle: null,
  };
  const account: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "cd".repeat(32),
    targetType: "account",
    targetId: "8a3c7f0e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z",
    authorHandle: "bob",
    postState: null,
    postCreatedAt: null,
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: null,
    body: null,
    media: null,
    displayName: `Bob ${GRINNING}`,
    bio: "",
    handle: "bob",
  };
  const BS = String.fromCharCode(92);
  // The texts and the digests below were computed with Python's json and hashlib when they were written.
  const POST_TEXT =
    `{"authorHandle":"ada","bio":null,"body":"Line one${BS}ncaf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}","displayName":null,"handle":null,` +
    `"media":[{"alt":"A cat","height":800,"id":"11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555","width":1200},{"alt":null,"height":480,"id":"66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa","width":640}],` +
    `"postCreatedAt":"2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z","postState":"visible","quoteOfId":"7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36","replyToId":null,` +
    `"salt":"${"ab".repeat(32)}","takenAt":"2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z","targetId":"3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a","targetType":"post","v":1}`;
  const POST_DIGEST = "cb995d11ed14e3c4e555c187d319a86506b263e98f924f59f2f7d5231a3bc6e6";
  const ACCOUNT_DIGEST = "41019b2a47d4ebad37cc8c5ad25f8d79a7232c4e3e705231f9e9ba1e02fb1f26";

  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.snapshot.v1");
  });

  test("the text is the sorted JSON of version 1 and the snapshot's fifteen members", () => {
    expect(snapshotText(post)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(snapshotText(account)) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(Object.keys(parsed)).toEqual(["authorHandle", "bio", "body", "displayName", "handle", "media", "postCreatedAt", "postState", "quoteOfId", "replyToId", "salt", "takenAt", "targetId", "targetType", "v"]);
    expect(parsed).toEqual({ v: 1, ...account });
  });

  test("the digest is the sha256 of the tag, a line feed and that text", async () => {
    expect(await snapshotDigest(post)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(account)).toBe(ACCOUNT_DIGEST);
  });

  test("it round-trips the snapshot answer's JSON, whatever order and whatever else the answer carries", async () => {
    // As the console receives it: parsed from JSON, with members the digest does not cover, in another order.
    const sent = {
      id: "9d0f5e3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      digest: POST_DIGEST,
      withheld: false,
      erasedAt: null,
      ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(post).reverse()),
      media: post.media!.map((image) => ({ height: image.height, width: image.width, note: "never part of a snapshot", alt: image.alt, id: image.id })),
    };
    const answer = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sent)) as SnapshotDigestInput;
    expect(snapshotText(answer)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(answer)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
  });

  test("any member that changes gives another digest", async () => {
    const changed: SnapshotDigestInput[] = [
      { ...post, salt: "ac".repeat(32) },
      { ...post, takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.124Z" },
      { ...post, body: `${post.body} ` },
      { ...post, postState: "withheld" },
      { ...post, quoteOfId: null },
      { ...post, media: [post.media![1]!, post.media![0]!] },
      { ...post, media: [{ ...post.media![0]!, alt: "A dog" }, post.media![1]!] },
      { ...post, authorHandle: "adb" },
    ];
    const digests = await Promise.all([post, ...changed].map(snapshotDigest));
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(changed.length + 1);
  });

  test("a time that is not the UTC string toISOString writes, to the millisecond, is refused", () => {
    for (const takenAt of ["2026-10-03T10:00:00Z", "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123456Z", "2026-10-03T12:00:00.123+02:00", "2026-10-03 10:00:00.123Z", ""]) {
      expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt }), takenAt).toThrow(TypeError);
    }
    expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00Z" })).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 3, 10, 0, 0, 123)).toISOString() })).toBe(POST_TEXT);
  });
});

describe("appealDeadline", () => {
  const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso);
  const deadline = (iso: string) => appealDeadline(at(iso)).toISOString();

  test("six calendar months later, at the same UTC time", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-10-03T10:15:30.250Z")).toBe("2027-04-03T10:15:30.250Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-07-15T00:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-07-01T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-01-01T23:59:59.999Z");
  });

  test("a day the sixth month lacks becomes that month's last day", () => {
    // 31 August plus six months is the end of February: the 28th, or the 29th in a leap year.
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-30T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-29T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-03-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-09-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-05-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-11-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-10-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-04-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-12-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-06-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    // A leap day itself moves to 29 August: August has the day.
    expect(deadline("2028-02-29T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-08-29T08:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it is computed in UTC: the last instants of a UTC month stay on that month's side", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T23:59:59.999Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it leaves its argument as it was", () => {
    const informed = at("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
    appealDeadline(informed);
    expect(informed.toISOString()).toBe("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
  });
});

  });

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

const later = "2026-09-30T22:00:00.000Z";

/** What @simplewebauthn/browser's startRegistration returns for a security key. */
const registration = {
  id: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  rawId: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  type: "public-key",
  response: { clientDataJSON: b64(200), attestationObject: b64(400), transports: ["usb", "nfc"] },
  clientExtensionResults: {},
  authenticatorAttachment: "cross-platform",
};

/** What startAuthentication returns for a discoverable staff key: the user handle is there. */
const assertion = {
  id: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  rawId: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  type: "public-key",

};

const options = { challenge: b64(78), rpId: "console.korbat.example", allowCredentials: [], userVerification: "required", timeout: 300000 };

/** Every key of an object removed in turn must make the schema refuse it. */
function everyFieldRequired(schema: { safeParse: (value: unknown) => { success: boolean } }, value: Record<string, unknown>) {
  for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
    const partial: Record<string, unknown> = { ...value };
    delete partial[key];
    expect(schema.safeParse(partial).success, key).toBe(false);
  }
}

describe("the step-up actions of moderation cases", () => {
  const image = "7a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
  const otherImage = "9a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
  const TC = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";
  const SPEECH = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH";
  const decided = STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.case_decided.params;
  const reviewed = STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.appeals_reviewed.params;
  const revealed = STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.identity_revealed.params;

  /** An interim withhold under R1: the least a restricting decision carries. */
  const interim = {
    kind: "interim",
    stateVersion: 0,
    throughSeq: 0,
    reviewsDecisionId: null,
    snapshotId: uuid,
    snapshotDigest: hex,
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    category: TC,
    categoryKeyword: null,
    actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }],
    factsDigest: hex,
    reasonDigest: hex,
    legalReferenceDigest: null,
    // 3e: always present (design, section 10.4).
    unfounded: [] as string[],
    replaced: false,
  };
  const final = { ...interim, kind: "final", throughSeq: 3, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] };
  const noAction = { ...final, outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, actions: [], factsDigest: null, reasonDigest: null };
  const legal = { ...final, ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, category: SPEECH, legalReferenceDigest: hex };
  const correction = {
    ...interim,
    kind: "correction",
    reviewsDecisionId: "5f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
    outcome: "reversed",
    ground: null,
    ruleId: null,
    factsDigest: null,
    actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }],
  };
  const review = {
    stateVersion: 4,
    appealId: "4f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
    snapshotId: uuid,
    snapshotDigest: hex,
    outcome: "reversed",
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    category: TC,
    actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }],
    reasonDigest: hex,
  };
  const reveal = { reasonCategory: "impersonation_claim", reasonDigest: hex };

  const refused = (schema: { safeParse: (value: unknown) => { success: boolean } }, value: unknown) => schema.safeParse(value).success === false;

  test("each has its target type, and a target id in PostgreSQL's lower-case spelling only", () => {
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.case_decided.targetType).toBe("case");
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.appeals_reviewed.targetType).toBe("decision");
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.identity_revealed.targetType).toBe("intake_item");
    for (const action of ["case_decided", "appeals_reviewed", "identity_revealed"] as const) {
      const spec = STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS[action];
      expect(spec.targetId.safeParse(uuid).success, action).toBe(true);
      expect(spec.targetId.safeParse(uuid.toUpperCase()).success, action).toBe(false);
      expect(spec.targetId.safeParse("abc").success, action).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("case_decided takes an interim, a final and a correcting decision, each exactly as sent", () => {
    for (const params of [interim, final, noAction, legal, correction]) expect(decided.parse(params), params.kind).toEqual(params);
    everyFieldRequired(decided, interim);
    // A final decision that finds no breach may still name the rule it examined, and may lift the case's interim withholds.
    expect(decided.parse({ ...noAction, ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R5", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }).ruleId).toBe("R5");
    expect(decided.parse({ ...noAction, outcome: "not_evident" }).outcome).toBe("not_evident");
    expect(decided.parse({ ...legal, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" }).categoryKeyword).toBe("KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT");
  });

  test("the params are strict and unchanged: a member they do not know is refused, and nothing is trimmed, folded or defaulted", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, note: "x" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, extra: 1 }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, ground: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(revealed, { ...reveal, text: "why" })).toBe(true);
    // No transform: an upper-case id or digest is refused, never lower-cased.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, snapshotId: uuid.toUpperCase() })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, snapshotDigest: hex.toUpperCase() })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, factsDigest: ` ${hex}` })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: image.toUpperCase() }] })).toBe(true);
    // Numbers are whole and in range.
    for (const stateVersion of [-1, 1.5, "0", 2_147_483_648]) expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, stateVersion }), String(stateVersion)).toBe(true);
    for (const rulesVersion of [0, 1.5, 32_768]) expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, rulesVersion }), String(rulesVersion)).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PORNOGRAPHY_OR_SEXUALIZED_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, ruleId: "R7" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, kind: "review" })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the outcome goes with the kind: an interim decision restricts, a final one restricts or finds no breach, a correction reverses", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, outcome: "no_violation" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, outcome: "kept" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, outcome: "reversed" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, outcome: "restricted" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, outcome: "kept" })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...correction, outcome: "partly_reversed" }).outcome).toBe("partly_reversed");
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, outcome: "restricted" })).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewed.parse({ ...review, outcome: "kept", actions: [] }).outcome).toBe("kept");
  });

  test("an interim decision answers no item: its throughSeq is 0", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, throughSeq: 1 })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...final, throughSeq: 1 }).throughSeq).toBe(1);
  });

  test("a restriction carries its ground, its facts and its reason; a rule ground its rule; a legal ground its reference, and no rule", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, ground: null, ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, factsDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, reasonDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, legalReferenceDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, ruleId: "R3" })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a keyword goes only with the ground of the law", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL" })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a correction names the decision it corrects, states no ground of its own, and holds reversals only; no other kind names a decision", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, reviewsDecisionId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, reasonDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, ruleId: "R1" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, factsDigest: hex })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, legalReferenceDigest: hex })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }, { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, reviewsDecisionId: uuid })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, reviewsDecisionId: uuid })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the actions are sorted by kind and then by image, without repeats, at most eight, with at most one post measure and one seal", () => {
    const sorted = [
      { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: image },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: otherImage },
      { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null },
    ];
    const sealing = { ...final, ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", actions: sorted };
    expect(decided.parse(sealing).actions).toEqual(sorted);
    // Any other order of the same actions, and any repeat, is refused: the same decision always has the same hash.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[1], sorted[0], sorted[2], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[0], sorted[2], sorted[1], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[0], sorted[1], sorted[1], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...sealing, actions: [sorted[0], sorted[3], sorted[3]] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }, { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    // Two post measures in one decision.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    // Nine actions.
    const nine = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => ({ kind: "remove_media", mediaId: `${i}a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a` }));
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, actions: nine })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...final, actions: nine.slice(0, 8) }).actions).toHaveLength(8);
  });

  test("an image measure names its image, and no other kind names one", () => {
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: image }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, actions: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: image }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: image }] }).actions[0]).toEqual({ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: image });
  });

  test("appeals_reviewed takes the appeal, the snapshot, the outcome and reversals only, sorted like a decision's", () => {
    expect(reviewed.parse(review)).toEqual(review);
    everyFieldRequired(reviewed, review);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: otherImage }, { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: image }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, appealId: uuid.toUpperCase() })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, reasonDigest: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewed.parse({ ...review, outcome: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: image }, { kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e (design, section 10.4)
  const accountFinal = { ...final, ruleId: "R1" };
  const suspendAction = (days: number | null, announced: boolean) => ({ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days, announced });

  test("3e: an action entry is one of two strict shapes, and the three timed kinds sign their days and whether they are announced", () => {
    const announced = { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(3, true)] };
    expect(decided.parse(announced)).toEqual(announced);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: false }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(decided.parse({ ...accountFinal, ruleId: "R6", actions: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", mediaId: null, days: 30, announced: false }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
    // A timed kind in the plain shape, and a plain kind in the timed one, are refused.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    // days is a whole number from 1 to 30, null only on a termination; a restriction of reporting is never announced.
    for (const days of [0, 31, 1.5]) expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(days, true)] }), String(days)).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(null, true)] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, ruleId: "R6", actions: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", mediaId: null, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: image, days: 3, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
    // At most one suspension or termination.
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(3, true), { kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: true }] })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("3e: the six measures only in a final restriction, a strike only on a korbat rule other than R2, an overruling only with a full reversal", () => {
    expect(decided.parse({ ...final, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...interim, actions: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, actions: [{ kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...legal, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    const overruling = { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] };
    expect(decided.parse(overruling).actions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...overruling, outcome: "partly_reversed" })).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewed.parse({ ...review, actions: overruling.actions }).actions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, outcome: "partly_reversed", actions: overruling.actions })).toBe(true);
    // A review and a correction hold the four new reversals, never a new measure.
    expect(refused(reviewed, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewed.parse({ ...review, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }] }).actions).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("3e: a correction may keep the decision with no action; unfounded only on a final no-breach decision, sorted; replaced only with a lift", () => {
    const kept = { ...correction, outcome: "kept", actions: [] };
    expect(decided.parse(kept).outcome).toBe("kept");
    expect(refused(decided, { ...kept, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, outcome: "kept" })).toBe(true);
    const [first, second] = [uuid, "6f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a"].sort();
    expect(decided.parse({ ...noAction, unfounded: [first, second] }).unfounded).toEqual([first, second]);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: [second, first] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: [first, first] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: [first!.toUpperCase()] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...final, unfounded: [first] })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...noAction, unfounded: Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => `${String(i).padStart(8, "0")}-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a`) })).toBe(true);
    const withdrawn = { ...correction, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: true };
    expect(decided.parse(withdrawn).replaced).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...correction, replaced: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, { ...accountFinal, actions: [suspendAction(3, true)], replaced: true })).toBe(true);
    // Both members are always present: a decision without them is refused.
    const { unfounded: _u, ...withoutMarks } = interim;
    const { replaced: _r, ...withoutReplaced } = interim;
    expect(refused(decided, withoutMarks)).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(decided, withoutReplaced)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("identity_revealed takes a reason category and the digest of the saved reason, never the reason", () => {
    expect(revealed.parse(reveal)).toEqual(reveal);
    everyFieldRequired(revealed, reveal);
    for (const reasonCategory of ["impersonation_claim", "abuse_of_reporting", "legal_requirement", "other"]) expect(revealed.parse({ ...reveal, reasonCategory }).reasonCategory).toBe(reasonCategory);
    expect(refused(revealed, { ...reveal, reasonCategory: "curiosity" })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(revealed, { ...reveal, reasonDigest: "because" })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the cross-field rules survive the route's extension with the assertion, since its key does not overlap", () => {
    const extended = decided.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON.optional() });
    expect(extended.parse({ ...interim, stepUp: assertion })).toEqual({ ...interim, stepUp: assertion });
    expect(extended.parse(interim)).toEqual(interim);
    expect(refused(extended, { ...interim, outcome: "no_violation", stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(extended, { ...interim, throughSeq: 2, stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(extended, { ...interim, other: 1, stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    const extendedReview = reviewed.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON.optional() });
    expect(refused(extendedReview, { ...review, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }], stepUp: assertion })).toBe(true);
    expect(extendedReview.parse({ ...review, stepUp: assertion }).stepUp).toEqual(assertion);
  });

  test("the options request takes each of the three with its own target and params", () => {
    const requests = [
      { action: "case_decided", target: { type: "case", id: uuid }, params: interim },
      { action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: uuid }, params: review },
      { action: "identity_revealed", target: { type: "intake_item", id: uuid }, params: reveal },
    ];
    for (const request of requests) expect(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse(request), request.action).toEqual(request);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[0], target: { type: "decision", id: uuid } })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[0], params: review })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[0], params: { ...interim, outcome: "kept" } })).toBe(true);
    expect(refused(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest, { ...requests[2], params: {} })).toBe(true);
  });

  /**
   * Every string a params schema lets through, by its path: the walk goes through objects, arrays and nullable members.
   * A string is described by its format (a uuid) and the patterns it is held to; enums and literals are closed lists and
   * numbers are not strings, so neither is listed.
   */
  function strings(schema: unknown, path = "$"): { path: string; format: string | undefined; patterns: string[] }[] {
    const def = (schema as { _zod: { def: Record<string, unknown> } })._zod.def;
    switch (def.type) {
      case "object":
        return Object.entries(def.shape as Record<string, unknown>).flatMap(([key, member]) => strings(member, `${path}.${key}`));
      case "array":
        return strings(def.element, `${path}[]`);
      case "nullable":
      case "optional":
        return strings(def.innerType, path);
      // 3e: an action entry is one of two shapes, each walked; a boolean and a null carry no text.
      case "union":
        return (def.options as unknown[]).flatMap((option) => strings(option, path));
      case "string": {
        const checks = ((def.checks as { _zod: { def: { format?: string; pattern?: RegExp } } }[] | undefined) ?? []).map((check) => check._zod.def);
        return [{ path, format: def.format as string | undefined, patterns: checks.filter((check) => check.format === "regex").map((check) => String(check.pattern)) }];
      }
      case "enum":
      case "literal":
      case "number":
      case "boolean":
      case "null":
        return [];
      default:
        // A kind of member this walk does not know could carry free text: it fails the test until it is listed above.
        return [{ path, format: `unknown member type ${String(def.type)}`, patterns: [] }];
    }
  }
  const LOWER_UUID = "/^[0-9a-f-]+$/";
  const HEX_DIGEST = "/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/";
  const free = (schema: unknown) => strings(schema).filter((s) => !((s.format === "uuid" && s.patterns.includes(LOWER_UUID)) || (s.format === undefined && s.patterns.includes(HEX_DIGEST))));

  test("no params schema of any action lets a free string through: every string is a lower-case uuid or a hex digest", () => {
    for (const [action, spec] of Object.entries(STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS)) {
      expect(free(spec.params), action).toEqual([]);
      expect(free(spec.targetId), action).toEqual([]);
    }
    // What the walk finds in the decision's params: ids and digests, nothing else.
    expect(strings(decided).map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(["$.reviewsDecisionId", "$.snapshotId", "$.snapshotDigest", "$.actions[].mediaId", "$.factsDigest", "$.reasonDigest", "$.legalReferenceDigest", "$.unfounded[]"]);
    expect(strings(revealed).map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(["$.reasonDigest"]);
  });

  test("the walk catches a free string, a uuid in any case, a transform and a member it cannot read", () => {
    const loose = z.strictObject({
      note: z.string().max(10),
      id: z.uuid(),
      short: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{8}$/),
      list: z.array(z.strictObject({ label: z.string().nullable() })),
      trimmed: z.string().trim().pipe(z.uuid()),
      ok: z.uuid().regex(/^[0-9a-f-]+$/),
      digest: z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/).nullable(),
    });
    expect(free(loose).map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(["$.note", "$.id", "$.short", "$.list[].label", "$.trimmed"]);
  });
});

describe("the step-up action's hash and binding", () => {
  const BS = String.fromCharCode(92);
  const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
  const revoke = { action: "staff_session_revoked", target: { type: "staff_session", id: uuid }, params: {} };
  // The 3a action's sorted JSON, and the sha256 values below, were checked with Python's hashlib when they were written.
  const REVOKE_TEXT = `{"action":"staff_session_revoked","params":{},"target":{"id":"${uuid}","type":"staff_session"}}`;
  const REVOKE_HASH = "dad06ce5248ff75b3aa9b1faec9bab38bfa70f6dd2568d231b02e282207385c5";
  const SESSION = "8a3c7f0e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666";
  const BINDING = "9b70fa1ab475e7958d1265150cd04c7953483fe6145f52b12b2fd89d0c598dca";
  const hexOf = (bytes: Uint8Array) => Array.from(bytes, (b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");

  test("the action's text is the sorted JSON of its action, target and params: object keys sorted, no whitespace", () => {
    expect(stepUpActionText(revoke)).toBe(REVOKE_TEXT);
    // The order the members were written in changes nothing.
    expect(stepUpActionText({ params: {}, target: { id: uuid, type: "staff_session" }, action: "staff_session_revoked" })).toBe(REVOKE_TEXT);
    // The options request is hashed as it was sent: its schemas change nothing in it.
    expect(stepUpActionText(StaffStepUpOptionsRequest.parse(revoke))).toBe(REVOKE_TEXT);
  });

  test("params are sorted at every depth, arrays keep their order, and strings and numbers are written as JSON.stringify writes them", () => {
    const params = { b: [3, { z: 1, a: null }, "x"], a: `q"${BS}`, c: true, d: 0.5, e: -0, "": -1, B: { y: [], x: {} } };
    expect(stepUpActionText({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "post", id: "p1" }, params })).toBe(
      `{"action":"case_decided","params":{"":-1,"B":{"x":{},"y":[]},"a":"q${BS}"${BS}${BS}","b":[3,{"a":null,"z":1},"x"],"c":true,"d":0.5,"e":0},"target":{"id":"p1","type":"post"}}`,
    );
  });

  test("keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units, as Array.prototype.sort sorts them in the API, audit-verify and the console alike", () => {
    const eAcute = String.fromCharCode(0xe9);
    const fullwidthA = String.fromCharCode(0xff21);
    // An astral character's first code unit (0xd83d) sorts before 0xff21, though its code point (0x1f600) is higher.
    const grinning = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    const params = { [fullwidthA]: 1, [grinning]: 2, [eAcute]: 3, z: 4 };
    expect(stepUpActionText({ action: "a", target: { type: "t", id: "i" }, params })).toBe(
      `{"action":"a","params":{"z":4,"${eAcute}":3,"${grinning}":2,"${fullwidthA}":1},"target":{"id":"i","type":"t"}}`,
    );
  });

  test("a value that is not JSON is refused rather than hashed", () => {
    for (const value of [undefined, Number.NaN, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, () => 1, BigInt(1), new Date(0), [undefined], Symbol("x")]) {
      expect(() => stepUpActionText({ action: "a", target: { type: "t", id: "i" }, params: { value } }), String(typeof value)).toThrow(TypeError);
    }
  });

  test("the action's hash is the lower-case hex sha256 of the text's UTF-8 bytes", async () => {
    expect(await stepUpActionHash(revoke)).toBe(REVOKE_HASH);
    const reason = String.fromCharCode(0xe9, 0x4e2d) + String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(await stepUpActionHash({ action: "case_decided", target: { type: "post", id: "p1" }, params: { reason } })).toBe(
      "8f41483850c87296607ff1c3fd5e501574bcc3f564a09d935a7063efab414720",
    );
  });

  test("another action, target or params gives another hash: params are bound too, though 3a's one action has none", async () => {
    const hashes = await Promise.all([
      stepUpActionHash(revoke),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, action: "staff_key_revoked" }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, target: { type: "staff_session", id: "4f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a" } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, target: { type: "staff_key", id: uuid } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { all: true } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { all: false } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { items: [1, 2] } }),
      stepUpActionHash({ ...revoke, params: { items: [2, 1] } }),
    ]);
    expect(new Set(hashes).size).toBe(hashes.length);
  });

  test("the binding is the full 32-byte sha256 of the session's handle, a newline and the action's hash", async () => {
    expect(stepUpBindingText(SESSION, REVOKE_HASH)).toBe(`${SESSION}${LF}${REVOKE_HASH}`);
    const binding = await stepUpBinding(SESSION, REVOKE_HASH);
    expect(binding).toBeInstanceOf(Uint8Array);
    expect(binding).toHaveLength(32);
    expect(hexOf(binding)).toBe(BINDING);
    // Another session, or another action, binds something else.
    expect(hexOf(await stepUpBinding("7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36", REVOKE_HASH))).not.toBe(BINDING);
    expect(hexOf(await stepUpBinding(SESSION, "0".repeat(64)))).not.toBe(BINDING);
  });

  test("the step-up challenge's layout: 74 bytes of version, purpose, expiry, nonce, the full binding and the seal", () => {
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE).toEqual({
      bytes: 74,
      encodedLength: 99,
      version: 1,
      purpose: 6,
      versionAt: 0,
      purposeAt: 1,
      expiryAt: 2,
      expiryBytes: 8,
      nonceAt: 10,
      nonceBytes: 16,
      bindingAt: 26,
      bindingBytes: 32,
      sealAt: 58,
      sealBytes: 16,
    });
    // The fields follow one another with no gap, and the encoded length is the bytes' unpadded base64url length.
    const c = STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE;
    expect([c.purposeAt + 1, c.expiryAt + c.expiryBytes, c.nonceAt + c.nonceBytes, c.bindingAt + c.bindingBytes, c.sealAt + c.sealBytes]).toEqual([
      c.expiryAt,
      c.nonceAt,
      c.bindingAt,
      c.sealAt,
      c.bytes,
    ]);
    expect(c.encodedLength).toBe(Math.ceil((c.bytes * 8) / 6));
  });

  test("the other ceremonies' layout: 58 bytes of version, purpose, expiry, nonce, a 16-byte binding and the seal", () => {
    expect(CEREMONY_CHALLENGE).toEqual({
      bytes: 58,
      encodedLength: 78,
      version: 1,
      versionAt: 0,
      purposeAt: 1,
      expiryAt: 2,
      expiryBytes: 8,
      nonceAt: 10,
      nonceBytes: 16,
      bindingAt: 26,
      bindingBytes: 16,
      sealAt: 42,
      sealBytes: 16,
    });
    const c = CEREMONY_CHALLENGE;
    expect([c.purposeAt + 1, c.expiryAt + c.expiryBytes, c.nonceAt + c.nonceBytes, c.bindingAt + c.bindingBytes, c.sealAt + c.sealBytes]).toEqual([
      c.expiryAt,
      c.nonceAt,
      c.bindingAt,
      c.sealAt,
      c.bytes,
    ]);
    expect(c.encodedLength).toBe(Math.ceil((c.bytes * 8) / 6));
    // The two layouts share their first fields, and their lengths keep either from being read as the other.
    expect([c.versionAt, c.purposeAt, c.expiryAt, c.nonceAt, c.bindingAt, c.version]).toEqual([
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.versionAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.purposeAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.expiryAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.nonceAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.bindingAt,
      STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.version,
    ]);
    expect(c.bytes).not.toBe(STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.bytes);
  });

  test("each ceremony's purpose code, the step-up's among them, and no two alike", () => {
    expect(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES).toEqual({ signin: 1, register: 2, reauth: 3, staff_signin: 4, staff_register: 5, staff_step_up: 6 });
    expect(STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE.purpose).toBe(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES.staff_step_up);
    expect(new Set(Object.values(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES)).size).toBe(Object.keys(CHALLENGE_PURPOSES).length);
  });
});

describe("the audit log", () => {
  const entry = {
    seq: 42,
    hash: hex,
    createdAt: at,
    actorHandle: "mod_ada",
    action: "staff_session_revoked",
    targetType: "staff_session",
    targetId: uuid,
    actionHash: "cd".repeat(32),
  };

  test("an entry carries its place and hash, time, actor handle, action, target and the action's hash", () => {
    expect(AuditEntry.parse(entry)).toEqual(entry);
    // The system actor has no handle; most rows have no step-up, some no target.
    const bare = { ...entry, actorHandle: null, targetType: null, targetId: null, actionHash: null };
    expect(AuditEntry.parse(bare)).toEqual(bare);
    everyFieldRequired(AuditEntry, entry);
  });

  test("an entry never carries metadata, and its place and hashes have their exact forms", () => {
    expect(AuditEntry.parse({ ...entry, metadata: { email: "a@b.c" } })).toEqual(entry);
    for (const seq of [0, -1, 1.5, "42"]) expect(AuditEntry.safeParse({ ...entry, seq }).success, String(seq)).toBe(false);
    for (const hash of ["AB".repeat(32), "ab".repeat(31), `${"ab".repeat(31)}zz`]) {
      expect(AuditEntry.safeParse({ ...entry, hash }).success, hash).toBe(false);
      expect(AuditEntry.safeParse({ ...entry, actionHash: hash }).success, hash).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("a page holds at most 50 entries and the cursor of the next one, null at the end", () => {
    expect(STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(50);
    expect(AuditPage.parse({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: 42 })).toEqual({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: 42 });
    expect(AuditPage.parse({ entries: [], nextCursor: null })).toEqual({ entries: [], nextCursor: null });
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: Array(51).fill(entry), nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: Array(50).fill(entry), nextCursor: 1 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: [entry] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(AuditPage.safeParse({ entries: [entry], nextCursor: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a page is asked for by cursor, by place (at) or from the newest, with sign-ins as the one filter", () => {
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({})).toEqual({});
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ cursor: "42" })).toEqual({ cursor: 42 });
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ at: "7", action: "staff_sign_in" })).toEqual({ at: 7, action: "staff_sign_in" });
    expect(AuditPageQuery.parse({ cursor: "999999999999999" }).cursor).toBe(999_999_999_999_999);
    for (const value of ["0", "-1", "1.5", "01", "1e3", "", " 4", "abc", "1000000000000000"]) {
      expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ cursor: value }).success, value).toBe(false);
      expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ at: value }).success, value).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ action: "role_granted" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A cursor reads older rows and at reads from a place: both at once name no page.
    expect(AuditPageQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "4", at: "7" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
