```ts
describe("passkeys 1c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** The foreign keys of one local column: the table and columns they point at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string, name: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .foreignKeys.filter((k) => k.reference().columns.some((c) => c.name === name))
      .map((k) => ({ table: getTableConfig(k.reference().foreignTable).name, columns: k.reference().foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }));

  test("bytea is the bytea SQL type and hands Buffers both ways", () => {
    const table = pgTable("bytea_probe", { value: bytea("value") });
    const probe = getTableConfig(table).columns[0]!;
    expect(probe.getSQLType()).toBe("bytea");
    const bytes = Buffer.from([0, 1, 254, 255]);
    expect(probe.mapToDriverValue(bytes)).toEqual(bytes);
    // postgres.js already parses bytea into a Buffer; a driver that answers a plain Uint8Array gets one too.
    const read = probe.mapFromDriverValue(new Uint8Array([0, 1, 254, 255]));
    expect(Buffer.isBuffer(read)).toBe(true);
    expect(read).toEqual(bytes);
    expect(probe.mapFromDriverValue(bytes)).toEqual(bytes);
  });

  test("users carry an optional WebAuthn user handle in bytea, unique among the accounts that have one", () => {
    const handle = column("users", "webauthn_user_id");
    expect(handle?.getSQLType()).toBe("bytea");
    expect(handle?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(handle?.hasDefault).toBe(false);
    const idx = byName.get("users")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "users_webauthn_user_id_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["webauthn_user_id"]);
    expect(idx?.config.where).toBeDefined();
  });

  test("passkeys record the AAGUID, the backup and verification flags, the creating device and a suspected copy", () => {
    expect(column("passkeys", "aaguid")?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(column("passkeys", "aaguid")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    for (const name of ["backup_eligible", "uv_initialized"]) {
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe("boolean");
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(true);
      expect(column("passkeys", name)?.default, name).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(column("passkeys", "created_device_id")?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(column("passkeys", "created_device_id")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(foreignKeys("passkeys", "created_device_id")).toEqual([{ table: "devices", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "set null" }]);
    expect(column("passkeys", "suspect_at")?.getSQLType()).toBe("timestamp with time zone");
    expect(column("passkeys", "suspect_at")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    // One row per credential: the index the foundation created stays.
    const idx = byName.get("passkeys")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "passkeys_credential_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["credential_id"]);
  });

  test("sessions carry a random handle that is unique, the factors they proved and the passkey that started them", () => {
    const handle = column("sessions", "handle");
    expect(handle?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(handle?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(handle?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    const idx = byName.get("sessions")!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === "sessions_handle_idx");
    expect(idx?.config.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(idx?.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name)).toEqual(["handle"]);
    const factors = column("sessions", "factors");
    expect(factors?.getSQLType()).toBe("jsonb");
    expect(factors?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(factors?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    expect(column("sessions", "passkey_id")?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(foreignKeys("sessions", "passkey_id")).toEqual([{ table: "passkeys", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "set null" }]);
  });

  test("adding, removing and a counter regression of a passkey are security events", () => {
    const values = schema.authEventType.enumValues;
    // The slice ends at 1c's last value: 3a appends the staff events after it.
    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("account_deleted"), values.indexOf("passkey_counter_regression") + 1)).toEqual([
      "account_deleted",
      "passkey_added",
      "passkey_removed",
      "passkey_counter_regression",
    ]);
  });
});

describe("explore 2c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local column: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  const indexColumns = (config: { columns: unknown[] }) => config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name);

  test("profiles carry the author's Explore switch, on by default", () => {
    const flag = column("profiles", "show_in_explore");
    expect(flag?.getSQLType()).toBe("boolean");
    expect(flag?.notNull).toBe(true);
    expect(flag?.default).toBe(true);
  });

  test("explore_runs numbers each ranking with an identity and records its time, formula, counts and duration", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("explore_runs")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(shape("explore_runs")).toEqual([
      ["generation", "integer", true],
      ["as_of", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["formula", "smallint", true],
      ["candidates", "integer", true],
      ["items", "integer", true],
      ["took_ms", "integer", true],
    ]);
    const generation = column("explore_runs", "generation");
    expect(generation?.primary).toBe(true);
    // Always generated: an insert cannot choose its generation, so the numbers come from the sequence alone.
    expect(generation?.generatedIdentity?.type).toBe("always");
    // The refresh writes every other value itself, the refresh time included, which tests move.
    expect(cfg.columns.filter((c) => c.hasDefault).map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(["generation"]);
    expect(cfg.foreignKeys).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("explore_items holds a ranking's posts by position, each post once, and goes with its ranking, its post or its author", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("explore_items")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    // No score or count is stored: the position is the order.
    expect(shape("explore_items")).toEqual([
      ["generation", "integer", true],
      ["position", "integer", true],
      ["post_id", "uuid", true],
      ["author_id", "uuid", true],
    ]);
    expect(cfg.primaryKeys.map((k) => k.columns.map((c) => c.name))).toEqual([["generation", "position"]]);
    expect(cfg.indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, indexColumns(i.config), i.config.unique])).toEqual([["explore_items_generation_post_idx", ["generation", "post_id"], true]]);
    expect(foreignKeys("explore_items")).toEqual({
      generation: { table: "explore_runs", columns: ["generation"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      post_id: { table: "posts", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      author_id: { table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
    });
  });

  test("both tables have row level security and one full-access policy for the API role", () => {
    // The loop under "row level security" covers them too; this pins the policy each one has.
    for (const name of ["explore_runs", "explore_items"]) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name)!;
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(cfg.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]), name).toEqual([[`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("likes and reposts have a BRIN index on created_at for the refresh's window; bookmarks, which Explore never reads, has none", () => {
    for (const name of ["likes", "reposts"]) {
      const brin = byName.get(name)!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method === "brin");
      expect(brin.map((i) => [i.config.name, indexColumns(i.config), i.config.unique, i.config.where]), name).toEqual([[`${name}_created_brin`, ["created_at"], false, undefined]]);
    }
    expect(byName.get("bookmarks")!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method === "brin")).toEqual([]);
    // The factory's other indexes stay the same on all three tables.
    for (const name of ["likes", "reposts", "bookmarks"]) {
      const others = byName.get(name)!.indexes.filter((i) => i.config.method !== "brin");
      expect(others.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.method]).sort(), name).toEqual([
        [`${name}_post_idx`, "btree"],
        [`${name}_user_created_idx`, "btree"],
      ]);
    }
  });
});

describe("staff console 3a", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local columns: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  /** Every index as its name, its columns and whether it is unique, by name. */
  const indexes = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .indexes.map((i) => [i.config.name, i.config.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name), i.config.unique])
      .sort((a, b) => String(a[0]).localeCompare(String(b[0])));
  const uniques = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name)]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);

  test("the seven staff events close the auth event type, after 1c's passkey events", () => {
    const values = schema.authEventType.enumValues;
    expect(values.slice(values.indexOf("passkey_counter_regression") + 1)).toEqual([
      "staff_enrollment_issued",
      "staff_key_added",
      "staff_key_revoked",
      "staff_key_counter_regression",
      "staff_sign_in",
      "staff_signed_out",
      "staff_session_revoked",
    ]);
  });

  test("the three staff tables live in the auth schema, with row level security and one policy for the auth role", () => {
    for (const name of ["staff_keys", "staff_enrollments", "staff_sessions"]) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name)!;
      expect(cfg.schema, name).toBe("auth");
      expect(cfg.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual([[`${name}_auth_all`, "all", authRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("a staff key records its credential, its origin and relying party ID, its dates and whether it was revoked or suspect", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_keys")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["credential_id", "text", true],
      ["public_key", "text", true],
      ["counter", "bigint", true],
      ["transports", "text[]", true],
      ["name", "text", true],
      ["aaguid", "uuid", false],
      ["origin", "text", true],
      ["rp_id", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["last_used_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["revoked_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["suspect_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    // No user handle of its own: staff registrations use the account's webauthn_user_id.
    expect(column("staff_keys", "user_handle")).toBeUndefined();
    // The development cleaner deletes accounts as the superuser; a key must stop that delete, never go with it.
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_keys")).toEqual({ user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" } });
    expect(indexes("staff_keys")).toEqual([
      ["staff_keys_credential_idx", ["credential_id"], true],
      ["staff_keys_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
    // The pair the staff sessions' foreign key names.
    expect(uniques("staff_keys")).toEqual([["staff_keys_id_user_id_unique", ["id", "user_id"]]]);
    expect(checks("staff_keys")).toEqual(["staff_keys_suspect_is_revoked"]);
  });

  test("an enrolment keeps only its token's hash, the console it was issued for, its expiry and when it was used", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_enrollments")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["token_hash", "text", true],
      ["origin", "text", true],
      ["rp_id", "text", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["used_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
    ]);
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_enrollments")).toEqual({ user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" } });
    expect(indexes("staff_enrollments")).toEqual([
      ["staff_enrollments_token_hash_idx", ["token_hash"], true],
      ["staff_enrollments_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
  });

  test("a staff session keeps its token's hash, a unique handle, its key and account together, both expiries and the browser label", () => {
    expect(shape("staff_sessions")).toEqual([
      ["id", "text", true],
      ["handle", "uuid", true],
      ["user_id", "uuid", true],
      ["key_id", "uuid", true],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["last_used_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["idle_expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["absolute_expires_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      ["revoked_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["browser", "text", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("staff_sessions", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(column("staff_sessions", "handle")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    // The key's foreign key names the account as well, so a session's key always belongs to its account.
    expect(foreignKeys("staff_sessions")).toEqual({
      user_id: { table: "users", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
      "key_id,user_id": { table: "staff_keys", columns: ["id", "user_id"], onDelete: "cascade" },
    });
    expect(indexes("staff_sessions")).toEqual([
      ["staff_sessions_handle_idx", ["handle"], true],
      ["staff_sessions_user_idx", ["user_id"], false],
    ]);
    expect(checks("staff_sessions")).toEqual(["staff_sessions_lifetime"]);
  });

  test("audit_log gains the staff session's handle, the key, the action's hash and the step-up, all optional", () => {
    const added = [
      ["staff_session", "uuid"],
      ["key_id", "uuid"],
      ["action_hash", "text"],
      ["step_up", "jsonb"],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type] of added) {
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(false);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.hasDefault, name).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(checks("audit_log")).toEqual(["audit_log_step_up_complete"]);
  });

  test("audit_log's chain columns are not null, with placeholder defaults that the trigger always overwrites", () => {
    const chain = [
      ["chain_version", "smallint", 0],
      ["chain_seq", "bigint", 0],
      ["prev_hash", "text", ""],
      ["hash", "text", ""],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type, placeholder] of chain) {
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.notNull, name).toBe(true);
      expect(column("audit_log", name)?.default, name).toBe(placeholder);
    }
    // One index serves the viewer and audit-verify; there is none on (created_at, id).
    expect(indexes("audit_log")).toEqual([["audit_log_chain_seq_idx", ["chain_seq"], true]]);
  });

  test("audit_head holds one row, the newest place and hash, which the API role may only read", () => {
    const cfg = byName.get("audit_head")!;
    expect(cfg.schema).toBeUndefined(); // public
    expect(shape("audit_head")).toEqual([
      ["id", "smallint", true],
      ["seq", "bigint", true],
      ["hash", "text", true],
    ]);
    expect(column("audit_head", "id")?.primary).toBe(true);
    expect(cfg.columns.filter((c) => c.hasDefault)).toEqual([]);
    expect(checks("audit_head")).toEqual(["audit_head_single_row"]);
    expect(cfg.enableRLS).toBe(true);
    expect(policies("audit_head")).toEqual([["audit_head_api_select", "select", apiRole]]);
  });
});

describe("moderation cases 3c", () => {
  const column = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.find((c) => c.name === name);
  /** Name, SQL type and not-null of every column, in order. */
  const shape = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.columns.map((c) => [c.name, c.getSQLType(), c.notNull]);
  const checks = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.checks.map((c) => c.name).sort();
  const policies = (table: string) => byName.get(table)!.policies.map((p) => [p.name, p.for, p.to]);
  const index = (table: string, name: string) => byName.get(table)!.indexes.find((i) => i.config.name === name)?.config;
  const indexColumns = (config: { columns: unknown[] } | undefined) => config?.columns.map((c) => (c as { name?: string }).name);
  /** An index's predicate as the SQL the migration holds. */
  const predicate = (config: { where?: SQL } | undefined) => (config?.where ? new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(config.where).sql : undefined);
  /** Every foreign key of a table by its local columns: the table and columns it points at and what a delete there does. */
  const foreignKeys = (table: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      byName.get(table)!.foreignKeys.map((k) => {
        const ref = k.reference();
        return [ref.columns.map((c) => c.name).join(","), { table: getTableConfig(ref.foreignTable).name, columns: ref.foreignColumns.map((c) => c.name), onDelete: k.onDelete }];
      }),
    );
  /** The columns declared unique by themselves, each with the name of its constraint. */
  const uniques = (table: string) =>
    byName
      .get(table)!
      .columns.filter((c) => c.isUnique)
      .map((c) => [c.uniqueName, [c.name]])
      .sort();

  /** A check's expression as the migration holds it. */
  const checkSql = (table: string, name: string) => new PgDialect().sqlToQuery(byName.get(table)!.checks.find((c) => c.name === name)!.value).sql;

  const MODERATION_TABLES = ["cases", "intakes", "intake_items", "decisions", "decision_actions", "seal_posts", "appeals", "staff_texts", "evidence_snapshots", "case_access_log", "moderation_limits", "media_holds"];
  const AUTH_TABLES = ["notifier_contacts", "notifier_confirmations", "notifier_suppressions", "staff_personal_accounts"];

  test("the twelve moderation tables are public, with row level security and one policy for the API role", () => {
    for (const name of MODERATION_TABLES) {
      const cfg = byName.get(name);
      expect(cfg, name).toBeDefined();
      expect(cfg!.schema, name).toBeUndefined(); // public
      expect(cfg!.enableRLS, name).toBe(true);
      // The grants do the restricting (migration 0015); moderation_limits is read only, so its one policy is a SELECT one.
      expect(policies(name), name).toEqual(name === "moderation_limits" ? [["moderation_limits_api_select", "select", apiRole]] : [[`${name}_api_all`, "all", apiRole]]);
    }
  });

  test("no moderation table has a column named like an email or an address", () => {
    for (const name of MODERATION_TABLES) {
      for (const c of byName.get(name)!.columns) expect(c.name, `${name}.${c.name}`).not.toMatch(/email|address/i);
    }
  });

  test("xid8 is the xid8 SQL type and hands the transaction id over as a string", () => {
    const table = pgTable("xid8_probe", { value: xid8("value") });
    const probe = getTableConfig(table).columns[0]!;
    expect(probe.getSQLType()).toBe("xid8");
    // A 64-bit counter: a string keeps every digit, where a JavaScript number would not.
    expect(probe.mapFromDriverValue("18446744073709551615")).toBe("18446744073709551615");
    expect(probe.mapToDriverValue("773")).toBe("773");
  });

  test("one open case a target: the partial unique index, the queue's index and the target's index", () => {
    const open = index("cases", "cases_one_open_per_target");
    expect(open?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(open)).toEqual(["target_type", "target_id"]);
    expect(predicate(open)).toBe("closed_at is null");
    const queue = index("cases", "cases_queue_idx");
    expect(queue?.unique).toBe(false);
    expect(indexColumns(queue)).toEqual(["lane", "oldest_open_at"]);
    expect(predicate(queue)).toBe("closed_at is null");
    expect(indexColumns(index("cases", "cases_target_idx"))).toEqual(["target_type", "target_id", "opened_at"]);
    expect(checks("cases")).toEqual(["cases_closed_answered", "cases_lane", "cases_seq_order"]);
    expect(column("cases", "id")?.hasDefault).toBe(true);
    // No foreign key on the target: it names two tables.
    expect(foreignKeys("cases")).toEqual({});
  });

  test("an item's partial unique indexes: one target a notice, one re-examination an item, one item per reporter, case and ground", () => {
    const target = index("intake_items", "intake_items_target_once");
    expect(target?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(target)).toEqual(["intake_id", "target_type", "target_id"]);
    expect(predicate(target)).toBe("reexamines_item_id is null");

    const reexamines = index("intake_items", "intake_items_reexamines_once");
    expect(reexamines?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(reexamines)).toEqual(["reexamines_item_id"]);
    expect(predicate(reexamines)).toBe("reexamines_item_id is not null");

    const reporter = index("intake_items", "intake_items_reporter_once");
    expect(reporter?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(reporter)).toEqual(["case_id", "reporter_account_id", "alleges_illegal"]);
    expect(predicate(reporter)).toBe("reexamines_item_id is null");

    const seq = index("intake_items", "intake_items_case_seq_idx");
    expect(seq?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(seq)).toEqual(["case_id", "seq"]);
    expect(seq?.where).toBeUndefined();

    // The freeze's probe, and the release's.
    const suspect = index("intake_items", "intake_items_suspect_open_idx");
    expect(indexColumns(suspect)).toEqual(["case_id"]);
    expect(predicate(suspect)).toBe("suspect and answered_by is null");
    expect(predicate(index("intake_items", "intake_items_revision_idx"))).toBe("revision_pending_at is not null");
    expect(indexColumns(index("intake_items", "intake_items_answered_by_idx"))).toEqual(["answered_by"]);
  });

  test("an item records whether it is suspect and the handle an account was named by, and the database holds both halves of that", () => {
    const suspect = column("intake_items", "suspect");
    expect(suspect?.getSQLType()).toBe("boolean");
    expect(suspect?.notNull).toBe(true);
    // The trigger forces it; the default is there so that no insert must name a forced column.
    expect(suspect?.default).toBe(false);
    const named = column("intake_items", "named_handle");
    expect(named?.getSQLType()).toBe("text");
    expect(named?.notNull).toBe(false);
    expect(checks("intake_items")).toEqual([
      "intake_items_case",
      "intake_items_lane",
      "intake_items_named_handle",
      "intake_items_position",
      "intake_items_shown",
      "intake_items_statement",
      "intake_items_statement_len",
    ]);
    expect(foreignKeys("intake_items")).toEqual({
      intake_id: { table: "intakes", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      case_id: { table: "cases", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      answered_by: { table: "decisions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "no action" },
      reexamines_item_id: { table: "intake_items", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "no action" },
    });
  });

  test("no check lets a row through on a null: a statement always has its digest, a salt its form, and the two comparisons with a nullable value are null-safe", () => {
    // A CHECK passes when its expression is null, so `digest = encode(...)` alone would accept a statement with no digest.
    for (const [table, name] of [
      ["intake_items", "intake_items_statement"],
      ["appeals", "appeals_statement"],
    ] as const) {
      expect(checkSql(table, name), name).toContain(`"${table}"."statement_digest" is not null and "${table}"."statement_digest" = encode(sha256(`);
      expect(checkSql(table, name), name).toContain(`"${table}"."statement_salt" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'`);
    }
    expect(checkSql("staff_texts", "staff_texts_digest")).toContain(`"staff_texts"."salt" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "staff_texts"."digest" = encode(sha256(`);
    expect(checkSql("intake_items", "intake_items_case")).toBe(
      `("intake_items"."case_id" is null) = ("intake_items"."seq" is null) and ("intake_items"."case_id" is not null or "intake_items"."outcome" is not distinct from 'not_available')`,
    );
    expect(checkSql("decisions", "decisions_keyword")).toBe(`"decisions"."category_keyword" is null or "decisions"."ground" is not distinct from 'illegal'`);
  });

  test("every check of intakes, by name", () => {
    expect(checks("intakes")).toEqual([
      "intakes_category",
      "intakes_category_keyword",
      "intakes_cited_law_len",
      "intakes_contact_signed_out",
      "intakes_csam",
      "intakes_erased",
      "intakes_explanation_len",
      "intakes_finding",
      "intakes_finding_legal",
      "intakes_has_ground",
      "intakes_illegal_elements",
      "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
      "intakes_lookup",
      "intakes_r2_finding_only",
      "intakes_ref",
      "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
      "intakes_rule_id",
    ]);
    // The public reference and the token's hash each name one notice.
    expect(uniques("intakes")).toEqual([
      ["intakes_lookup_hash_unique", ["lookup_hash"]],
      ["intakes_ref_unique", ["ref"]],
    ]);
    expect(foreignKeys("intakes")).toEqual({
      reporter_id: { table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "set null" },
      finding_by: { table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
    });
    // The notifier's contact lives in the auth schema; the public row holds only its id, with no foreign key.
    expect(column("intakes", "contact_id")?.getSQLType()).toBe("uuid");
    expect(predicate(index("intakes", "intakes_unerased_idx"))).toBe("erased_at is null");
  });

  test("every check of decisions, by name, and one review an appeal", () => {
    expect(checks("decisions")).toEqual([
      "decisions_automated_decision",
      "decisions_category",
      "decisions_category_keyword",
      "decisions_digests",
      "decisions_ground_law",
      "decisions_ground_rule",
      "decisions_interim",
      "decisions_keyword",
      "decisions_law_no_rule",
      "decisions_restricted",
      "decisions_reversal_plain",
      "decisions_review_target",
      "decisions_rule_id",
      "decisions_territorial_scope",
    ]);
    const once = index("decisions", "decisions_appeal_once");
    expect(once?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(once)).toEqual(["appeal_id"]);
    expect(predicate(once)).toBe("appeal_id is not null");
    expect(foreignKeys("decisions")).toEqual({
      case_id: { table: "cases", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      reviews_decision_id: { table: "decisions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "no action" },
      appeal_id: { table: "appeals", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "no action" },
      snapshot_id: { table: "evidence_snapshots", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      decided_by: { table: "profiles", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
    });
  });

  test("the columns of decisions that the database forces: their types, and which carry a default", () => {
    // [name, SQL type, not null, default]; undefined where the column has none and the trigger of 0016 alone fills it.
    const forced = [
      ["appeal_id", "uuid", false, undefined],
      ["answers_from_seq", "integer", false, undefined],
      ["source", "decision_source", true, undefined],
      ["automated_detection", "boolean", true, false],
      ["automated_decision", "text", true, "not_automated"],
      ["territorial_scope", "text", true, "worldwide"],
      ["decided_at", "timestamp with time zone", true, undefined],
      ["xact", "xid8", true, undefined],
      ["puid", "text", true, undefined],
      ["informed_at", "timestamp with time zone", true, undefined],
      ["suspect", "boolean", true, undefined],
      ["unseen", "boolean", true, false],
      ["needs_admin", "boolean", true, undefined],
      ["ended_interim", "boolean", true, undefined],
      ["author_mail", "delivery_state", true, "none"],
      ["author_mail_at", "timestamp with time zone", false, undefined],
    ] as const;
    for (const [name, type, notNull, fallback] of forced) {
      const c = column("decisions", name);
      expect(c?.getSQLType(), name).toBe(type);
      expect(c?.notNull, name).toBe(notNull);
      expect(c?.default, name).toBe(fallback);
    }
    // The Transparency Database's platform id: one per decision, never the internal id.
    expect(uniques("decisions")).toEqual([["decisions_puid_unique", ["puid"]]]);
  });

  test("the ledger: a measure once a decision, lifted at most once, and the columns the database forces", () => {
    expect(shape("decision_actions")).toEqual([
      ["id", "uuid", true],
      ["decision_id", "uuid", true],
      ["kind", "action_kind", true],
      ["media_id", "uuid", false],
      ["subject_account_id", "uuid", true],
      ["post_id", "uuid", false],
      ["reverses_action_id", "uuid", false],
      ["no_effect", "text", false],
      ["created_at", "timestamp with time zone", true],
      // 3e (design, section 6.1): three the key signs, four the trigger forces.
      ["days", "smallint", false],
      ["announced", "boolean", false],
      ["basis", "text", false],
      ["rests_on", "uuid[]", false],
      ["starts_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["ends_at", "timestamp with time zone", false],
      ["replaced", "boolean", false],
    ]);
    // None of the forced columns has a default: the triggers of 0016 and 0021 alone fill them.
    for (const name of ["subject_account_id", "post_id", "reverses_action_id", "no_effect", "created_at", "days", "announced", "basis", "rests_on", "starts_at", "ends_at", "replaced"]) {
      expect(column("decision_actions", name)?.hasDefault, name).toBe(false);
    }
    const once = byName.get("decision_actions")!.uniqueConstraints.map((u) => [u.getName(), u.columns.map((c) => c.name), u.nullsNotDistinct]);
    expect(once).toEqual([["decision_actions_once", ["decision_id", "kind", "media_id"], true]]);
    const reversed = index("decision_actions", "decision_actions_reversed_once");
    expect(reversed?.unique).toBe(true);
    expect(indexColumns(reversed)).toEqual(["reverses_action_id"]);
    expect(predicate(reversed)).toBe("reverses_action_id is not null");
    expect(checks("decision_actions")).toEqual(["decision_actions_announced", "decision_actions_basis", "decision_actions_days", "decision_actions_no_effect"]);
    // Each check names columns only: no value of action_kind, which a check may not name in the migration that adds it.
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_days")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."days" between 1 and 30`);
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_basis")).toBe(
      `"decision_actions"."basis" in ('strikes', 'threat', 'terrorist', 'flood', 'protective', 'threat_repeat', 'ladder_end', 'reports')`,
    );
    expect(checkSql("decision_actions", "decision_actions_announced")).toBe(`"decision_actions"."announced" is null or "decision_actions"."basis" is not null`);
    expect(foreignKeys("decision_actions")).toEqual({
      decision_id: { table: "decisions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "restrict" },
      reverses_action_id: { table: "decision_actions", columns: ["id"], onDelete: "no action" },
    });
    // 3c's seven measures and five reversals, then 3e's six measures and four reversals, in the order the migration adds them.
    expect(schema.actionKind.enumValues).toEqual([
      "withhold",
      "remove",
      "seal_media",
      "withhold_media",
      "remove_media",
      "reset_display_name",
      "reset_bio",
      "restore",
      "unseal_media",
      "restore_media",
      "restore_display_name",
      "restore_bio",
      "strike",
      "suspend",
      "terminate",
      "retire_handle",
      "warn_reporting",
      "restrict_reporting",
      "overrule",
      "lift_suspension",
      "unretire_handle",
      "lift_reporting",
    ]);
  });

  test("profiles gain the three columns standing_apply derives, null by default, and one interval at most", () => {
    for (const name of ["suspended_from", "suspended_until", "reports_restricted_until"]) {
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { STANDING_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_TEXTS, REDRESS_VERSION, RULEBOOKS, RULES, RULES_VERSION, getRedress, getRule, isRuleId } from "../src/index";

const VERSIONS = [1, 2, 3] as const;

describe("rulebook", () => {
  test("the current rulebook is version 3, and every version is kept: a decision renders with the rules it was made under", () => {
    expect(RULES_VERSION).toBe(3);
    expect(Object.keys(RULEBOOKS).map(Number)).toEqual([...VERSIONS]);
    expect(RULES).toBe(RULEBOOKS[RULES_VERSION]);
  });

  test.each(VERSIONS)("version %i has exactly six rules R1..R6 in order", (version) => {
    expect(RULEBOOKS[version].map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]);
  });

  test.each(VERSIONS)("every rule of version %i has text and at least one example on each side", (version) => {
    for (const r of RULEBOOKS[version]) {
      expect(r.title.length, r.id).toBeGreaterThan(5);
      expect(r.text.length, r.id).toBeGreaterThan(40);
      expect(r.notAllowed.length, r.id).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(r.allowed.length, r.id).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    }
  });

  test("version 1 is the six rules as they stood: only R2 fully automated, only R1 auto-withheld", () => {
    const v1 = RULEBOOKS[1];
    expect(v1.filter((r) => r.automation === "auto_remove").map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(["R2"]);
    expect(v1.filter((r) => r.automation === "withhold_for_review").map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(["R1"]);
    expect(v1.filter((r) => r.seniorQueue).map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(["R2", "R5"]);
    expect(getRule("R1", 1)?.text).toContain("Images that score high on the automated check are hidden from others until a person reviews them");
    expect(getRule("R2", 1)?.text).toContain("removed automatically on a hash match");
    expect(getRule("R5", 1)?.text).toContain("Cases go to the senior queue.");
    expect(getRule("R6", 1)?.title).toBe("No spam, scams, or impersonation");
  });

  test("version 2 automates nothing: a person decides every case, and R2 and R5 are an admin's", () => {
    const v2 = RULEBOOKS[2];
    expect(v2.filter((r) => r.automation !== "none").map((r) => r.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(v2.filter((r) => r.seniorQueue).map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(["R2", "R5"]);
  });

  test("version 2's R1 no longer promises an automated check", () => {
    expect(getRule("R1", 2)?.text).toBe(
      "Images or text whose primary purpose is sexual arousal are not allowed. This includes nudity presented sexually, explicit sexual acts, and sexualised depictions of anyone.",
    );
  });

  test("version 2's R2 says that nobody opens reported images, who seals them and who decides", () => {
    expect(getRule("R2", 2)?.text).toBe(
      "Any sexualised depiction of a minor is not allowed. Nobody at korbat opens images that are reported or found as such material while the report is unanswered or the images are sealed. " +
        "After an admin has answered without a seal, staff may open them like any other image. Whoever is on duty may seal them while an admin decides: sealed images are shown to nobody, their author included. " +
        "An admin either seals them for good, in which case they are kept only for the authorities and reported to them, or answers without a seal. " +
        "Every final decision on a report or finding under this rule, whether it acts or not, and every review of one, is taken by an admin. " +
        "Only an admin can lift a seal, and a seal for good only on the authorities' answer; an appeal of a seal waits until the authorities have assessed the images.",
    );
  });

  test("version 2's R4 hides on a moderator's decision, never on the number of reports", () => {
    const text = getRule("R4", 2)!.text;
    expect(text.endsWith("When a moderator finds a report credible, the post is hidden from others while the moderator decides, because the harm is immediate. The number of reports never decides it.")).toBe(true);
    expect(text).not.toContain("When a report is credible the post is hidden");
    // Everything before its last sentence is version 1's.
    expect(text.startsWith(getRule("R4", 1)!.text.split(" When a report is credible")[0]!)).toBe(true);
  });

  test("version 2's R5 says who may hide a threat, who decides, and who reviews an appeal", () => {
    const text = getRule("R5", 2)!.text;
    expect(text).not.toContain("senior queue");
    expect(
      text.endsWith(
        "Any moderator may hide a reported threat from others at once while an admin decides, and may lift that again. " +
          "Every final decision on a report under this rule, whether it acts or not, is taken by an admin, and only an admin corrects one. " +
          "An appeal against a restriction under it is reviewed by a moderator who made none of the case's decisions and did not report it themselves, and waits while korbat has none.",
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  test("version 2's R6 names coordinated manipulation, with its examples on both sides", () => {
    const r6 = getRule("R6", 2)!;
    expect(r6.title).toBe("No spam, scams, impersonation or coordinated manipulation");
    expect(r6.text).toContain("Coordinating several accounts, your own or other people's, to like, repost or report together is not allowed.");
    expect(r6.notAllowed).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["A group of accounts liking each other's posts on cue to lift them in Explore", "Reporting someone together to get them removed"]));
    expect(r6.allowed).toContain("Asking your followers to read or share a post");
    // Version 1's examples are all still there.
    for (const example of getRule("R6", 1)!.notAllowed) expect(r6.notAllowed).toContain(example);
    for (const example of getRule("R6", 1)!.allowed) expect(r6.allowed).toContain(example);
  });

  test("version 3 is version 2 with one change, to R6: repeated plainly unfounded reports, after a warning; a notice of illegal content is never restricted", () => {
    const [v2, v3] = [RULEBOOKS[2], RULEBOOKS[3]];
    for (const id of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5"]) expect(getRule(id, 3), id).toEqual(getRule(id, 2));
    expect(v3.filter((r) => r.automation !== "none").map((r) => r.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(v3.filter((r) => r.seniorQueue).map((r) => r.id)).toEqual(v2.filter((r) => r.seniorQueue).map((r) => r.id));
    const [r6v2, r6v3] = [getRule("R6", 2)!, getRule("R6", 3)!];
    expect(r6v3.title).toBe(r6v2.title);
    expect(r6v3.text).toBe(
      `${r6v2.text} Sending report after report that is plainly unfounded is not allowed either: after a warning, korbat may stop taking an account's reports under these rules for a limited time. A notice of illegal content is never restricted.`,
    );
    expect(r6v3.notAllowed).toEqual([...r6v2.notAllowed, "Reporting the same account again and again for posts that plainly break no rule"]);
    expect(r6v3.allowed).toEqual([...r6v2.allowed, "Reporting in good faith something that turns out to break no rule"]);
  });

  test("R3 reads the same in both versions", () => {
    expect(getRule("R3", 2)).toEqual(getRule("R3", 1));
  });

  test("getRule reads a rule of one version, the current one unless told, and isRuleId knows the six ids", () => {
    expect(getRule("R3")?.title).toMatch(/hatred/i);
    expect(getRule("R6")).toBe(getRule("R6", RULES_VERSION));
    expect(getRule("R6", 1)?.title).not.toBe(getRule("R6", 2)?.title);
    expect(getRule("R9")).toBeUndefined();
    expect(getRule("R1", 4)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(isRuleId("R6")).toBe(true);
    expect(isRuleId("x")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("redress", () => {
  const LAST = "You can also go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";

    expect(Object.keys(REDRESS_TEXTS[2])).toEqual(["appeal", "interim", "notAppealable", "strikeNext", "reply", "replyAtOnce", "replyAnswered", "warnNext", "appealNow"]);
    for (const key of ["appeal", "interim", "notAppealable"] as const) expect(REDRESS_TEXTS[2][key], key).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1][key]);
    expect(getRedress(REDRESS_VERSION)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[2]);
    expect(getRedress(1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1]);

A reply sent before the start holds the start until a moderator has read it and answered you; if the decision is kept, it then starts with the answer, and never before the time you were given. A reply sent later is read and answered too, and can end this measure, but does not pause it. You can reply once. Replying does not use up your appeal.`,
    );
    expect(v2.replyAtOnce).toBe(

    );

The six months for it count from this answer when you replied before the start, and otherwise from the day you were told of that decision. ${LAST}`,
    );

    expect(v2.appealNow).toBe("You can appeal from now; you do not have to wait for the start. An appeal does not hold the start: only a reply sent before the start does.");
  });

  test("every number in version 2's texts is held to STANDING_RULES: a changed number is a new version, so an old statement keeps its own", () => {

    expect(v2.strikeNext).toContain(`after ${words[STANDING_RULES.ladderDays.length]} suspensions in ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days`);
    expect(v2.warnNext).toContain(`If ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks} of the reports`);
    expect(v2.warnNext).toContain(`for up to ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days`);
```

```ts
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };

    const FIELD = (field: string) => `korbat does not put back your ${field} as it was before the reset: set it again in Settings, Profile if you wish.`;
    const KEPT = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days.`;
    const KEPT_R4 = `The screen of the decision that reset it shows what it was for at least ${RETENTION.resetValueDays} days, unless korbat had already erased it under rule R4.`;

    test("a correction of a final decision renders that decision's rule from its own row and version, and its reason", () => {
      // The corrected decision was made under rulebook version 1: its rule reads as that version worded it.
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 1 }, reversals: [reversal("restore")] }));
      expect(out).toEqual([
        "korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed it.",
        `Your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 1)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat changed it: The post is satire.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      const part = statementParagraphs(correction({ outcome: "partly_reversed", reversals: [reversal("restore_media")] }));
      expect(part[0]).toBe("korbat corrected its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of it.");
      expect(part[1]).toBe(
        `One image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
      );
      // A corrected decision on the law renders its legal reference.
      const law = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 241." } }));
      expect(law).toContain("That decision rested on the law: Section 241.");
    });

    test("a correction of an interim decision lifts what was done while deciding", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(correction({ reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed: { ...reviewed, kind: "interim" } }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe("korbat lifted what it did while deciding on 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC.");
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });

    test("a review answers the appeal: kept, reversed in part or reversed", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: "The post was read again.", measures: [], reviewed }))).toEqual([
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and kept that decision.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        `That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
        "Why korbat kept it: The post was read again.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed that decision.",
      );
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "partly_reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore_media")], reviewed }))[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reviewed your appeal against its decision of 2026-10-01 09:00 UTC and reversed part of that decision.",
      );
    });

    test("the field-restore sentence, with and without its 30-day sentence, and with the R4 form", () => {
      const lifted = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]>, kind: ReversalKind = "restore_bio") => statementParagraphs(correction({ post: null, reversals: [reversal(kind, { resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, ...more })] }))[1];
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: false })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your bio. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      expect(lifted({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R3" }, "restore_display_name")).toBe(`korbat lifted the reset of your display name. ${FIELD("display name")} ${KEPT}`);
    });

    test("a final no-action decision that ends measures taken while deciding names them, and nothing else it did", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(
        statement({
          outcome: "no_violation",
          ground: null,
          ruleId: null,
          facts: null,
          reason: null,
          measures: [],
          endedMeasures: [
            { kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, ...NO_RESET },
            { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE, ...NO_RESET },
          ],
        }),
      );
      expect(out).toEqual([
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.withhold.label}, ${MEASURES.withhold_media.label}.`,
        "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
        "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
        REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable,
      ]);
    });

    test("the field sentence after an interim reset ended by a closing decision, with and without its 30-day sentence, and none for a field the closing decision resets itself", () => {
      const ended = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"][number]>, kind: MeasureKind = "reset_bio") => ({ kind, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: RESET_DECISION, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, ...more });
      const closing = (endedMeasures: DecisionStatement["endedMeasures"], more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) =>
        statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, post: null, measures: [], endedMeasures, ...more }));
      expect(closing([ended({})])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`);
      expect(closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R4" })])[0]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT_R4}`);
      // Two resets of two fields: one field sentence each.
      expect(closing([ended({}, "reset_display_name"), ended({ oldValueKept: true })])[0]).toBe(
        `What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_display_name.label}, ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}. ${FIELD("display name")} ${FIELD("bio")} ${KEPT}`,
      );
      // The closing decision resets the bio itself: its own reset's sentences speak for the field, and no field sentence is added.
      const own = closing([ended({ oldValueKept: true })], { outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", facts: "f", reason: "r", measures: [measure("reset_bio")] });
      expect(own[0]).toContain("korbat reset your bio.");
      expect(own[1]).toBe(`What korbat did while deciding has ended: ${MEASURES.reset_bio.label}.`);
      expect(own.join("\n")).not.toContain("korbat does not put back your bio");
    });

    test("a final decision that lifts a withhold taken while deciding and leaves the case open", () => {
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")] }));
      expect(out[0]).toBe(
        `Your post of ${POST_TIME}: korbat lifted this restriction. If your post or image is still restricted, another decision listed in Settings, Cases applies, or its content was erased under korbat's retention rules.`,
      );
      expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });
  });

  test("a review or a correction renders the reviewed decision's rule under the rulebook that decision was made under, whatever version its own row carries", () => {
    const [v1, v2] = [getRule("R6", 1)!, getRule("R6", 2)!];
    expect(v1.title).not.toBe(v2.title);
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R6" as const, rulesVersion: 1, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    const correction = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }));
    expect(correction).toContain(`That decision rested on korbat rule R6, "${v1.title}": ${v1.text}`);
    expect(correction.join(" ")).not.toContain(v2.title);
    const review = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed }));
    expect(review).toContain(`That decision rested on korbat rule R6, "${v1.title}": ${v1.text}`);
    // A reviewed decision made under the current rulebook reads the current wording.
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 2 } }))).toContain(
      `That decision rested on korbat rule R6, "${v2.title}": ${v2.text}`,
    );
    // A rulebook this package does not hold is never rendered as another.
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reviewed: { ...reviewed, rulesVersion: 99 } }))).toThrow();
  });

  test("a decision that does nothing, and a decision on the law whose reference was erased, each read one fixed sentence", () => {
    expect(W.noAction).toBe("korbat decided to take no action.");
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [] }))[0]).toBe("korbat decided to take no action.");
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, legalReference: null }))).toContain("korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.");
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "illegal" as const, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }))).toContain(
      "That decision rested on the law: its reference was erased under korbat's retention rules.",
    );
  });

  test("every reversal kind has its sentence", () => {
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    // 3c's five reversals; the overruling of a strike has its own test below.
    for (const kind of REVERSAL_KINDS.slice(0, 5)) {
      const account = MEASURES[kind].target === "display_name" || MEASURES[kind].target === "bio";
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, post: account ? null : POST, measures: [], reversals: [reversal(kind)], reviewed }));
      expect(out[1], kind).toMatch(/korbat lifted (this restriction|the seal on these images|the reset of your (display name|bio))\./);
    }
  });

  test("staff texts that were erased leave their paragraphs out, and the statement still stands", () => {
    const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ facts: null, reason: null }));
    expect(out.join("\n")).not.toMatch(/The facts:|korbat's reasons:/);
    expect(out.at(-1)).toBe(appeal(DECIDED));
  });
});


describe("3e: the strike's sentences (design, section 18, W.2 and W.3)", () => {
  const ENDS = "2027-01-02T09:30:15.250Z";
  const strike = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}) => measure("strike", { endsAt: ENDS, activeThen: 2, ...more });
  /** A final removal under R3 that gives a strike, made under rulebook 3 and redress 2. */
  const struck = (more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}) => statement({ ruleId: "R3", rulesVersion: 3, redressVersion: 2, measures: [measure("remove"), strike()], ...more });
  const appeal2 = (decidedAt: string) => REDRESS_TEXTS[2].appeal.replace("{deadline}", `${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(11, 16)} UTC`);

  test("the words, each a constant", () => {
    expect(W.strike("2027-01-02 09:30 UTC", 2)).toBe(
      "This decision gives your account a strike. It counts until 2027-01-02 09:30 UTC. With it your account had 2 active strikes when this was decided. korbat's rules fix when a decision gives a strike; the moderator does not choose it.",
    );
    expect(W.strike("2027-01-02 09:30 UTC", 1)).toContain("With it your account had 1 active strike when this was decided.");
    expect(W.strikeAnyway).toBe("The strike counts although the post was already not shown or deleted: what counts is the breach.");
    expect(W.overruled).toBe("korbat overruled the strike that decision gave. It no longer counts.");
    expect(W.automationStrike).toBe(
      "No automated means were used to find this or to decide that it breaks the rule. That the decision gives a strike follows from korbat's published rule, which its software applies.",
    );
  });

  test("a removal that gives a strike, paragraph by paragraph: the strike follows the removal with the prior warning, and the automation sentence says what the software did", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(struck())).toEqual([
      `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`,
      `${W.strike("2027-01-02 09:30 UTC", 2)} ${REDRESS_TEXTS[2].strikeNext}`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
      W.automationStrike,
      `It breaks korbat rule R3, "${getRule("R3", 3)!.title}": ${getRule("R3", 3)!.text}`,
      "The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
      "korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
      appeal2(DECIDED),
    ]);
    // The six elements of Article 17(3) are all there; a decision without a strike keeps 3c's automation sentence.
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ rulesVersion: 3, redressVersion: 2 }))).toContain(W.automation);
    expect(statementParagraphs(struck())).not.toContain(W.automation);
  });

  test("a strike whose other measures all changed nothing still counts, and says so", () => {
    const out = statementParagraphs(struck({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "deleted" }), strike()] }));
    expect(out[1]).toBe(`${W.strike("2027-01-02 09:30 UTC", 2)} ${W.strikeAnyway} ${REDRESS_TEXTS[2].strikeNext}`);
    // One measure that changed something: no such sentence.
    const mixed = statementParagraphs(struck({ measures: [measure("remove", { noEffect: "already" }), measure("remove_media"), strike()] }));
    expect(mixed.join("\n")).not.toContain(W.strikeAnyway);
  });

  test("the overruling of a strike in a correction or a review that reverses the decision", () => {
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R3" as const, rulesVersion: 3, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    for (const kind of ["correction", "review"] as const) {
      const out = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind, outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, rulesVersion: 3, redressVersion: 2, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore"), reversal("overrule")], reviewed }));
      expect(out, kind).toContain(W.overruled);
      expect(out.at(-1), kind).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[2].notAppealable);
    }
  });

  test("a strike without its end of counting is not rendered as another statement; a kind of 3e that is not worded yet is not rendered at all", () => {
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(struck({ measures: [measure("remove"), strike({ endsAt: null })] }))).toThrow(/strike/);
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(struck({ post: null, measures: [measure("suspend")] }))).toThrow(/suspend/);
    const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R3" as const, rulesVersion: 3, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
    expect(() => statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, post: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("lift_suspension")], reviewed }))).toThrow(/lift_suspension/);
  });

  test("a statement under redress version 1 and rulebook version 2 renders as it did", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toEqual([
      `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
      "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
      `It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
      "The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
      "korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
      appeal(DECIDED),
    ]);
    // Rulebook 3's R6 is rendered as version 3 words it, version 2's as version 2 does.
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 3 }))).toContain("Sending report after report that is plainly unfounded is not allowed either");
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 2 }))).not.toContain("Sending report after report");
  });
});
describe("the package", () => {
  test("its index re-exports the statement and its words: the index is the package's only door", () => {
    expect(typeof statementParagraphs).toBe("function");
    expect(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation).toBe("No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/standing-repo.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { iso, rows, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The queries of account sanctions (3e design, sections 6.2 and 7.12): an account's standing as the views of the standing
 * ledger give it, the strike rule's answer for a post case, and the period of each standing measure. Every number comes
 * from the database's own standing_rules(), and every "now" is the database's clock, so the case answer reads what the
 * ledger's triggers would read at the same moment. Nothing here is stored: each answer is computed at the request.
 */

/** A UTC day of a timestamptz expression. The expression is written here, never input. */
const day = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')`);

/** An instant as JavaScript writes it, or null for an infinite one (a termination's end). */
const finite = (expression: string) => sql`case when isfinite(${sql.raw(expression)}) then ${iso(expression)} end`;

/**
 * What strike_due answers for a final restriction of this case on a korbat rule other than R2 that rests on no suspect
 * item (the rule passed is R1: strike_due asks only that it is not R2), and whether the case's post already carries a
 * strike that stands, which is the first of the two reasons it can answer false.
 */
export async function strikeDueOf(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ due: boolean; struck: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select public.strike_due(${caseId}::uuid, 'incompatible', 'R1', false, null) as due,
               exists (select 1 from cases c
                         join cases x on x.target_type = 'post' and x.target_id = c.target_id
                         join decisions d on d.case_id = x.id
                         join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike'
                        where c.id = ${caseId}::uuid
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)) as struck`,
  );
  return { due: row?.due ?? false, struck: row?.struck ?? false };
}

/** An active strike of an account, as the case answer lists it. */
export interface StrikeRow {
  decisionId: string;
  caseId: string;
  ruleId: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  countsUntil: string;
}

/** The facts an account's standing is built from, each read from the ledger's views at the database's clock. */
export interface StandingFacts {
  /** The active strikes, oldest first. */
  strikes: StrikeRow[];
  /** The rule of the newest active strike. */
  ladderRule: string | null;
  /** Whether a strike is newer than the newest measure of the ladder that stands, or there is none. */
  newStrikeSinceLadder: boolean;
  /** The suspensions of the ladder that stand, whose basis holds, decided in the last ladder_memory_days, and the day of the newest. */
  suspensionsInYear: number;
  lastSuspendedOn: string | null;
  /** The live standing measure (standing_live), with its kind and its period's state now; null when none. */
  live: { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean } | null;
  /** The account's posts of the last flood_minutes, and the interval they were counted in. */
  flood: { posts: number; from: string; to: string };
  /** The grounds of a measure at once whose facts hold now, by the rows of decision_actions_check's table. */
  threat: boolean;
  terrorist: boolean;
  threatRepeat: boolean;
  /** The day of the newest seal for good of the account's images that a protective suspension may rest on now. */
  sealOn: string | null;
}

/**
 * An account's standing: its active strikes, its ladder, its live measure, and the facts of the grounds of a measure at
 * once, read as the rows of decision_actions_check's table read them. An aid to the console: the database decides at the
 * commit, and a fact that moves between this read and the key is refused there.
 */
export async function standingFacts(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<StandingFacts> {
  const account = sql`${accountId}::uuid`;
  const strikes = await rows<{ decision_id: string; case_id: string; rule_id: string; decided_at: string; counts_until: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select s.decision_id, d.case_id, d.rule_id, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, ${iso("s.ends_at")} as counts_until
          from active_strikes s join decisions d on d.id = s.decision_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} order by s.created_at, s.action_id`,
  );
  const [ladder] = await rows<{ new_strike: boolean; in_year: number; last_on: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select coalesce((select max(s.created_at) from active_strikes s where s.account_id = ${account})
                          > (select max(a.created_at) from decision_actions a
                              where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.basis in ('strikes', 'ladder_end')
                                and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)), true) as new_strike,
               count(y.id)::int as in_year, max(${day("y.decided_at")}) as last_on
          from (select 1) one
          left join (select a.id, d.decided_at from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id cross join standing_rules() k
                      where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'strikes'
                        and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                        and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                        and d.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)) y on true`,
  );
  const [live] = await rows<{ kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; running: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, coalesce(p.starts_at <= clock_timestamp(), false) as running
          from standing_live s join decision_actions a on a.id = s.action_id left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = s.action_id
         where s.account_id = ${account} limit 1`,
  );
  const [grounds] = await rows<{ posts: number; from_at: string; to_at: string; threat: boolean; terrorist: boolean; threat_repeat: boolean; seal_on: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select (select count(*)::int from posts p where p.author_id = ${account} and p.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes)) as posts,
               ${iso("(now() - make_interval(mins => k.flood_minutes))")} as from_at, ${iso("now()")} as to_at,
               exists (select 1 from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                        where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as threat,
               exists (select 1 from decisions x join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id and xc.target_type = 'post' join posts xp on xp.id = xc.target_id and xp.author_id = ${account}
                        where x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.ground = 'illegal' and x.category_keyword = 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT'
                          and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as terrorist,
               exists (select 1 from decision_actions a join decisions ad on ad.id = a.decision_id
                         join posts xp on xp.author_id = ${account} and xp.created_at > ad.informed_at
                         join cases xc on xc.target_type = 'post' and xc.target_id = xp.id
                         join decisions x on x.case_id = xc.id
                        where a.subject_account_id = ${account} and a.kind = 'suspend' and a.basis = 'threat'
                          and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
                          and public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is null
                          and ad.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.ladder_memory_days)
                          and x.kind = 'final' and x.outcome = 'restricted' and x.rule_id = 'R5' and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                          and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force f where f.decision_id = x.id)) as threat_repeat,
               (select ${day("x.decided_at")} from measures_in_force m join decisions x on x.id = m.decision_id
                 where m.kind = 'seal_media' and m.decision_kind = 'final' and m.subject_account_id = ${account}
                   and x.decided_at >= now() - make_interval(days => k.basis_age_days)
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions p where p.kind = 'suspend' and p.basis = 'protective' and m.decision_id = any(p.rests_on))
                 order by x.decided_at desc, x.id desc limit 1) as seal_on
          from standing_rules() k`,
  );
  return {
    strikes: strikes.map((row) => ({ decisionId: row.decision_id, caseId: row.case_id, ruleId: row.rule_id, decidedAt: row.decided_at, countsUntil: row.counts_until })),
    ladderRule: strikes.at(-1)?.rule_id ?? null,
    newStrikeSinceLadder: ladder!.new_strike,
    suspensionsInYear: ladder!.in_year,
    lastSuspendedOn: ladder!.last_on,
    live: live ? { kind: live.kind, running: live.running } : null,
    flood: { posts: grounds!.posts, from: grounds!.from_at, to: grounds!.to_at },
    threat: grounds!.threat,
    terrorist: grounds!.terrorist,
    threatRepeat: grounds!.threat_repeat,
    sealOn: grounds!.seal_on,
  };
}

/** Whether the case holds an unanswered item of a user's report: such a case holds the ladder's, the protective and the reporting measures back. */
export async function openReportsIn(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ open: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select exists (select 1 from intake_items i join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where i.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid and i.answered_by is null and n.kind = 'user') as open`,
  );
  return row?.open ?? false;
}

/** A ledger row's columns of 3e, and for a standing measure where its period stands now. */
export interface StandingColumns {
  days: number | null;
  announced: boolean | null;
  basis: string | null;
  restsOn: string[] | null;
  earliestStart: string | null;
  countsUntil: string | null;
  period: { startsAt: string | null; endsAt: string | null; state: string } | null;
  /** On a strike: the kinds of the standing measures that rest on its decision and stand (not lifted, basis whole). */
  restedOnBy: string[] | null;
}

/**
 * The columns of 3e of a case's ledger rows, by id: what the key signed (days, announced), what the trigger forced (the
 * basis, what it rests on, the earliest start, a strike's or a warning's end of counting) and, for a suspension or a
 * termination, its period as suspension_periods gives it with its state at the database's clock: lifted (before its
 * start: never), its basis broken, ended, running, announced (a start fixed and ahead), held by a reply filed on time,
 * or unfixed.
 */
export async function standingColumns(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<Map<string, StandingColumns>> {
  const found = await rows<{
    id: string;
    days: number | null;
    announced: boolean | null;
    basis: string | null;
    rests_on: string[] | null;
    earliest_start: string | null;
    counts_until: string | null;
    rested_on_by: string[] | null;
    standing: boolean;
    starts_at: string | null;
    ends_at: string | null;
    state: string | null;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.id, a.days, a.announced, a.basis, a.rests_on::text[] as rests_on,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then ${iso("a.starts_at")} end as earliest_start,
               case when a.kind in ('strike', 'warn_reporting') then ${iso("a.ends_at")} end as counts_until,
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then coalesce((
                 select array_agg(distinct m.kind::text order by m.kind::text) from decision_actions m
                  where m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
                    and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions x where x.reverses_action_id = m.id)
                    and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) is null), '{}') end as rested_on_by,
               a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') as standing,
               ${iso("p.starts_at")} as starts_at, ${finite("p.ends_at")} as ends_at,
               case
                 when l.id is not null then case when p.starts_at is null then 'never' else 'lifted' end
                 when public.standing_basis_broken_at(a.id) is not null then 'basis_ended'
                 when p.starts_at is not null and p.ends_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'ended'
                 when p.starts_at is not null and p.starts_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'running'
                 when p.starts_at is not null then 'announced'
                 when r.on_time and r.answered_by is null then 'held'
                 else 'unfixed'
               end as state
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = a.id
          left join decision_actions l on l.reverses_action_id = a.id
          left join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = a.id
         where d.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`,
  );
  return new Map(
    found.map((row) => [
      row.id,
      {
        days: row.days,
        announced: row.announced,
        basis: row.basis,
        restsOn: row.rests_on,
        earliestStart: row.earliest_start,
        countsUntil: row.counts_until,
        restedOnBy: row.rested_on_by,
        period: row.standing ? { startsAt: row.starts_at, endsAt: row.ends_at, state: row.state ?? "unfixed" } : null,
      },
    ]),
  );
}

/** How many strikes of the account count now (active_strikes): what the app's block "Your standing" prints. */
export async function activeStrikesOf(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ n: number }>(q, sql`select count(*)::int as n from active_strikes s where s.account_id = ${accountId}::uuid`);
  return row?.n ?? 0;
}

/** A strike as the account's export lists it (3e design, section 18, W.8). */
export interface ExportedStrikeRow {
  decisionId: string;
  postId: string;
  ruleId: string;
  givenAt: string;
  countsUntil: string;
  overruledAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * Every strike the account was given, newest first: the decision that gave it, the post it was given for, the rule, when
 * it was given, until when it counts, and when it was overruled. A strike is the account's own data and names nobody else.
 */
export async function exportedStrikes(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<ExportedStrikeRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ decision_id: string; post_id: string; rule_id: string; given_at: string; counts_until: string; overruled_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select a.decision_id, c.target_id as post_id, d.rule_id, ${iso("a.created_at")} as given_at, ${iso("a.ends_at")} as counts_until,
               (select ${iso("r.created_at")} from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) as overruled_at
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
         where a.subject_account_id = ${accountId}::uuid and a.kind = 'strike'
         order by a.created_at desc, a.id desc`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ decisionId: row.decision_id, postId: row.post_id, ruleId: row.rule_id, givenAt: row.given_at, countsUntil: row.counts_until, overruledAt: row.overruled_at }));
}
```
