```ts
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import type { Platform } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { AccountExport } from "../../auth";
import type { ModerationExport } from "../../moderation";
import type { ProfileExport } from "../../social";
import { AccountError, type AccountDeps } from "../context";
import type { OpenFile, ZipWriter } from "../zip";

/** One export a day (1b design, section 10). */
export const EXPORTS_PER_WINDOW = 1;
export const EXPORT_WINDOW_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const exportLimitKey = (userId: string) => `export:${userId}`;

/** The entry an image has in the archive; export.json names it under the post's media. */
export function mediaEntry(id: string): string {
  return `media/${id}.webp`;
}

/** The download's name: the handle and the day, so several exports of one account sort by date. */
export function exportFilename(handle: string, now: Date): string {
  return `korbat-export-${handle}-${now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.zip`;
}

/**
 * What the archive is written from. The account's own facts, the profile and the moderation member are
 * read before the first byte; the profile's lists are read page by page while export.json is written,
 * and the images, each behind the media module's checked open, go first, so `missingMedia` is complete
 * by the time the JSON that lists it is written.
 */
export interface ExportPlan {
  exportedAt: Date;
  /** The handle of the session that asked for the export: the id the auth module lists each session under. */
  currentSession: string;
  account: AccountExport;
  profile: ProfileExport;
  /** The decisions about the account that it was told of and its own reports, as the moderation module hands them over (3c design, section 7.11). */
  moderation: ModerationExport;
  images: { id: string; open: OpenFile }[];
  /** The images whose file the checked open refused or could not find, filled while the images are written. */
  missingMedia: string[];
}

/**
 * Counts one export of the account in the daily window and refuses once it is used up. Taken before
 * anything is built or streamed, so a stream that fails midway still counts; Retry-After says when the
 * window resets.
 */
export async function enforceExportLimit(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string): Promise<void> {
  let hit: { count: number; resetMs: number };
  try {
    hit = await deps.limits.hit(exportLimitKey(userId), EXPORT_WINDOW_MS);
  } catch {
    // Fails closed: an export that cannot be counted is not made, and the client is told to retry shortly.
    throw new AccountError("service_unavailable", 503, undefined, 30);
  }
  if (hit.count > EXPORTS_PER_WINDOW) throw new AccountError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hit.resetMs / 1000)));
}

/**
 * Gives the day's export back after a failure before the archive's first byte (a pool timeout, a
 * restart): the owner received nothing, so the attempt must not use up the day. Best effort: when the
 * store cannot be reached, the export stays counted and a warning says so, which costs the owner a day
 * at worst.
 */
export async function giveBackExport(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string, log: Logger): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await deps.limits.release(exportLimitKey(userId));
  } catch (err) {
    log.warn({ err, userId }, "account export: the day's export could not be given back after a failure before the first byte");
  }
}

const iso = (at: Date): string => at.toISOString();
const isoOrNull = (at: Date | null): string | null => (at ? at.toISOString() : null);

/** What an account module built without the moderation module writes: the member is part of the format, so it is always there. */
const NO_MODERATION: ModerationExport = { decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [] };

/**
 * Reads what is needed before the first byte: the account's facts, sessions, devices and events (one
 * read, bounded by the 90 days of events), the profile's own fields, the list of images, and the
 * moderation member (the decisions the account was told of and its own reports, both short lists). The
 * four modules are asked at once, so a read that fails costs the owner nothing: no byte was sent yet.
 * `currentSession` is the handle of the session asking, which marks its entry among the sessions.
 * `pageSize` is how many rows of each profile list are read at a time; tests lower it.
 */
export async function buildExport(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string, currentSession: string, now: Date, pageSize?: number): Promise<ExportPlan> {
  const [account, profile, images, moderation] = await Promise.all([
    deps.auth.exportAccount(userId),
    deps.social.exportProfile(userId, pageSize),
    deps.media.exportImages(userId),
    // The server always hands the moderation module over; a test of the other members may leave it out.
    deps.moderation ? deps.moderation.exportFor(userId) : NO_MODERATION,
  ]);
  return { exportedAt: now, currentSession, account, profile, moderation, images, missingMedia: [] };
}

/** A list member of export.json, read in pages and written one element at a time. */
class Paged<T> {
  constructor(
    readonly pages: AsyncIterable<readonly T[]>,
    readonly element: (row: T) => unknown,
  ) {}
}

/** An array already in memory, as one page. */
function inMemory<T>(rows: readonly T[], element: (row: T) => unknown): Paged<T> {
  return new Paged(
    (async function* () {
      yield rows;
    })(),
    element,
  );
}

/** Fragments are gathered into pieces of about this many UTF-16 units, at most 3 bytes each in UTF-8: well under 64 KiB. */
const PIECE_CHARS = 16 * 1024;

/**
 * export.json in pieces, written exactly as JSON.stringify(document, null, 2) writes the whole
 * document: member by member at the top level, and the lists element by element, each element
 * stringified on its own and indented to its depth (JSON.stringify's output holds line breaks only
 * between tokens; one inside a string is escaped, so indenting after every line break is exact). No list
 * is ever whole in memory: each is read page by page as it is written.
 */
export async function* exportJson(plan: ExportPlan): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  let buffer = "";
  for await (const fragment of documentFragments(plan)) {
    buffer += fragment;
    if (buffer.length >= PIECE_CHARS) {
      yield buffer;
      buffer = "";
    }
  }
  if (buffer.length > 0) yield buffer;
}

async function* documentFragments(plan: ExportPlan): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  const { account, profile } = plan;
  const ref = (row: { postId: string; at: Date }) => ({ postId: row.postId, at: iso(row.at) });
  const other = (row: { handle: string; since: Date }) => ({ handle: row.handle, since: iso(row.since) });
  // The members in the order of the format (ExportFormat in the contracts); the order is part of the bytes.
  const members: [string, unknown][] = [
    ["format", "korbat-export-1"],
    ["exportedAt", iso(plan.exportedAt)],
    [
      "account",
      {
        id: account.account.id,
        email: account.account.email,
        createdAt: iso(account.account.createdAt),
        role: account.account.role,
        mfaEnabled: account.account.mfaEnabled,
        hasPassword: account.account.hasPassword,
        verified: account.account.verified,
        termsVersion: account.account.termsVersion,
        termsAcceptedAt: isoOrNull(account.account.termsAcceptedAt),
        // Inside the account, where the format places them; at most the cap of ten, so they are written with the account's other facts rather than paged.
        passkeys: account.passkeys.map((passkey) => ({ name: passkey.name, createdAt: iso(passkey.createdAt), lastUsedAt: isoOrNull(passkey.lastUsedAt), synced: passkey.synced, createdOn: passkey.createdOn })),
      },
    ],
    [
      "profile",
      {
        handle: profile.profile.handle,
        displayName: profile.profile.displayName,
        bio: profile.profile.bio,
        createdAt: iso(profile.profile.createdAt),
        handleHistory: [...profile.profile.handleHistory],
        // Last in the profile, where the format added it (2c); the member order is part of the bytes.
        showInExplore: profile.profile.showInExplore,
      },
    ],
    [
      "posts",
      new Paged(profile.posts, (post) => ({
        id: post.id,
        body: post.body,
        createdAt: iso(post.createdAt),
        replyToId: post.replyToId,
        quoteOfId: post.quoteOfId,
        state: post.state,
        deletedAt: isoOrNull(post.deletedAt),
        media: post.media.map((image) => ({ id: image.id, file: mediaEntry(image.id), altText: image.altText, width: image.width, height: image.height })),
      })),
    ],
    ["likes", new Paged(profile.likes, ref)],
    ["reposts", new Paged(profile.reposts, ref)],
    ["bookmarks", new Paged(profile.bookmarks, ref)],
    ["following", new Paged(profile.following, other)],
    ["blocks", new Paged(profile.blocks, other)],
    ["mutes", new Paged(profile.mutes, other)],
    [
      "sessions",
      inMemory(account.sessions, (session) => ({ id: session.id, createdAt: iso(session.createdAt), lastUsedAt: iso(session.lastUsedAt), current: session.id === plan.currentSession })),
    ],
    [
      "devices",
      // The platform column is text; sign-in only ever writes one of the contract's three values.
      inMemory(account.devices, (device) => ({ label: device.label, platform: device.platform as Platform, firstSeenAt: iso(device.firstSeenAt), lastSeenAt: iso(device.lastSeenAt) })),
    ],
    ["events", inMemory(account.events, (event) => ({ type: event.type, at: iso(event.at) }))],
    // Complete by now: the images were written before the JSON.
    ["missingMedia", inMemory(plan.missingMedia, (id) => id)],
    // Last, where the format added it (3c). Each entry is written member by member in the format's order, so the bytes
    // do not depend on how the moderation module builds its objects, and nothing beyond the format is ever written.
    ["moderation", moderationMember(plan.moderation)],
  ];

  yield "{\n";
  for (const [index, [key, value]] of members.entries()) {
    yield `${index === 0 ? "" : ",\n"}  ${JSON.stringify(key)}: `;
    if (value instanceof Paged) yield* listFragments(value);
    else yield indented(JSON.stringify(value, null, 2), "  ");
  }
  yield "\n}";
}

/** The moderation member with every entry's members in the order of the format (ExportFormat in the contracts). */
function moderationMember(moderation: ModerationExport): ModerationExport {
  return {
    decisions: moderation.decisions.map((decision) => ({
      id: decision.id,
      decidedOn: decision.decidedOn,
      postId: decision.postId,
      kind: decision.kind,
      outcome: decision.outcome,
      ground: decision.ground,
      ruleId: decision.ruleId,
      rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
      measures: decision.measures.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, noEffect: measure.noEffect })),
      reversals: decision.reversals.map((reversal) => ({ kind: reversal.kind, mediaId: reversal.mediaId })),
      facts: decision.facts,
      reason: decision.reason,
      legalReference: decision.legalReference,
      appeal: decision.appeal === null ? null : decision.appeal.state === "pending" ? { state: "pending", result: null } : { state: "answered", result: decision.appeal.result },
    })),
    reports: moderation.reports.map((report) => ({
      ref: report.ref,
      receivedAt: report.receivedAt,
      ground: report.ground,
      ruleId: report.ruleId,
      category: report.category,
      explanation: report.explanation,
      items: report.items.map((item) => ({ position: item.position, link: item.link, reexamines: item.reexamines, outcome: item.outcome, outcomeText: item.outcomeText, reexaminationOpen: item.reexaminationOpen })),
    })),
    // 3e (W.8): the strikes the account was given.
    strikes: moderation.strikes.map((strike) => ({ decisionId: strike.decisionId, postId: strike.postId, ruleId: strike.ruleId, givenAt: strike.givenAt, countsUntil: strike.countsUntil, overruledAt: strike.overruledAt })),
  };
}

/** A top-level member's array, as JSON.stringify writes it at that depth: "[]" when empty, else one element per line group. */
async function* listFragments<T>(list: Paged<T>): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  let first = true;
  for await (const page of list.pages) {
    for (const row of page) {
      yield `${first ? "[\n" : ",\n"}    ${indented(JSON.stringify(list.element(row), null, 2), "    ")}`;
      first = false;
    }
  }
  yield first ? "[]" : "\n  ]";
}

const indented = (json: string, pad: string): string => json.replaceAll("\n", `\n${pad}`);

/**
 * Writes the archive: every image as a stored entry, then export.json, then the central directory.
 * export.json comes last so that missingMedia can name every image whose file the checked open refused
 * or did not find when its turn came (the sweeper may be between the row and the file), or that was no
 * longer the owner's to export by then: the media module reads each image's row again as it opens the
 * file, and opens none for an image deleted with its post, erased or sealed since the list was read.
 * The order of entries means nothing to a reader.
 */
export async function writeExport(writer: ZipWriter, plan: ExportPlan): Promise<void> {
  for (const image of plan.images) {
    if (!(await writer.addFile(mediaEntry(image.id), image.open))) plan.missingMedia.push(image.id);
  }
  await writer.addJsonPieces("export.json", exportJson(plan));
  await writer.end();
}
```

### Replace `apps/api/src/cli/staff-cases.ts` (whole file)

```ts
/**
 * The staff command line's commands for moderation cases (3c design, section 7.13): link, unlink, limits, text-verify,
 * account-facts and access-request. staff.ts parses their arguments, reads their settings and opens their connections;
 * this file holds what each does, over the connections it is handed. Each sets the 10-second lock timeout in every
 * transaction it opens, writes its audit row in the transaction of its change and as that transaction's last statement
 * (the insert holds the chain's head until the commit), and says so when it changed nothing it was asked to.
 *
 * This file has no entry point of its own, so both bundles can include it (build.mjs says why that matters).
 */
import { and, eq, isNull, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { MEASURE_KINDS, snapshotDigest, textDigest, type SnapshotDigestInput } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { moderationLimits, profiles, staffPersonalAccounts, users, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../auth";
import { imageModerationStates } from "../media";
import { accessDraftForAccount, accessDraftForContacts, type AccountAccessDraft, type ContactsAccessDraft } from "../moderation";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../staff";

/** What a command reads and writes through: its own connection, or a transaction a test hands in. */
type Runner = Db | DbTx;

const rowsOf = async <T>(q: Runner, query: ReturnType<typeof sql>): Promise<T[]> => (await q.execute(query)) as unknown as T[];
const uuidArray = (ids: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;
const textArray = (values: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${values.join(",")}}`}::text[]`;

/** Runs `change` in a transaction that waits at most 10 seconds for a lock, as every staff command waits. */
function changing<T>(db: Runner, change: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  return db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    return change(tx);
  });
}

/** A handle as the operator types it, with or without its at sign, in the lower case the profiles hold. */
export const handleArg = (arg: string): string => arg.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- link and unlink

export type Changed = { ok: true; lines: string[] } | { ok: false; problem: string };

/**
 * Records, or with `remove` takes back, that a personal account is a staff member's own (the recusal check of 3c reads
 * the links; no API role can). As the migrator, in one transaction: the staff account's row and the personal account's
 * are locked FOR SHARE, so neither can be promoted, demoted or taken down under the check; a link is recorded only for
 * a live staff account and a live account that is not staff. The audit row names the staff account and nothing of the
 * link, which must not spread.
 */
export async function changeLink(migrateDb: Runner, staffEmail: string, personalHandle: string, remove: boolean): Promise<Changed> {
  const handle = handleArg(personalHandle);
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const [staff] = await tx
      .select({ id: users.id, role: users.role })
      .from(users)
      .where(and(sql`lower(${users.email}) = lower(${staffEmail})`, isNull(users.deletedAt)))
      .limit(1)
      .for("share");
    if (!staff) return { ok: false, problem: `no live account for ${staffEmail}` };
    const [profile] = await tx.select({ id: profiles.id }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    if (remove) {
      const gone = await tx.delete(staffPersonalAccounts).where(and(eq(staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId, staff.id), eq(staffPersonalAccounts.personalUserId, profile.id))).returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
      if (gone.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
      await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_removed", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
      return { ok: true, lines: [`unlink: @${handle} is no longer linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
    }
    if (staff.role === "user") return { ok: false, problem: `${staffEmail} is not staff (its role is user)` };
    const [personal] = await tx.select({ id: users.id, role: users.role, deletedAt: users.deletedAt }).from(users).where(eq(users.id, profile.id)).limit(1).for("share");
    if (!personal || personal.deletedAt !== null) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not a live account` };
    if (personal.id === staff.id) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is the staff account itself, which is always a party where it is one` };
    if (personal.role !== "user") return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is a staff account (its role is ${personal.role}); only a personal account is linked` };
    const added = await tx.insert(staffPersonalAccounts).values({ staffUserId: staff.id, personalUserId: personal.id }).onConflictDoNothing().returning({ id: staffPersonalAccounts.staffUserId });
    if (added.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is already linked to ${staffEmail}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "staff_link_added", targetType: "user", targetId: staff.id, requestId: null, metadata: {} });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`link: @${handle} is linked to ${staffEmail}. Update your own record of this staff member's linked handles.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- limits

/** The five limits on staff, in the order the command takes them. */
export interface StaffLimits {
  decisionsPerHour: number;
  decisionsPerDay: number;
  caseOpensPerDay: number;
  findingsPerDay: number;
  revealsPerDay: number;
}

const describeLimits = (l: StaffLimits) => `${l.decisionsPerHour} decisions an hour, ${l.decisionsPerDay} decisions a day, ${l.caseOpensPerDay} case opens a day, ${l.findingsPerDay} findings a day, ${l.revealsPerDay} reveals a day`;

/**
 * Sets the limits' one row, as the migrator: an upsert, so it also works on a database whose row is missing, that
 * changes the row only when one of the five numbers differs. Its audit row carries the five numbers and is written only
 * when the row was inserted or changed.
 */
export async function setLimits(migrateDb: Runner, limits: StaffLimits): Promise<Changed> {
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const l = moderationLimits;
    const written = await tx
      .insert(l)
      .values({ id: 1, ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: l.id,
        set: { ...limits, updatedAt: sql`now()` },
        setWhere: sql`(${l.decisionsPerHour}, ${l.decisionsPerDay}, ${l.caseOpensPerDay}, ${l.findingsPerDay}, ${l.revealsPerDay}) is distinct from
                      (${limits.decisionsPerHour}::int, ${limits.decisionsPerDay}::int, ${limits.caseOpensPerDay}::int, ${limits.findingsPerDay}::int, ${limits.revealsPerDay}::int)`,
      })
      .returning({ id: l.id });
    if (written.length === 0) return { ok: false, problem: `the limits already are ${describeLimits(limits)}; nothing changed` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "moderation_limits_set", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { ...limits } });
    return { ok: true, lines: [`limits: set to ${describeLimits(limits)}. Keep these numbers in your own records: a restore brings back the ones of its backup.`] };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- account-facts

/**
 * Prints an account's handle, address and creation time for the runbook's Art. 18 step, as the migrator, and records
 * that it did. Only for the subject of the named case: the account the case is about, or the author of its post.
 */
export async function accountFacts(migrateDb: Runner, handleGiven: string, caseId: string): Promise<Changed> {
  const handle = handleArg(handleGiven);
  return changing(migrateDb, async (tx): Promise<Changed> => {
    const [profile] = await tx.select({ id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    const [subject] = await rowsOf<{ subject: string | null }>(
      tx,
      sql`select case when c.target_type = 'account' then c.target_id else (select p.author_id from posts p where p.id = c.target_id) end as subject from cases c where c.id = ${caseId}::uuid`,
    );
    if (!subject) return { ok: false, problem: `no case has the id ${caseId}` };
    if (subject.subject !== profile.id) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} is not the subject of case ${caseId}; nothing was read` };
    const [account] = await tx.select({ email: users.email, createdAt: users.createdAt }).from(users).where(eq(users.id, profile.id)).limit(1);
    if (!account) return { ok: false, problem: `@${handle} has no account row` };
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "account_facts_read", targetType: "user", targetId: profile.id, requestId: null, metadata: { caseId } });
    return {
      ok: true,
      lines: [
        `handle: @${profile.handle}`,
        `email: ${account.email}`,
        `account created: ${account.createdAt.toISOString()}`,
        "Keep this off the server, with your R2 or Art. 18 record of the case, and destroy it after an answer without a seal (README, runbook).",
      ],
    };
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- access-request

/**
 * Drafts the moderation part of an answer to a GDPR access request and records that it did, on the API role: for a
 * handle the account's cases and its own reports, for an address the notices of the contacts the auth module found for
 * it (`contactsOf`, which alone can read a contact). The audit row carries counts only, and names the account for a
 * handle and nobody for an address.
 */
export async function accessRequest(
  apiDb: Runner,
  appOrigin: string,
  who: { handle: string } | { email: string },
  contactsOf: (email: string) => Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]>,
): Promise<{ ok: true; draft: AccountAccessDraft | ContactsAccessDraft } | { ok: false; problem: string }> {
  if ("handle" in who) {
    const handle = handleArg(who.handle);
    const [profile] = await apiDb.select({ id: profiles.id, handle: profiles.handle }).from(profiles).where(eq(profiles.handle, handle)).limit(1);
    if (!profile) return { ok: false, problem: `no account has the handle @${handle}` };
    const draft = await accessDraftForAccount(apiDb, appOrigin, profile);
    await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: "user", targetId: profile.id, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: draft.cases.length, contacts: 0 } }));
    return { ok: true, draft };
  }
  const contacts = await contactsOf(who.email);
  const draft = await accessDraftForContacts(apiDb, appOrigin, contacts);
  await changing(apiDb, (tx) => appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "access_request_drafted", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { cases: 0, contacts: contacts.length } }));
  return { ok: true, draft };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- text-verify

/** One thing text-verify found wrong, and what it is about: an audit row by its place, or a decision, a post, an image or a seal by its id. */
export interface TextProblem {
  about: "audit" | "decision" | "post" | "image" | "seal";
  id: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface TextReport {
  ok: boolean;
  /** The confirmed rows read, and the decisions, posts, images and seals in force checked. */
  auditRows: number;
  decisions: number;
  posts: number;
  images: number;
  seals: number;
  /** The first problems, in the order found. */
  problems: TextProblem[];
  problemCount: number;
}

/** How many rows text-verify reads at a time. */
export const TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
const PAGE = TEXT_VERIFY_PAGE_SIZE;

/** The actions whose params name saved texts and snapshots by their digests. */
const CONFIRMED_ACTIONS = ["case_decided", "appeals_reviewed", "identity_revealed"];
/** The params members that name a saved text. */
const TEXT_MEMBERS = ["factsDigest", "reasonDigest", "legalReferenceDigest"];

interface NamingRow {
  place: number;
  action: string;
  actorId: string;
  targetType: string | null;
  targetId: string | null;
  params: Record<string, unknown>;
}

const isObject = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> => typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
/** An action as the key signed it and as the ledger holds it: its kind, its image, and (3e) the days and whether it was announced. */
const actionKey = (action: { kind: unknown; mediaId: unknown; days?: unknown; announced?: unknown }) =>
  [action.kind, action.mediaId, action.days, action.announced].map((part) => (part === null || part === undefined ? "" : String(part))).join(":");

/**
 * text-verify (3c design, section 7.13), read-only on the API's role. audit-verify proves that the record was not
 * rewritten; this proves that what the record's confirmed rows name is still what korbat holds, and that what posts and
 * images show is what the record says. Three checks, each in this command's own code:
 *
 *   1. Every digest in the params of a confirmed row (a decision, a review, a reveal) names a saved text that korbat
 *      still holds and that recomputes to it, an erased text, a snapshot still held that recomputes to it, or an erased
 *      snapshot. A text or a snapshot that is missing was removed around the erasures, which keep each row and its digest.
 *   2. Every decision is named by exactly one such row, written by the deciding account on the decision's case (for a
 *      review, on the reviewed decision), whose params equal the decision's own columns and whose actions equal its
 *      ledger rows as a set (3e: with each row's days and whether it was announced; the marks the decision set equal the
 *      params' `unfounded`, and a withdrawal for another measure its `replaced`). A row that names a decision korbat does
 *      not hold is reported too.
 *   3. Every post's level and every image's state equal what the ledger of measures gives, worked out here from the
 *      ledger's rows, the cases' closures, the items and the erasure marks, as the database's own writer derives them;
 *      and every post a seal in force lists still has the number of image rows the seal recorded.
 *
 * So a change made around the triggers, by the migrator or by hand, is reported: a decision or a measure altered or
 * removed, a level or a state set, a sealed image row destroyed or lost in a restore. `keep` bounds the problems kept.
 */
export async function textVerify(q: Runner, keep = 100): Promise<TextReport> {
  const problems: TextProblem[] = [];
  let problemCount = 0;
  const problem = (about: TextProblem["about"], id: string, message: string) => {
    problemCount++;
    if (problems.length < keep) problems.push({ about, id, message });
  };

  // ---- 1. the confirmed rows and what their digests name
  const naming = new Map<string, NamingRow[]>();
  let auditRows = 0;
  for (let after = 0; ; ) {
    const page = await rowsOf<{ id: number; place: number; action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; target_id: string | null; metadata: unknown }>(
      q,
      sql`select id::int as id, chain_seq::int as place, action, actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata from audit_log
           where action = any(${textArray(CONFIRMED_ACTIONS)}) and id > ${after} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    const wanted: { place: number; member: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    const wantedSnapshots: { place: number; id: string; digest: string }[] = [];
    for (const row of page) {
      auditRows++;
      const metadata = isObject(row.metadata) ? row.metadata : {};
      const params = isObject(metadata.params) ? metadata.params : null;
      if (params === null) {
        problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, carries no params`);
        continue;
      }
      for (const member of TEXT_MEMBERS) if (typeof params[member] === "string") wanted.push({ place: row.place, member, digest: params[member] });
      if (typeof params.snapshotId === "string" && typeof params.snapshotDigest === "string") wantedSnapshots.push({ place: row.place, id: params.snapshotId, digest: params.snapshotDigest });
      if (row.action !== "identity_revealed") {
        const decisionId = typeof metadata.decisionId === "string" ? metadata.decisionId : null;
        if (decisionId === null) problem("audit", String(row.place), `its action, ${row.action}, names no decision`);
        else naming.set(decisionId, [...(naming.get(decisionId) ?? []), { place: row.place, action: row.action, actorId: row.actor_id, targetType: row.target_type, targetId: row.target_id, params }]);
      }
    }
    if (wanted.length > 0) {
      const texts = await rowsOf<{ digest: string; text: string | null; salt: string | null }>(q, sql`select digest, text, salt from staff_texts where digest = any(${textArray([...new Set(wanted.map((w) => w.digest))])})`);
      const byDigest = new Map(texts.map((t) => [t.digest, t]));
      for (const w of wanted) {
        const held = byDigest.get(w.digest);
        if (!held) problem("audit", String(w.place), `its ${w.member} names no saved text`);
        // An erased text keeps its row and its digest: that is retention at work, and nothing to report.
        else if (held.text !== null && (held.salt === null || (await textDigest(held.salt, held.text).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest)) problem("audit", String(w.place), `the text its ${w.member} names no longer recomputes to that digest`);
      }
    }
    if (wantedSnapshots.length > 0) {
      const found = await rowsOf<Record<string, unknown> & { id: string; digest: string; erased: boolean }>(
        q,
        sql`select id, digest, erased_at is not null as erased, salt, target_type::text as target_type, target_id,
                   to_char(taken_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as taken_at, author_handle, post_state::text as post_state,
                   to_char(post_created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as post_created_at, reply_to_id, quote_of_id, body, media, display_name, bio, handle
              from evidence_snapshots where id = any(${uuidArray([...new Set(wantedSnapshots.map((w) => w.id))])})`,
      );
      const byId = new Map(found.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      for (const w of wantedSnapshots) {
        const s = byId.get(w.id);
        if (!s) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotId names no snapshot");
        else if (s.digest !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "its snapshotDigest is not the digest of the snapshot it names");
        else if (!s.erased) {
          const input = { salt: s.salt, targetType: s.target_type, targetId: s.target_id, takenAt: s.taken_at, authorHandle: s.author_handle, postState: s.post_state, postCreatedAt: s.post_created_at, replyToId: s.reply_to_id, quoteOfId: s.quote_of_id, body: s.body, media: s.media, displayName: s.display_name, bio: s.bio, handle: s.handle } as unknown as SnapshotDigestInput;
          if ((await snapshotDigest(input).catch(() => null)) !== w.digest) problem("audit", String(w.place), "the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest");
        }
      }
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  // ---- 2. every decision against the one row that names it
  let decisions = 0;
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; d: Record<string, unknown>; actions: { kind: string; mediaId: string | null; days: number | null; announced: boolean | null }[]; marks: string[]; replaced: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select d.id, to_jsonb(d) as d,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', a.kind, 'mediaId', a.media_id, 'days', a.days, 'announced', a.announced)) from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::jsonb) as actions,
                 coalesce((select jsonb_agg(m.item_id) from unfounded_marks m where m.decision_id = d.id), '[]'::jsonb) as marks,
                 exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.replaced) as replaced
            from decisions d where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`d.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by d.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const { id, d, actions, marks, replaced } of page) {
      decisions++;
      seen.add(id);
      const named = naming.get(id) ?? [];
      if (named.length !== 1) {
        problem("decision", id, named.length === 0 ? "no confirmed row of the audit log names it" : `${named.length} rows of the audit log name it (places ${named.map((row) => row.place).join(", ")})`);
        continue;
      }
      const row = named[0]!;
      const review = d.kind === "review";
      const expected: Record<string, unknown> = review
        ? { stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, appealId: d.appeal_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest }
        : {
            kind: d.kind, stateVersion: d.seen_state_version, throughSeq: d.through_seq, reviewsDecisionId: d.reviews_decision_id, snapshotId: d.snapshot_id, snapshotDigest: d.snapshot_digest, outcome: d.outcome,
            ground: d.ground, ruleId: d.rule_id, rulesVersion: d.rules_version, redressVersion: d.redress_version, category: d.category, categoryKeyword: d.category_keyword,
            factsDigest: d.facts_digest, reasonDigest: d.reason_digest, legalReferenceDigest: d.legal_reference_digest,
          };
      const differing: string[] = [];
      if (row.actorId !== d.decided_by) differing.push("actor");
      if (row.action !== (review ? "appeals_reviewed" : "case_decided") || row.targetType !== (review ? "decision" : "case") || row.targetId !== (review ? d.reviews_decision_id : d.case_id)) differing.push("target");
      for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(expected), ...Object.keys(row.params)])) {
        if (key === "actions" || key === "unfounded" || key === "replaced") continue;
        if ((expected[key] ?? null) !== (row.params[key] ?? null)) differing.push(key);
        if (!(key in expected)) differing.push(key);
      }
      // 3e: the marks the decision set, as the sorted item ids its params signed, and whether it withdrew a suspension for
      // another measure; a review signs neither, and a row signed before 3e lacks both, which reads as none and false.
      if (!review) {
        const signed = row.params.unfounded === undefined ? "" : Array.isArray(row.params.unfounded) ? row.params.unfounded.map(String).sort().join("|") : null;
        if (signed !== [...marks].sort().join("|")) differing.push("unfounded");
        if ((row.params.replaced ?? false) !== replaced) differing.push("replaced");
      }
      const recorded = Array.isArray(row.params.actions) ? row.params.actions.filter(isObject).map((a) => actionKey({ kind: a.kind, mediaId: a.mediaId, days: a.days, announced: a.announced })) : null;
      if (recorded === null || [...recorded].sort().join("|") !== actions.map(actionKey).sort().join("|")) differing.push("actions");
      if (differing.length > 0) problem("decision", id, `it differs from the audit row at place ${row.place} that names it: ${[...new Set(differing)].sort().join(", ")}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const [decisionId, named] of naming) if (!seen.has(decisionId)) problem("decision", decisionId, `the audit row at place ${named[0]!.place} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`);

  // ---- 3. levels and states, worked out from the ledger
  const measures = MEASURE_KINDS as readonly string[];
  const removedPosts = new Set<string>();
  const withheldPosts = new Set<string>();
  const removedImages = new Set<string>();
  const withheldImages = new Set<string>();
  const sealsInForce = new Set<string>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; kind: string; post_id: string | null; media_id: string | null; decision_kind: string; case_open: boolean; suspect_open: boolean; reversed: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select a.id, a.kind::text as kind, a.post_id, a.media_id, d.kind::text as decision_kind, c.closed_at is null as case_open,
                 exists (select 1 from intake_items i where i.case_id = d.case_id and i.suspect and i.answered_by is null and i.created_at <= d.decided_at) as suspect_open,
                 exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) as reversed
            from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
           where a.kind::text = any(${textArray(measures)}) and ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`a.id > ${after}::uuid`} order by a.id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const m of page) {
      // In force: no row reverses it, and a measure taken while deciding lasts while its case is open, a seal taken while
      // deciding while its case holds an unanswered suspect item that arrived no later than it.
      const inForce = !m.reversed && (m.decision_kind !== "interim" || (m.kind === "seal_media" ? m.suspect_open : m.case_open));
      if (!inForce) continue;
      if (m.kind === "remove" && m.post_id) removedPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold" && m.post_id) withheldPosts.add(m.post_id);
      else if (m.kind === "remove_media" && m.media_id) removedImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "withhold_media" && m.media_id) withheldImages.add(m.media_id);
      else if (m.kind === "seal_media") sealsInForce.add(m.id);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  // The posts each seal in force lists, with the image rows it recorded for each.
  const listed: { actionId: string; postId: string; images: number }[] = [];
  const sealedPosts = new Set<string>();
  if (sealsInForce.size > 0) {
    const found = await rowsOf<{ action_id: string; post_id: string; images: number }>(q, sql`select action_id, post_id, images::int as images from seal_posts where action_id = any(${uuidArray([...sealsInForce])}) order by action_id, post_id`);
    for (const row of found) {
      listed.push({ actionId: row.action_id, postId: row.post_id, images: row.images });
      sealedPosts.add(row.post_id);
    }
  }

  let posts = 0;
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page: { id: string; state: string; level: string; erased: boolean }[] = await rowsOf(
      q,
      sql`select id, state::text as state, moderation_level::text as level, erased_at is not null as erased from posts where ${after === null ? sql`true` : sql`id > ${after}::uuid`} order by id limit ${PAGE}`,
    );
    for (const post of page) {
      posts++;
      const level = post.erased || removedPosts.has(post.id) ? "removed" : withheldPosts.has(post.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (post.level !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its level is stored as ${post.level}, and the ledger of measures gives ${level}`);
      // The state mirrors the level unless the author deleted the post, which is terminal.
      else if (post.state !== "deleted_by_author" && post.state !== level) problem("post", post.id, `its state is stored as ${post.state}, and its level is ${level}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }

  let images = 0;
  const imagesOn = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let after: string | null = null; ; ) {
    const page = await imageModerationStates(q as Db, after, PAGE);
    for (const image of page) {
      images++;
      if (sealedPosts.has(image.postId)) imagesOn.set(image.postId, (imagesOn.get(image.postId) ?? 0) + 1);
      const state = sealedPosts.has(image.postId) ? "sealed" : image.erasedAt !== null || removedImages.has(image.id) ? "removed" : withheldImages.has(image.id) ? "withheld" : "visible";
      if (image.moderationState !== state) problem("image", image.id, `its state is stored as ${image.moderationState}, and the ledger of measures gives ${state}`);
    }
    if (page.length < PAGE) break;
    after = page[page.length - 1]!.id;
  }
  for (const row of listed) {
    const now = imagesOn.get(row.postId) ?? 0;
    if (now !== row.images) problem("seal", row.actionId, `it lists post ${row.postId} with ${row.images} image ${row.images === 1 ? "row" : "rows"}, and the post has ${now} now`);
  }

  return { ok: problemCount === 0, auditRows, decisions, posts, images, seals: sealsInForce.size, problems, problemCount };
}

/** text-verify on the command line's own connection: one REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction, so every check reads one state of the database. */
export function textVerifyOn(apiDb: Db): Promise<TextReport> {
  return apiDb.transaction(
    async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      return textVerify(tx);
    },
    { isolationLevel: "repeatable read", accessMode: "read only" },
  );
}

/** How text-verify reports: what holds, or the first problems. */
export function describeTextReport(report: TextReport): string[] {
  const counted = `${report.auditRows} confirmed rows, ${report.decisions} decisions, ${report.posts} posts, ${report.images} images and ${report.seals} seals in force`;
  if (report.ok) return [`text-verify: what the record names is what korbat holds: ${counted}`];
  const shown = report.problems.slice(0, 20);
  const lines = [`text-verify: FAILED, ${report.problemCount} ${report.problemCount === 1 ? "problem" : "problems"} in ${counted}; the first:`];
  for (const p of shown) lines.push(`  ${p.about === "audit" ? "place" : p.about} ${p.id}: ${p.message}`);
  if (report.problemCount > shown.length) lines.push(`  and ${report.problemCount - shown.length} more`);
  return lines;
}
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE, AppealsReviewedParams, DAILY_LIMITS, type AppealRequest, type AppealRow, type AppealsPage, type DecisionView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_VERSION } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, StaffStepUpConfirmed } from "../auth";
import { isDeadlock, isLockNotAvailable } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import { authorDecisionView, decodeListCursor, encodeListCursor } from "./author";
import { reviewerOf } from "./cases";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { recordConfirmed, refuseUnopened, type DecideOptions, type DecideOutcome } from "./decide";
import { countOrRefuse, saltedStatement } from "./intake";
import { insertAction, insertAppeal, insertReview, pendingAppeals, raisedMessage, reviewedDecision, violatedUniqueConstraint } from "./repo";

/**
 * Appeals and their reviews (3c design, sections 6.3 and 7.7). An appeal has one shape: the author's appeal of a final
 * decision that restricts them, one for each such decision, while any of its measures is in force and within six
 * calendar months of being told. A review answers that one appeal: it keeps the decision or lifts measures of it, and
 * never restricts. The database decides whether an appeal is open and who may review it; this file inserts the rows.
 */

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60_000;

/**
 * The longest an appeal waits for a lock. Its trigger takes the case's row for the length of its own transaction and
 * waits for whoever holds the case: a decision that is being recorded, which for a seal over thousands of images is
 * seconds, or an erasure.
 */
const APPEAL_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

/** How often the appeal's transaction is run again after a deadlock or a lock timeout: in each nothing was written. */
const APPEAL_RETRIES = 2;

/**
 * POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/appeal: the author's appeal of a decision about their post or their account. In
 * this order:
 *   1. the day's limit, five for an account, counted before anything is read, so that whatever the answer the request
 *      was counted;
 *   2. one transaction that inserts the appeal's row. Its trigger decides, under a lock on the decision's case, whether
 *      an appeal of this decision is open now for this account (appeal_not_open: the decision is not a final
 *      restriction, is someone else's, is past its window, or nothing of it is in force), and the unique index refuses
 *      a second appeal (appeal_exists). The statement is optional and free of form; the server makes its salt and
 *      digest. A deadlock or a lock timeout runs the transaction again, and when the last run fails the same way the
 *      answer is service_unavailable;
 *   3. the answer: the decision as its author now reads it, with the appeal waiting. A decision that is not the
 *      viewer's, or of which they were not told, never opened by its id and does not now: not_found.
 * A request that failed through no fault of its sender gives its hit on the day's limit back.
 */
export async function fileAppeal(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "limits" | "log">, viewer: string, decisionId: string, request: AppealRequest): Promise<DecisionView> {
  const key = `appeal:day:account:${viewer}`;
  await countOrRefuse(deps, key, DAY_MS, DAILY_LIMITS.appeals);
  const statement = await saltedStatement(request.statement);
  try {
    for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
      try {
        await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
          await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', ${`${APPEAL_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS}ms`}::text, true)`);
          await insertAppeal(tx, { decisionId, appellantId: viewer, statement });
        });
        break;
      } catch (err) {
        const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
        if (refusal !== null && isModerationErrorCode(refusal)) throw new ModerationError(refusal);
        if (violatedUniqueConstraint(err) === "appeals_once") throw new ModerationError("appeal_exists");
        if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isLockNotAvailable(err)) throw err;
        if (attempt >= APPEAL_RETRIES) throw new ModerationError("service_unavailable", 503, undefined, 30);
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // A refusal that is the sender's own (not open, appealed already) stays counted; anything else was not their doing.
    if (!(err instanceof ModerationError) || err.code === "service_unavailable") {
      await deps.limits.release(key).catch((failure: unknown) => deps.log.warn({ err: failure }, "appeal: a limit hit of a request that could not be saved could not be given back"));
    }
    throw err;
  }
  return authorDecisionView(deps, viewer, decisionId);
}

/**
 * GET /api/staff/appeals: the pending appeals, newest first, 50 a page, each marked whether the reading person may
 * review it (3c design, section 7.7). No row carries a statement: the reviewer reads it on the case page, whose read is
 * logged and counted.
 */
export async function appealsList(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, session: ActiveStaffSession, cursor?: string): Promise<AppealsPage> {
  const after = cursor === undefined ? null : decodeListCursor(cursor);
  const found = await pendingAppeals(deps.apiDb, reviewerOf(session), after, APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE + 1);
  const page = found.slice(0, APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE);
  const last = page.at(-1);
  return {
    appeals: page.map(
      (row): AppealRow => ({
        id: row.id,
        caseId: row.caseId,
        decisionId: row.decisionId,
        filedAt: row.filedAt,
        decidedAt: row.decidedAt,
        deadline: row.deadline,
        ruleId: row.ruleId as AppealRow["ruleId"],
        legal: row.legal,
        actions: row.actions,
        reviewer: row.reviewer,
        needsAdmin: row.needsAdmin,
        mayReview: row.mayReview,
      }),
    ),
    // One row more than the page was read: only then is there a next page.
    nextCursor: found.length > APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE && last ? encodeListCursor({ at: last.sortAt, id: last.id }) : null,
  };
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review, once its step-up verified (3c design, section 7.7): records the answer to
 * the author's one appeal of the decision, as a decision of kind review, in the one transaction every confirmed decision
 * runs (recordConfirmed), with its audit row as appeals_reviewed on the reviewed decision.
 *
 * Before the transaction: the redress texts are those the API serves now (the rulebook version is the reviewed
 * decision's, which the database holds the review to), and the appeal the reviewer's key confirmed is the decision's
 * pending appeal: when it is not, the appeal was answered since the console read the case, and the answer is
 * case_changed with nothing written. The database forces and compares the appeal again under the case's lock, and at
 * commit holds the audit row's params to the stored review, so a review answers exactly the appeal that was confirmed.
 * It refuses a reviewer who decided anything in the case or opened a finding in it (reviewer_conflict), a party
 * (staff_recused), and a moderator where the review needs an admin (admin_required).
 *
 * After the commit the transaction's own last step does what it does for every decision: the statement's mail, the
 * count of the person's decisions, and the mail to every staff account when the review lifted a seal.
 */
export async function review(deps: ModerationDeps, session: ActiveStaffSession, confirmed: StaffStepUpConfirmed, ctx: { requestId: string }, options: DecideOptions = {}): Promise<DecideOutcome> {
  // A confirmation of anything else never reviews an appeal: that would be a wiring fault, not a refusal.
  if (confirmed.action !== "appeals_reviewed" || confirmed.target.type !== "decision" || confirmed.keyId !== session.keyId) {
    throw new Error("a review needs a step-up that confirmed it");
  }
  const params = AppealsReviewedParams.parse(confirmed.params);
  if (params.redressVersion !== REDRESS_VERSION) throw new ModerationError("invalid_decision");
  // The routes' one list of the kinds they accept (3e design, section 7.1 item 2).
  refuseUnopened(params, options);

  const reviewsDecisionId = confirmed.target.id;
  const reviewed = await reviewedDecision(deps.apiDb, reviewsDecisionId);
  if (!reviewed) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  if (reviewed.pendingAppealId !== params.appealId) throw new ModerationError("case_changed");
  // As for a decision: a case's target and a post's author never change, so the subject is read before the transaction.
  const subject = reviewed.target.type === "account" ? reviewed.target.id : await deps.social.postAuthor(reviewed.target.id);

  return recordConfirmed(deps, session, confirmed, ctx, subject, async (tx, decisionId) => {
    await insertReview(tx, { id: decisionId, caseId: reviewed.caseId, reviewsDecisionId, decidedBy: session.userId, params });
    for (const action of params.actions) await insertAction(tx, decisionId, action);
  });
}

/** The case a reviewed decision belongs to, for the answer to a review that has just committed. */
export async function reviewedCase(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, decisionId: string): Promise<string> {
  const reviewed = await reviewedDecision(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!reviewed) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  return reviewed.caseId;
}
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ActionKind, DecisionStrike, PostModeration, RuleId } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { iso, rows, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * The queries the author's surfaces are built from (3c design, sections 5, 7.6 and 11): the list of decisions about an
 * account, one decision's gate with the content it was made on and where its appeal stands, and the chip's facts on the
 * author's own posts. They read decisions, their ledger, cases, snapshots, the author's own appeals and posts, and the
 * database's two answers about who may review an appeal, and nothing else: no query here can reach who
 * reported, what a report said or how many there were, and a test refuses the names of those tables in this file.
 */

/** A UTC day of a timestamptz expression. The expression is written here, never input. */
const day = (expression: string) => sql.raw(`to_char(${expression} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')`);

const MEASURES = sql`('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')`;

/**
 * The end of the appeal's window of decision `d`, while an appeal can still be filed: a final decision that restricts,
 * with at least one of its measures in force, no appeal filed, and its deadline not yet reached on the database's clock.
 * Null otherwise: for a decision taken while deciding, one that restricts nothing, a review, a correction, a restriction
 * reversed in full, and once the author appealed or the window closed.
 */
const appealUntil = sql`case when d.kind = 'final' and d.outcome = 'restricted'
                  and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = d.id)
                  and not exists (select 1 from appeals ap where ap.decision_id = d.id)
                  and clock_timestamp() < public.appeal_deadline(d.informed_at)
             then ${iso("public.appeal_deadline(d.informed_at)")} end`;

/**
 * The UTC day on which the last measure of decision `d` was lifted, for a final decision that restricted and of which
 * nothing is in force any more. Null while any of its measures stands, and for every other decision: a decision taken
 * while deciding ends with its case, without a reversal.
 */
const reversedOn = sql`case when d.kind = 'final' and d.outcome = 'restricted'
                  and exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind in ${MEASURES})
                  and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind in ${MEASURES}
                                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id))
             then (select ${day("max(r.created_at)")} from decision_actions a join decision_actions r on r.reverses_action_id = a.id where a.decision_id = d.id) end`;

/**
 * The strike decision `d` gave (3e design, section 10.2), read fresh: its end of counting, when it was overruled, and
 * whether it counts now, ran out or was overruled; all null for a decision without one.
 */
const strikeColumns = sql`(select ${iso("a.ends_at")} from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike') as strike_until,
               (select ${iso("r.created_at")} from decision_actions a join decision_actions r on r.reverses_action_id = a.id
                 where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike') as strike_overruled_at,
               (select case when exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) then 'overruled'
                            when a.ends_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'expired' else 'counts' end
                  from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike') as strike_state`;

/**
 * The cases about an account: the account's own, and those about the posts it wrote. A post keeps its author through its
 * deletion and the account's purge, so a decision stays with the account it was about.
 */
const casesAbout = (accountId: string) => sql`(
    select c.id, c.target_type, c.target_id from cases c where c.target_type = 'account' and c.target_id = ${accountId}::uuid
    union all
    select c.id, c.target_type, c.target_id from cases c join posts p on p.id = c.target_id where c.target_type = 'post' and p.author_id = ${accountId}::uuid
  )`;

/** One decision as the author's list shows it. */
export interface AuthorDecisionRow {
  id: string;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "review" | "correction";
  outcome: string;
  decidedOn: string;
  /** The decision's time to the microsecond, as text: what the next page starts after. */
  sortAt: string;
  post: { id: string; createdAt: string } | null;
  actions: ActionKind[];
  endedInterim: boolean;
  ruleId: string | null;
  legal: boolean;
  appealUntil: string | null;
  reversedOn: string | null;
  /** Where the author's appeal of the decision stands: pending, or its result; null when they filed none. */
  appeal: "pending" | "kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed" | null;
  /** The strike the decision gave: until when it counts and when it was overruled; null for a decision without one. */
  strike: { countsUntil: string; overruledAt: string | null } | null;
}

/**
 * The decisions about this account that its author was told of (`author_mail` is not `none`), newest first, after the
 * cursor when one is given. A decision the author was not told of is in no page.
 */
export async function authorDecisions(q: Runner, accountId: string, after: { at: string; id: string } | null, limit: number): Promise<AuthorDecisionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.kind, d.outcome, ${day("d.decided_at")} as decided_on,
               to_char(d.decided_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as sort_at,
               c.target_type, c.target_id,
               (select ${iso("p.created_at")} from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id) as post_created_at,
               coalesce((select array_agg(a.kind::text order by a.kind, a.media_id) from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id), '{}') as actions,
               d.ended_interim, d.rule_id, d.ground is not distinct from 'illegal' as legal,
               ${appealUntil} as appeal_until, ${reversedOn} as reversed_on,
               (select coalesce(ap.result::text, 'pending') from appeals ap where ap.decision_id = d.id) as appeal,
               ${strikeColumns}
          from ${casesAbout(accountId)} c join decisions d on d.case_id = c.id
         where d.author_mail <> 'none'
           ${after === null ? sql`` : sql`and (d.decided_at, d.id) < (${after.at}::timestamptz, ${after.id}::uuid)`}
         order by d.decided_at desc, d.id desc limit ${limit}::int`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id as string,
    kind: row.kind as AuthorDecisionRow["kind"],
    outcome: row.outcome as string,
    decidedOn: row.decided_on as string,
    sortAt: row.sort_at as string,
    post: row.target_type === "post" && row.post_created_at !== null ? { id: row.target_id as string, createdAt: row.post_created_at as string } : null,
    actions: row.actions as ActionKind[],
    endedInterim: row.ended_interim as boolean,
    ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null,
    legal: row.legal as boolean,
    appealUntil: row.appeal_until as string | null,
    reversedOn: row.reversed_on as string | null,
    appeal: row.appeal as AuthorDecisionRow["appeal"],
    strike: row.strike_until === null ? null : { countsUntil: row.strike_until as string, overruledAt: row.strike_overruled_at as string | null },
  }));
}

/**
 * The author's appeal of a decision. While it is pending: whether anyone at korbat may review it now, as the database
 * answers it in one word that names nobody, and whether its review is an admin's. Once answered: its result, the UTC day
 * and the decision that answered it.
 */
export interface AuthorAppealFacts {
  filedAt: string;
  reviewer: "available" | "none_single_staff" | "none_eligible" | null;
  needsAdmin: boolean;
  result: "kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed" | null;
  answeredOn: string | null;
  answeredBy: string | null;
}

/** What the author's view of one decision adds to its statement: where its appeal stands, and its snapshot with what decides whether and how it is shown. */
export interface AuthorDecisionFacts {
  targetType: "post" | "account";
  targetId: string;
  appealUntil: string | null;
  reversedOn: string | null;
  /** Null when the author filed no appeal of this decision. */
  appeal: AuthorAppealFacts | null;
  /** The database's one predicate by which a snapshot's content is withheld wherever it would be shown. */
  withheld: boolean;
  erased: boolean;
  /** The UTC day the snapshot was erased; null while it is kept. */
  erasedOn: string | null;
  /** A decision about the same post or account carries an R4 redaction. */
  redacted: boolean;
  body: string | null;
  images: { id: string; alt: string | null; width: number; height: number }[];
  handle: string;
  displayName: string | null;
  bio: string | null;
  /** For a decision about a post: whether its author deleted it, whether its content was erased, and whether a seal in force lists it. */
  postDeleted: boolean;
  postErased: boolean;
  sealed: boolean;
  /** The strike the decision gave, read fresh: until when it counts, whether it still does, and when it was overruled. */
  strike: DecisionStrike | null;
}

/**
 * One decision for the account it is about, or null: when no decision has the id, when it is about someone else, and when
 * its author was not told of it, so that no such decision opens by its id. A post's images are sealed exactly while a
 * seal in force lists the post, which is how the database derives their state too; this module never reads an image row.
 */
export async function authorDecision(q: Runner, accountId: string, decisionId: string): Promise<AuthorDecisionFacts | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select c.target_type, c.target_id, ${appealUntil} as appeal_until, ${reversedOn} as reversed_on,
               ap.id as appeal_id, ${iso("ap.filed_at")} as appeal_filed_at, public.appeal_reviewer_state(ap.id) as appeal_reviewer,
               public.review_needs_admin(d.id) as appeal_needs_admin, ap.result as appeal_result, ${day("ap.answered_at")} as appeal_answered_on,
               ap.answered_by as appeal_answered_by,
               public.snapshot_withheld(d.snapshot_id) as withheld, s.erased_at is not null as erased, ${day("s.erased_at")} as erased_on,
               exists (select 1 from decisions r join cases rc on rc.id = r.case_id
                        where rc.target_type = c.target_type and rc.target_id = c.target_id and r.redacted_at is not null) as redacted,
               s.body, s.media::text as media, coalesce(s.handle, s.author_handle) as handle, s.display_name, s.bio,
               coalesce(p.state = 'deleted_by_author', false) as post_deleted, coalesce(p.erased_at is not null, false) as post_erased,
               (c.target_type = 'post' and exists (select 1 from seal_posts sp join measures_in_force m on m.id = sp.action_id where sp.post_id = c.target_id)) as sealed,
               ${strikeColumns}
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = d.snapshot_id
          left join posts p on c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id
          left join appeals ap on ap.decision_id = d.id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.author_mail <> 'none'
           and case when c.target_type = 'post' then p.author_id = ${accountId}::uuid else c.target_id = ${accountId}::uuid end`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    targetType: row.target_type as "post" | "account",
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    appealUntil: row.appeal_until as string | null,
    reversedOn: row.reversed_on as string | null,
    appeal:
      row.appeal_id === null
        ? null
        : {
            filedAt: row.appeal_filed_at as string,
            reviewer: row.appeal_reviewer as AuthorAppealFacts["reviewer"],
            needsAdmin: row.appeal_needs_admin as boolean,
            result: row.appeal_result as AuthorAppealFacts["result"],
            answeredOn: row.appeal_answered_on as string | null,
            answeredBy: row.appeal_answered_by as string | null,
          },
    withheld: row.withheld as boolean,
    erased: row.erased as boolean,
    erasedOn: row.erased_on as string | null,
    redacted: row.redacted as boolean,
    body: row.body as string | null,
    images: row.media === null ? [] : (JSON.parse(row.media as string) as AuthorDecisionFacts["images"]),
    handle: row.handle as string,
    displayName: row.display_name as string | null,
    bio: row.bio as string | null,
    postDeleted: row.post_deleted as boolean,
    postErased: row.post_erased as boolean,
    sealed: row.sealed as boolean,
    strike:
      row.strike_until === null
        ? null
        : { countsUntil: row.strike_until as string, state: row.strike_state as DecisionStrike["state"], overruledAt: row.strike_overruled_at as string | null },
  };
}

/**
 * The decision behind the state of each of these posts that the account wrote and that is withheld or removed (3c design,
 * section 5): the decision of the strongest post measure in force, a removal before a withhold and the newest first; or,
 * for a post that is removed only because its content was erased, with no post measure in force, the newest decision
 * whose R4 redaction it was. A post of someone else, and one that is visible, is not in the answer.
 */
export async function chipFacts(q: Runner, accountId: string, postIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, PostModeration>> {
  const facts = new Map<string, PostModeration>();
  if (postIds.length === 0) return facts;
  const found = await rows<{ post_id: string; decision_id: string; rule_id: string | null; legal: boolean; interim: boolean; strike_until: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select p.id as post_id, f.decision_id, f.rule_id, f.legal, f.interim,
               -- 3e: the strike of the chip's decision while it stands and still counts.
               (select ${iso("a.ends_at")} from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = f.decision_id and a.kind = 'strike' and a.ends_at > clock_timestamp()
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)) as strike_until
          from posts p
          cross join lateral (
            (select d.id as decision_id, d.rule_id, d.ground is not distinct from 'illegal' as legal, d.kind = 'interim' as interim, 0 as source,
                    (m.kind = 'remove') as removes, d.decided_at
               from measures_in_force m join decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id
              where m.post_id = p.id and m.kind in ('withhold', 'remove'))
            union all
            (select d.id, d.rule_id, d.ground is not distinct from 'illegal', false, 1, true, d.redacted_at
               from cases c join decisions d on d.case_id = c.id
              where c.target_type = 'post' and c.target_id = p.id and p.erased_at is not null and d.redacted_at is not null
                and exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'remove'))
            order by source, removes desc, decided_at desc, decision_id desc
            limit 1
          ) f
         where p.id = any(${`{${postIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) and p.author_id = ${accountId}::uuid and p.moderation_level in ('withheld', 'removed')`,
  );
  for (const row of found) facts.set(row.post_id, { decisionId: row.decision_id, ruleId: row.rule_id as RuleId | null, legal: row.legal, interim: row.interim, strikeUntil: row.strike_until });
  return facts;
}
```
