```ts
  kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  redressVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  category: z.enum(TDB_CATEGORIES),
  categoryKeyword: z.string().nullable(),
  source: z.enum(["notice", "report", "own_initiative"]),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  staffHandle: z.string(),
  throughSeq: Count,
  answersFromSeq: Count.nullable(),
  reviewsDecisionId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  snapshotId: z.uuid(),
  suspect: z.boolean(),
  unseen: z.boolean(),
  needsAdmin: z.boolean(),
  endedInterim: z.boolean(),
  facts: z.string().nullable(),
  reason: z.string().nullable(),
  legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
  actions: z.array(CaseDecisionAction),
});
export type CaseDecision = z.infer<typeof CaseDecision>;

/**
 * Whether anyone at korbat may review a pending appeal now, as the database answers it (appeal_reviewer_state):
 * `available`; `none_single_staff` when korbat has at most one staff account that could (one admin, where the review
 * needs an admin); `none_eligible` when it has more and each took part in the case or is too close to someone in it.
 */
export const REVIEWER_STATES = ["available", "none_single_staff", "none_eligible"] as const;
export const ReviewerState = z.enum(REVIEWER_STATES);
export type ReviewerState = z.infer<typeof ReviewerState>;

/**
 * The author's appeal of a decision of the case, with its statement while korbat keeps it, and its answer. For a pending
 * appeal: `reviewer`, whether anyone may review it now; `needsAdmin`, whether its review is an admin's (the appealed
 * decision cites R2 or sealed images); and `mayReview`, whether the reading person may review it: they made none of the
 * case's decisions, opened no finding in it, are not close to anyone in it, and are an admin where one is needed. An
 * answered appeal has no reviewer state and nobody may review it.
 */
export const CaseAppeal = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  decisionId: z.uuid(),
  filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  statement: z.string().nullable(),
  answeredAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  result: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
  answeredBy: z.uuid().nullable(),
  reviewer: ReviewerState.nullable(),
  needsAdmin: z.boolean(),
  mayReview: z.boolean(),
});
export type CaseAppeal = z.infer<typeof CaseAppeal>;

/** How many appeals one page of the console's list holds. */
export const APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

/**
 * One pending appeal in the console's list: its case, the decision it appeals (when that was decided, the rule or the
 * law it rests on, and what it did), when it was filed, and the end of the decision's appeal window. Then the three
 * marks of CaseAppeal. No row carries the appellant's statement: the reviewer reads it on the case page, whose read is
 * logged and counted.
 */
export const AppealRow = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  caseId: z.uuid(),
  decisionId: z.uuid(),
  filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  deadline: z.iso.datetime(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  legal: z.boolean(),
  actions: z.array(z.enum(ACTION_KINDS)),
  reviewer: ReviewerState,
  needsAdmin: z.boolean(),
  mayReview: z.boolean(),
});
export type AppealRow = z.infer<typeof AppealRow>;

/** GET /api/staff/appeals: the pending appeals, newest first. */
export const AppealsPage = z.object({ appeals: z.array(AppealRow).max(APPEALS_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: z.string().nullable() });
export type AppealsPage = z.infer<typeof AppealsPage>;

export const AppealsQuery = z.object({ cursor: z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,400}$/).optional() });
export type AppealsQuery = z.infer<typeof AppealsQuery>;

/** A note on a case, or a recorded choice not to seal with its reason: who wrote it (a staff handle), when, and the text. */
export const CaseStaffText = z.object({ id: z.uuid(), staffHandle: z.string(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime(), text: z.string() });
export type CaseStaffText = z.infer<typeof CaseStaffText>;

/** One event of a case's history, in the order of their times: ids, enums and times, never text. */
export const CaseHistoryEntry = z.object({
  at: z.iso.datetime(),
  event: z.enum(["item", "snapshot", "decision", "appeal_filed", "appeal_answered", "note", "seal_declined", "reveal", "evidence_erased", "redaction"]),
  refId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  seq: z.number().int().nullable(),
  intakeKind: z.enum(["user", "finding"]).nullable(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  allegesIllegal: z.boolean().nullable(),
  csam: z.boolean().nullable(),
  reexamination: z.boolean().nullable(),
  decisionKind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]).nullable(),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
  staffHandle: z.string().nullable(),
  result: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
});
export type CaseHistoryEntry = z.infer<typeof CaseHistoryEntry>;

/**
 * What a case is about, as it stands now: a post with its state and its level, or an account with the handle, display
 * name and bio it holds now. `link` is the post's korbat address, as text: the console links nowhere into the app. A
 * member is null when the row is gone.
 */
export const CaseTarget = z.discriminatedUnion("type", [
  z.object({ type: z.literal("post"), id: z.uuid(), link: z.string(), authorHandle: z.string().nullable(), state: StoredPostState.nullable(), level: z.enum(["visible", "withheld", "removed"]).nullable() }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal("account"), id: z.uuid(), handle: z.string().nullable(), displayName: z.string().nullable(), bio: z.string().nullable(), deleted: z.boolean() }),
]);
export type CaseTarget = z.infer<typeof CaseTarget>;

/**
 * What a case on the path for child sexual abuse material shows in place of images: whether a suspect item is
 * unanswered, what the case reaches, and how often an admin answered such a report about this target or this author
 * without a seal in the last SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS months, with the day staff last opened an image of the post in the
 * console. Counts and days only.
 */
export const CaseSuspicion = z.object({
  open: z.boolean(),
  reach: z.object({ posts: Count, images: Count, sealed: Count, served: Count, newestPostOn: UtcDay.nullable() }),
  earlier: z.object({
    target: z.object({ count: Count, lastOn: UtcDay.nullable(), imagesOpenedOn: UtcDay.nullable() }),
    author: z.object({ count: Count, lastOn: UtcDay.nullable() }),
  }),
});
export type CaseSuspicion = z.infer<typeof CaseSuspicion>;

/**
 * GET /api/staff/cases/:case: the case, its target as it stands, its evidence (newest first), its items, its decisions
 * with their measures and texts, its appeals, the reading person's own drafts, the notes and the recorded choices not to
 * seal, and its history. `suspicion` is set for a case that holds a suspect item or a seal. `imagesAllowed` is false
 * while the post is frozen, and for every account case: an account case shows no image.
 */
export const CaseView = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  lane: LaneNumber,
  stateVersion: Count,
  intakeSeq: Count,
  answeredSeq: Count,
  openedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  closedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  target: CaseTarget,
  suspicion: CaseSuspicion.nullable(),
  imagesAllowed: z.boolean(),
  snapshots: z.array(CaseSnapshot),
  items: z.array(CaseItem),
  decisions: z.array(CaseDecision),
  appeals: z.array(CaseAppeal),
  drafts: z.array(StaffTextDraft),
  notes: z.array(CaseStaffText),
  sealsDeclined: z.array(CaseStaffText),
  history: z.array(CaseHistoryEntry),
  // 3e (design, section 10.3): on a post case the strike's answer and the author's standing in bands, on an account case
  // the account's standing; each null on the other kind of case.
  strikeDue: StrikeDue.nullable(),
  authorStanding: AuthorStanding.nullable(),
  standing: CaseStanding.nullable(),
});
export type CaseView = z.infer<typeof CaseView>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the statement of reasons

/** A measure as a statement tells of it: what it was, the image of an image measure, whether it changed anything, and what a seal covers. */
export const StatementMeasure = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(MEASURE_KINDS),
  mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  /** Null when the measure changed what someone sees; `already` or `deleted` when it did not. */
  noEffect: z.enum(["already", "deleted"]).nullable(),
  /** For a seal: the posts and images its list held when it was recorded, and how many of those images were on posts their author had deleted by then. */
  sealed: z.object({ posts: Count, images: Count, deletedImages: Count }).nullable(),
  // 3e (design, section 10.2): what the ledger fixes for good about a measure of 3e, so a statement reads as it was sent.
  // Absent on 3c's measures.
  /** A strike's last moment of counting. */
  endsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable().optional(),
  /** On a strike: the account's strikes that stood and counted at the decision's time, this one included. */
  activeThen: Count.nullable().optional(),
});
export type StatementMeasure = z.infer<typeof StatementMeasure>;

/**
 * What a statement says of a field reset that ended or was lifted: the decision that holds the reset (whose screen shows
 * the old value), whether korbat still kept that value when this decision was made, and the rule that decision cites,
 * since a value reset under R4 may have been erased by then.
 */
const ResetFacts = { resetDecisionId: z.uuid().nullable(), oldValueKept: z.boolean(), resetRuleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable() };

/** A reversal as a statement tells of it. The reset's facts are set only on the lifting of a field reset. */
export const StatementReversal = z.object({ kind: z.enum(REVERSAL_KINDS), mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(), ...ResetFacts });
export type StatementReversal = z.infer<typeof StatementReversal>;

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with the decision, without a reversal. The reset's facts are set only on a field reset. */
export const StatementEndedMeasure = z.object({ kind: z.enum(MEASURE_KINDS), mediaId: z.uuid().nullable(), ...ResetFacts });
export type StatementEndedMeasure = z.infer<typeof StatementEndedMeasure>;

/**
 * The statement's data (3c design, section 10): everything a statement of reasons is rendered from, and nothing a later
 * event changes, so a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered. It is the part of a decision that the
 * author's decision view, the console's preview and the mail share; @korbat/rules renders it (statementParagraphs).
 *   - `rulesVersion` and `redressVersion`: the rulebook and the redress texts the decision was made under.
 *   - `facts`, `reason`, `legalReference`: the staff texts, each null when the decision has none or it was erased.
 *   - `post`: the post a post case is about, by its id and creation time, which survive its deletion; null for an account case.
 *   - `endedMeasures`: the measures taken while deciding that ended with this decision. A seal taken while deciding is
 *     left out when the decision itself seals, since the images stay sealed.
 *   - `reviewed`: for a review or a correction, the decision it reviews, whose rule or law the statement renders
 *     under the rulebook version that decision was made under (`reviewed.rulesVersion`), never under its own.
 */
export const DecisionStatement = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  redressVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
  legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
  facts: z.string().nullable(),
  reason: z.string().nullable(),
  source: z.enum(["notice", "report", "own_initiative"]),
  decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  post: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  measures: z.array(StatementMeasure),
  reversals: z.array(StatementReversal),
  endedMeasures: z.array(StatementEndedMeasure),
  reviewed: z
    .object({
      kind: z.enum(["interim", "final"]),
      ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
      ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
      rulesVersion: z.number().int().positive(),
      legalReference: z.string().nullable(),
      decidedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    })
    .nullable(),
});
export type DecisionStatement = z.infer<typeof DecisionStatement>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the app: what the author and the reporter read

/** A page cursor of the app's moderation lists: an opaque word the API wrote. */
const ListCursor = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,400}$/);

/** How many decisions one page of the author's list holds. */
export const AUTHOR_CASES_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/**
 * One decision in its author's list (3c design, section 7.6): the decisions their author was told of, and no other.
 * `decidedOn` is the decision's UTC day, never the day its case opened, which would tell when a report arrived. `post` is
 * the post a decision about a post concerns, by its id and creation time; null for a decision about the account.
 * `actions` are what the decision did, measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds; `endedInterim` says that
 * what korbat did while deciding ended with it. `ruleId` and `legal` name the rule or the law it rests on (neither for a
 * decision without a ground). `appealUntil` is the end of the appeal's window while an appeal can still be filed, and
 * `reversedOn` the UTC day a final restriction was reversed in full; both null otherwise. `appeal` is where the author's
 * appeal of the decision stands: `pending`, or its answer; null when they filed none.
 */
export const AuthorCaseRow = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "review", "correction"]),
  outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
  decidedOn: UtcDay,
  post: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), createdAt: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
  actions: z.array(z.enum(ACTION_KINDS)),
  endedInterim: z.boolean(),
  ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
  legal: z.boolean(),
  appealUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  reversedOn: UtcDay.nullable(),
  appeal: z.enum(["pending", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]).nullable(),
  /** The strike the decision gave (3e design, section 10.2): until when it counts, and when it was overruled; null for a decision without one. */
  strike: z.object({ countsUntil: z.iso.datetime(), overruledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() }).nullable(),
});
export type AuthorCaseRow = z.infer<typeof AuthorCaseRow>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/cases: the decisions about the viewer's account, newest first, and how many strikes of the account
 * count now (active_strikes), which the block "Your standing" above the list prints.
 */
export const AuthorCasesPage = z.object({ decisions: z.array(AuthorCaseRow).max(AUTHOR_CASES_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: z.string().nullable(), activeStrikes: Count });
export type AuthorCasesPage = z.infer<typeof AuthorCasesPage>;

/** A strike as its decision's screen shows it: until when it counts, whether it still counts, ran out or was overruled, and when. */
export const DecisionStrike = z.object({ countsUntil: z.iso.datetime(), state: z.enum(["counts", "expired", "overruled"]), overruledAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() });
export type DecisionStrike = z.infer<typeof DecisionStrike>;

export const AuthorCasesQuery = z.object({ cursor: ListCursor.optional() });
export type AuthorCasesQuery = z.infer<typeof AuthorCasesQuery>;

/**
 * An image of the content a decision was made on, as the app's own image route serves it to its author. It is listed
 * only while that route serves it: never for a sealed image or one of a post its author deleted.
 */
export const DecisionImage = z.object({ id: MediaId, alt: z.string(), width: z.number().int().positive(), height: z.number().int().positive(), small: z.string(), large: z.string() });
export type DecisionImage = z.infer<typeof DecisionImage>;

/**
 * The content a decision was made on, from the decision's snapshot, or the reason it is not shown; the first that
 * applies, in this order (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10):
 *   - `r4_redacted`: an R4 redaction erased it when the restriction became final;
 *   - `erased`: korbat's copy was erased under its retention rules, on `contentErasedOn` (a UTC day); `postKept` says
 *     that the post itself is still in its author's profile;
 *   - `post`: the post's text, which is never sealed, and its images. `imagesHidden` says why none is listed: `sealed`
 *     (nobody is shown them, the author included), or `deleted_by_author` (kept for the case, served to nobody);
 *     `imageCount` is how many the snapshot holds either way. `deletedByAuthor` says that the author deleted the post;
 *   - `account`: the account's fields as the snapshot held them, which for a field reset is the value the reset removed.
 */
export const DecisionContent = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("r4_redacted") }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("erased"), contentErasedOn: UtcDay, postKept: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({
    kind: z.literal("post"),
    body: z.string(),
    deletedByAuthor: z.boolean(),
    images: z.array(DecisionImage),
    imageCount: Count,
    imagesHidden: z.enum(["sealed", "deleted_by_author"]).nullable(),
  }),
  z.strictObject({ kind: z.literal("account"), handle: z.string(), displayName: z.string(), bio: z.string() }),
]);
export type DecisionContent = z.infer<typeof DecisionContent>;

/**
 * The author's appeal as the decision's screen shows it (3c design, sections 7.7 and 10).
 *   - `pending`: `reviewer` says whether anyone at korbat may review it now and, when nobody may, whether that is
 *     because korbat has one moderator (or one admin); `needsAdmin` that its review is an admin's, which is true only
 *     when the decision cites R2 or sealed images, both of which its author was told. Neither says who took part in
 *     the case or why someone may not review it.
 *   - `answered`: the result, the UTC day, and the answering decision with its statement's data, which the screen
 *     renders as it renders every statement: the review, or the correction that reversed everything before a review.
 */
export const DecisionAppeal = z.discriminatedUnion("state", [
  z.strictObject({ state: z.literal("pending"), filedAt: z.iso.datetime(), reviewer: ReviewerState, needsAdmin: z.boolean() }),
  z.strictObject({
    state: z.literal("answered"),
    filedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    answeredOn: UtcDay,
    result: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
    answeredBy: z.uuid(),
    statement: DecisionStatement,
  }),
]);
export type DecisionAppeal = z.infer<typeof DecisionAppeal>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/decisions/:id: one decision as its author reads it (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10). It is the
 * statement's data, which the app renders with statementParagraphs exactly as the mail was rendered, and what the
 * author's screen adds: `appealUntil` and `reversedOn` as the list gives them, the content actioned, and `appeal`, the
 * author's appeal of this decision (null when they filed none).
 */
export const DecisionView = DecisionStatement.extend({
  id: z.uuid(),
  appealUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
  reversedOn: UtcDay.nullable(),
  content: DecisionContent,
  appeal: DecisionAppeal.nullable(),
  /** The strike the decision gave, read fresh (3e design, section 10.2); null for a decision without one. */
  strike: DecisionStrike.nullable(),
});
export type DecisionView = z.infer<typeof DecisionView>;

/** How many reports one page of the reporter's list holds. */
export const REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

/**
 * One item of a report in its sender's own list: the item as the status page gives it, and its id, by which the signed-in
 * sender asks for its re-examination. The status page, which anyone holding a link may open, names an item by its
 * position and never carries an id.
 */
export const ReportItem = NoticeItemStatus.extend({ id: z.uuid() });
export type ReportItem = z.infer<typeof ReportItem>;

/** One report or notice in its sender's list: its reference, when korbat received it, and its items as the status page gives them, each with its id. */
export const ReportRow = z.object({ ref: NoticeRef, receivedAt: z.string(), items: z.array(ReportItem) });
export type ReportRow = z.infer<typeof ReportRow>;

/**
 * GET /api/moderation/reports: the viewer's own reports and notices, newest first, while korbat keeps their records.
 * `reportMailStopped` says that korbat's mails about reports to the account's address are stopped, which someone who
 * holds that address asked for.
 */
export const ReportsPage = z.object({ reports: z.array(ReportRow).max(REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: z.string().nullable(), reportMailStopped: z.boolean() });
export type ReportsPage = z.infer<typeof ReportsPage>;

export const ReportsQuery = z.object({ cursor: ListCursor.optional() });
export type ReportsQuery = z.infer<typeof ReportsQuery>;

/** How many rows each of the overview's lists holds at most; its total says how many there are. */
export const OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX = 100;

const MailCounts = z.object({ receipts: Count, authorMails: Count, outcomes: Count });

/**
 * What retention should have erased or deleted more than a day ago and has not, one count for each due rule: closed
 * cases whose evidence is due, intake records, statements of accounts deleted for 12 months, R4 redactions, image rows
 * that nothing retains, unconfirmed drafts, access rows, and notifiers' contacts and confirmations. The retention job and
 * the auth janitor each run every ten minutes, so any count above zero means a step keeps failing, or that the retention
 * job is switched off. The API reads the counts at most once a minute, for all staff.
 */
export const ErasureOverdue = z.object({ caseEvidence: Count, intakeRecords: Count, statements: Count, redactions: Count, images: Count, drafts: Count, accessLog: Count, contacts: Count });
export type ErasureOverdue = z.infer<typeof ErasureOverdue>;
const HandleCount = z.object({ handle: z.string(), count: Count });

/**
 * GET /api/staff/overview: what the home screen shows every staff member. Per lane the open cases and since when the
 * oldest unanswered item waits; the appeals waiting, how many of them the reading person may review
 * (`appealsYouMayReview`, by CaseAppeal's rule) and how many no staff account may review now
 * (`appealsWithoutReviewer`: the database's appeal_reviewer_state is not `available`); every reveal of a source in the last 30 days, newest first, with
 * its staff handle and its case; per staff handle the images viewed and the findings opened today (UTC); the mails
 * waiting for more than an hour and those given up in the last 30 days; the decided items the daily release has not
 * released after 26 hours; what retention should have erased more than a day ago and has not (`erasureOverdue`); and
 * whether the emergency switch is on. And, of the path for child sexual abuse material,
 * three lists every staff member sees: the decisions of the last 30 days that lifted the protection of reported images
 * (a lifted seal, `unsealed`, or an admin's final answer to such a report without a seal, `dismissed`), the recorded
 * choices not to seal of the last 30 days, and the seals taken while deciding that are in force, each with what it
 * covers. Counts, times, handles and cases only.
 */
export const StaffOverview = z.object({
  lanes: z.array(z.object({ lane: LaneNumber, open: Count, oldestAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() })).length(3),
  appealsWaiting: Count,
  appealsYouMayReview: Count,
  appealsWithoutReviewer: Count,
  reveals: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid() })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
  imagesToday: z.array(HandleCount),
  findingsToday: z.array(HandleCount),
  mailsWaiting: MailCounts,
  mailsFailed: MailCounts,
  releaseOverdue: Count,
  erasureOverdue: ErasureOverdue,
  deferUnproven: z.boolean(),
  protectionLifted: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid(), kind: z.enum(["unsealed", "dismissed"]) })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
  sealsDeclined: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid() })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
  interimSeals: z.object({ total: Count, items: z.array(z.object({ at: z.iso.datetime(), handle: z.string(), caseId: z.uuid(), posts: Count, images: Count })).max(OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX) }),
});
export type StaffOverview = z.infer<typeof StaffOverview>;
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { DisplayName, HandleInput } from "./auth";
import { HiddenMedia, MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST, MediaAttachment, MediaView } from "./media";
import { RULE_IDS } from "./moderation";
import { FORBIDDEN_FORMAT, visibleLength } from "./text";

/**
 * Every code the social endpoints add to ErrorEnvelope.error.code (plus the shared ones: invalid_request, not_found, rate_limited).
 * explore_refreshed (409) refuses a page of an Explore ranking that is no longer kept.
 */
export const SocialErrorCode = z.enum(["post_unavailable", "not_author", "blocked", "self_target", "account_too_new", "explore_refreshed"]);
export type SocialErrorCode = z.infer<typeof SocialErrorCode>;

/** Postgres returns lowercase ids; the canonical form, so a lookup by any spelling finds the row. */
export const PostId = z.uuid().transform((id) => id.toLowerCase());

/** A handle from a URL or a lookup box: an optional leading @, then the 3 to 20 characters handles may contain. */
export const HandleParam = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .regex(/^@?[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,20}$/)
  .transform((value) => value.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase());

export const POST_MAX_LENGTH = 1000;

/** Length in code points, which is what Postgres char_length counts. */
export function postLength(body: string): number {
  return Array.from(body).length;
}

/** Unicode NFC, CR LF to LF, at most two consecutive line breaks, trimmed. The server and the composer use the same rule. */
export function normalizePostBody(raw: string): string {
  return raw.normalize("NFC").replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n").replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
}

/** Any control character other than tab and line feed. */
const FORBIDDEN_CONTROL = /[^\P{Cc}\t\n]/u;

/** A post body as stored: normalized, 1 to 1000 code points, some of them visible, no control or disguising characters. */
export const PostBody = z
  .string()
  .max(4000)
  .transform(normalizePostBody)
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_CONTROL.test(body), { message: "control characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(body), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => visibleLength(body) >= 1, { message: "a post needs some text" })
  .refine((body) => postLength(body) <= POST_MAX_LENGTH, { message: `posts have at most ${POST_MAX_LENGTH} characters` });

/** The text of a post that may also carry images: the same rule as PostBody, except that it may be empty. */
export const PostText = z
  .string()
  .max(4000)
  .transform(normalizePostBody)
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_CONTROL.test(body), { message: "control characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(body), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => postLength(body) <= POST_MAX_LENGTH, { message: `posts have at most ${POST_MAX_LENGTH} characters` });

/** A new post, reply or quote: text, up to four images that are ready, or both. */
export const CreatePostRequest = z
  .object({
    body: PostText.default(""),
    replyToId: PostId.optional(),
    quoteOfId: PostId.optional(),
    media: z.array(MediaAttachment).max(MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST).default([]),
  })
  .refine((post) => !(post.replyToId && post.quoteOfId), { message: "a post is a reply or a quote, not both", path: ["quoteOfId"] })
  .refine((post) => visibleLength(post.body) >= 1 || post.media.length >= 1, { message: "a post needs text or an image", path: ["body"] })
  .refine((post) => new Set(post.media.map((item) => item.id)).size === post.media.length, { message: "an image can be attached once", path: ["media"] });
export type CreatePostRequest = z.infer<typeof CreatePostRequest>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- posts

export const Author = z.object({ id: z.uuid(), handle: z.string(), displayName: z.string(), verified: z.boolean() });
export type Author = z.infer<typeof Author>;

/** Stands in for a post where its absence would break structure: an ancestor in a thread or a quoted embed. */
export const Tombstone = z
  .strictObject({ id: z.uuid(), deleted: z.literal(true).optional(), unavailable: z.literal(true).optional() })
  .refine((t) => t.deleted === true || t.unavailable === true, { message: "a tombstone is deleted or unavailable" });
export type Tombstone = z.infer<typeof Tombstone>;

/** Never deleted_by_author: deleted posts only ever appear as tombstones. */
export const PostState = z.enum(["visible", "withheld", "removed"]);
export type PostState = z.infer<typeof PostState>;

export const PostCounts = z.object({
  likes: z.number().int().min(0),
  reposts: z.number().int().min(0),
  replies: z.number().int().min(0),
  quotes: z.number().int().min(0),
});
export type PostCounts = z.infer<typeof PostCounts>;

export const ViewerPostState = z.object({ liked: z.boolean(), reposted: z.boolean(), bookmarked: z.boolean() });
export type ViewerPostState = z.infer<typeof ViewerPostState>;

const postFields = {
  id: z.uuid(),
  author: Author,
  body: z.string(),
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  state: PostState,
  /** The handle is null when the viewer could not open the parent: its author is blocked either way, or it is hidden or deleted. */
  replyTo: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), authorHandle: z.string().nullable() }).nullable(),
  counts: PostCounts,
  /** The post's images in order, each as the image or, where the reader is not shown it, as a hidden image in its place. Always present, often empty. */
  media: z.array(z.union([MediaView, HiddenMedia])),
  /** Present only for a signed-in viewer. */
  viewer: ViewerPostState.optional(),
};

/** A quoted post as embedded: one level deep, so its own quote is not expanded. */
export const QuotedPost = z.object({ ...postFields, quoteOf: z.null() });
export type QuotedPost = z.infer<typeof QuotedPost>;

/**
 * The decision behind the state of the viewer's own withheld or removed post (3c design, sections 5 and 7.6): the decision
 * of the strongest post measure in force, by its id, the rule it cites (null for a decision on the law), whether it rests
 * on the law, and whether korbat is still deciding. The app shows it as the chip that links to the statement. `strikeUntil`
 * (3e design, section 10.2) is the end of counting of the strike the post's decision gave, while that strike stands and
 * still counts; null otherwise.
 */
export const PostModeration = z.object({ decisionId: z.uuid(), ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(), legal: z.boolean(), interim: z.boolean(), strikeUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable() });
export type PostModeration = z.infer<typeof PostModeration>;

export const PostView = z.object({
  ...postFields,
  /**
   * The author's "In Explore" chip (2c design, section 8): present, and true, only on the viewer's own post while it is in
   * the current Explore ranking with their switch on. Nobody else's view carries it, nor does a quoted embed. It sits here
   * rather than in `viewer`, which the like, repost and bookmark answers replace.
   */
  inExplore: z.literal(true).optional(),
  /** Present only on the viewer's own post while moderation withholds or removed it; nobody else's view carries it, nor does a quoted embed. */
  moderation: PostModeration.optional(),
  quoteOf: z.union([QuotedPost, Tombstone]).nullable(),
});
export type PostView = z.infer<typeof PostView>;

/** An item of a timeline or a profile's Posts tab. */
export const TimelineItem = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("post"), post: PostView }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("repost"), post: PostView, repostedBy: Author, repostedAt: z.iso.datetime() }),
]);
export type TimelineItem = z.infer<typeof TimelineItem>;

export function page<T extends z.ZodType>(item: T) {
  return z.object({ items: z.array(item), nextCursor: z.string().nullable() });
}

export const TimelinePage = page(TimelineItem);
export type TimelinePage = z.infer<typeof TimelinePage>;
export const PostPage = page(PostView);
export type PostPage = z.infer<typeof PostPage>;

export const ThreadResponse = z.object({
  ancestors: z.array(z.union([PostView, Tombstone])),
  post: PostView,
  replies: PostPage,
});
export type ThreadResponse = z.infer<typeof ThreadResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- engagement and graph

export const EngagementResponse = z.object({ counts: PostCounts, viewer: ViewerPostState });
export type EngagementResponse = z.infer<typeof EngagementResponse>;

export const FollowResponse = z.object({ following: z.boolean(), followerCount: z.number().int().min(0) });
export type FollowResponse = z.infer<typeof FollowResponse>;

export const BlockResponse = z.object({ blocked: z.boolean() });
export type BlockResponse = z.infer<typeof BlockResponse>;

export const MuteResponse = z.object({ muted: z.boolean() });
export type MuteResponse = z.infer<typeof MuteResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- profiles

export const ProfileCounts = z.object({
  posts: z.number().int().min(0),
  followers: z.number().int().min(0),
  following: z.number().int().min(0),
});

export const ViewerProfileState = z.object({ following: z.boolean(), followedBy: z.boolean(), blocked: z.boolean(), muted: z.boolean() });
export type ViewerProfileState = z.infer<typeof ViewerProfileState>;

export const ProfileView = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  handle: z.string(),
  displayName: z.string(),
  bio: z.string(),
  verified: z.boolean(),
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  counts: ProfileCounts,
  /** Present only for a signed-in viewer looking at someone else. */
  viewer: ViewerProfileState.optional(),
});
export type ProfileView = z.infer<typeof ProfileView>;

export const ProfileListItem = Author.extend({ bio: z.string(), viewerFollows: z.boolean().optional() });
export type ProfileListItem = z.infer<typeof ProfileListItem>;

export const ProfilePage = page(ProfileListItem);
export type ProfilePage = z.infer<typeof ProfilePage>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- profile editing

export const BIO_MAX_LENGTH = 160;

/** A bio as stored: trimmed, at most 160 code points, one line of plain text with no control or disguising characters. Empty clears it. */
export const Bio = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  // The line and paragraph separators (Zl, Zp) break a line as a newline does, without being control characters.
  .regex(/^[^\p{Cc}\p{Zl}\p{Zp}]*$/u, "control characters and line breaks are not allowed")
  .refine((bio) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(bio), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((bio) => postLength(bio) <= BIO_MAX_LENGTH, { message: `bios have at most ${BIO_MAX_LENGTH} characters` });

/** What the profile screen saves: either field, or both. The handle has its own route and rules. */
export const ProfileEditRequest = z
  .object({ displayName: DisplayName.optional(), bio: Bio.optional() })
  .refine((edit) => edit.displayName !== undefined || edit.bio !== undefined, { message: "nothing to change" });
export type ProfileEditRequest = z.infer<typeof ProfileEditRequest>;

/** The handle rules and the 30-day cooldown are enforced by the flow, which answers with a specific error code. */
export const HandleChangeRequest = z.object({ handle: HandleInput });
export type HandleChangeRequest = z.infer<typeof HandleChangeRequest>;
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { DisplayName, OpaqueId, Role } from "./auth";
import { hex, sha256, sortedJson } from "./canonical";
import {
  ACTION_KINDS,
  DECISION_KEYWORDS,
  MEASURES,
  REVEAL_REASON_CATEGORIES,
  RULE_IDS,
  STANDING_DAYS,
  TDB_CATEGORIES,
  TIMED_KINDS,
  UNFOUNDED_MAX,
  compareDecisionActions,
  type ActionKind,
  type DecisionActionParams,
} from "./moderation";
import { AuthenticationResponseJSON, PasskeyOptionsResponse, RegistrationResponseJSON } from "./passkeys";

// The staff console (3a design, section 10). The console talks only to /api/staff/* on its own origin, and parses every
// answer with these schemas; the API validates every request with them.

/**
 * Every code the staff flows put in ErrorEnvelope.error.code. Staff routes may also answer the shared challenge_expired,
 * rate_limited and invalid_request, and the staff gate's not_found and csrf_failed, but never a passkey_* code.
 */
export const StaffErrorCode = z.enum([
  "staff_session_required",
  "staff_key_invalid",
  "staff_key_suspended",
  "staff_key_limit",
  "staff_key_not_device_bound",
  "staff_key_not_user_verified",
  "staff_key_refused",
  "staff_enrollment_invalid",
  "staff_step_up_required",
  "staff_step_up_invalid",
]);
export type StaffErrorCode = z.infer<typeof StaffErrorCode>;

/** The roles that open the console: an account whose role is user holds no staff key. */
export const StaffRole = Role.exclude(["user"]);
export type StaffRole = z.infer<typeof StaffRole>;

/**
 * The name a staff key's holder gives it at enrolment, under the display-name rules. The authenticator shows it (it is the
 * registration's user name), so the console asks for neither an email nor a real name.
 */
export const StaffKeyName = DisplayName;

/** Which button the enrolment page offered: a roaming security key (sent with the security-key hint) or this computer's Windows Hello (no hint). */
export const StaffKeyKind = z.enum(["security_key", "this_device"]);
export type StaffKeyKind = z.infer<typeof StaffKeyKind>;

/** A lowercase hex sha256: chain hashes and action hashes. */
const Sha256Hex = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, "must be a lowercase hex sha256");

/** A row's place in the audit chain (chain_seq): 1 for the first row. */
const ChainSeq = z.number().int().positive().max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);

/**
 * A place as a query string names it: a decimal without a sign, a leading zero or an exponent, and at most 15 digits, so
 * it always converts to a safe integer.
 */
const ChainSeqParam = z
  .string()
  .regex(/^[1-9][0-9]{0,14}$/, "must be a place in the audit chain: a positive whole number")
  .transform(Number);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- keys, sessions and the account

/** One of the person's staff keys as the console lists them: never the public key, the credential id or the AAGUID. */
export const StaffKey = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  name: z.string(),
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  lastUsedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
});
export type StaffKey = z.infer<typeof StaffKey>;

export const StaffKeysResponse = z.object({ keys: z.array(StaffKey) });
export type StaffKeysResponse = z.infer<typeof StaffKeysResponse>;

/**
 * One of the person's live staff sessions. `handle` is the session's random handle, which the revocation route takes;
 * `browser` is the coarse label ("Firefox on Linux"), never the user agent or an address.
 */
export const StaffSession = z.object({
  handle: z.uuid(),
  browser: z.string(),
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  lastUsedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  /** The session this request came from. */
  current: z.boolean(),
});
export type StaffSession = z.infer<typeof StaffSession>;

export const StaffSessionsResponse = z.object({ sessions: z.array(StaffSession) });
export type StaffSessionsResponse = z.infer<typeof StaffSessionsResponse>;

/**
 * GET /api/staff/me: the account's handle and role, the session's handle (the console binds step-up challenges to it) and
 * both expiries with the seconds left, counted on the server, so the console's idle timer needs no clock of its own.
 */
export const StaffMe = z
  .object({
    handle: z.string(),
    role: StaffRole,
    sessionHandle: z.uuid(),
    idleExpiresAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    idleSecondsLeft: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
    absoluteExpiresAt: z.iso.datetime(),
    absoluteSecondsLeft: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  })
  // The idle expiry never moves past the absolute one (the database checks it too).
  .refine((me) => me.idleSecondsLeft <= me.absoluteSecondsLeft, { message: "the idle end cannot lie beyond the absolute end", path: ["idleSecondsLeft"] });
export type StaffMe = z.infer<typeof StaffMe>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- enrolment

/** POST /api/staff/enroll/options: the token of the link `staff.js enroll` printed, the key's name and its kind. */
export const StaffEnrollOptionsRequest = z.object({ token: OpaqueId, name: StaffKeyName, kind: StaffKeyKind });
export type StaffEnrollOptionsRequest = z.infer<typeof StaffEnrollOptionsRequest>;

/**
 * The registration options, and whether the console's relying party ID is the app's (`rpShared`, true in development).
 * Only when it is not does the page ask the password manager to drop a refused credential through the Signal API.
 */
export const StaffEnrollOptionsResponse = PasskeyOptionsResponse.extend({ rpShared: z.boolean() });
export type StaffEnrollOptionsResponse = z.infer<typeof StaffEnrollOptionsResponse>;

/** POST /api/staff/enroll/verify: the same token and name with the browser's registration response. */
export const StaffEnrollVerifyRequest = z.object({ token: OpaqueId, name: StaffKeyName, response: RegistrationResponseJSON });
export type StaffEnrollVerifyRequest = z.infer<typeof StaffEnrollVerifyRequest>;

/** The key the enrolment stored; the person then signs in with it once. */
export const StaffEnrollVerifyResponse = z.object({ key: StaffKey });
export type StaffEnrollVerifyResponse = z.infer<typeof StaffEnrollVerifyResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- sign-in

/** POST /api/staff/signin/options takes no body and answers with discoverable-credential options. */
export const StaffSignInOptionsResponse = PasskeyOptionsResponse;
export type StaffSignInOptionsResponse = z.infer<typeof StaffSignInOptionsResponse>;

/** POST /api/staff/signin/verify: the browser's assertion. There is no device id: a staff session is its own record. */
export const StaffSignInVerifyRequest = z.object({ response: AuthenticationResponseJSON });
export type StaffSignInVerifyRequest = z.infer<typeof StaffSignInVerifyRequest>;

/** A sign-in answers with the new session as /me describes it, beside the two staff cookies. */
export const StaffSignInVerifyResponse = StaffMe;
export type StaffSignInVerifyResponse = z.infer<typeof StaffSignInVerifyResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- step-up

/**
 * A uuid in the one spelling PostgreSQL writes, lower-case hex. A step-up target's id is hashed exactly as sent, but the
 * database finds a uuid by value whatever its case and the audit row records the id as the database returns it: an
 * upper-case spelling would act on the row and leave a record whose target no longer hashes to the confirmed action, which
 * audit-verify would refuse for good. So any other spelling is refused, never changed.
 */
const LowerCaseUuid = z.uuid().regex(/^[0-9a-f-]+$/, { message: "a uuid in lower case" });

// The params of the three actions of moderation cases (3c design, section 10). They are written into the audit chain for
// good, so they hold only ids, enums, whole numbers and hex digests, never a free string: every text a decision carries is
// saved first and named here by its salted digest. No member has a transform (a schema that changed a value would have the
// key confirm one text and the record keep another), and the cross-field rules are refinements, which change nothing.
// The database's triggers check every rule again.

/** A case's version or an item's number: a whole number that PostgreSQL's integer holds. */
const Counter = z.number().int().min(0).max(2_147_483_647);

/** The version of the rulebook or of the redress texts: a whole number from 1 that PostgreSQL's smallint holds. */
const TextVersion = z.number().int().min(1).max(32_767);

/**
 * One measure or reversal, in one of two strict shapes (3e design, section 10.4). For every kind but three: its kind and,
 * for an image measure, the image, as a lower-case uuid (an image id's own schema lower-cases, which a param must not).
 */
const PlainAction = z.strictObject({ kind: z.enum(ACTION_KINDS).exclude(TIMED_KINDS), mediaId: LowerCaseUuid.nullable() });

/**
 * A suspension, a termination or a restriction of reporting: also its days (a whole number from 1 to 30, null on a
 * termination) and whether it is announced with the reply window, so that the key signs both and the database compares
 * both with its ledger row.
 */
const TimedAction = z.strictObject({ kind: z.enum(TIMED_KINDS), mediaId: z.null(), days: z.number().int().min(STANDING_DAYS.min).max(STANDING_DAYS.max).nullable(), announced: z.boolean() });

const DecisionAction = z.union([PlainAction, TimedAction]);

const isReversal = (kind: ActionKind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts !== null;

/** The six measures of 3e: each only in a final decision that restricts. */
const MEASURES_OF_3E: readonly ActionKind[] = ["strike", "suspend", "terminate", "retire_handle", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"];

type SignedAction = DecisionActionParams & { days?: number | null; announced?: boolean };

/**
 * What is wrong with a decision's list of actions, or nothing: they come in the one order compareDecisionActions gives,
 * without repeats; only an image measure names an image, and it must; at most one of them acts on the post itself
 * (a seal acts on images and may stand beside it), and at most one seals; and a correction or a review lifts, never
 * restricts. And for 3e's kinds: a termination has no days, a suspension and a restriction of reporting have theirs, a
 * restriction of reporting is never announced, and a decision holds at most one suspension or termination.
 */
function actionProblems(actions: readonly SignedAction[], reversalsOnly: boolean): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = [];
  if (actions.some((action, i) => i > 0 && compareDecisionActions(actions[i - 1]!, action) >= 0)) problems.push("the actions are sorted by kind and then by image, without repeats");
  if (actions.some((action) => (MEASURES[action.kind].target === "image") !== (action.mediaId !== null))) problems.push("an image measure names its image, and no other kind names one");
  if (actions.filter((action) => action.kind === "withhold" || action.kind === "remove").length > 1) problems.push("a decision holds at most one measure on the post itself");
  if (actions.filter((action) => action.kind === "seal_media").length > 1) problems.push("a decision holds at most one seal");
  if (reversalsOnly && actions.some((action) => !isReversal(action.kind))) problems.push("a correction or a review holds reversals only");
  const daysWrong = (action: SignedAction) =>
    (action.kind === "terminate" && action.days !== null) || ((action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "restrict_reporting") && (action.days === null || action.days === undefined));
  if (actions.some(daysWrong)) problems.push("a termination names no days, a suspension and a restriction of reporting name theirs");
  if (actions.some((action) => action.kind === "restrict_reporting" && action.announced !== false)) problems.push("a restriction of reporting starts at once: it is never announced");
  if (actions.filter((action) => action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate").length > 1) problems.push("a decision holds at most one suspension or termination");
  return problems;
}

/** Whether a list of ids is sorted, as text, without repeats. */
const sortedUnique = (ids: readonly string[]) => ids.every((id, i) => i === 0 || ids[i - 1]! < id);

/**
 * POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions: a decision taken while deciding (interim), one that decides the case (final) or
 * a correction of either. `stateVersion` is the case's version the console showed, `throughSeq` the last item a final
 * decision answers, and the snapshot is named with the digest the console computed from what it displayed. Two members of
 * 3e are always present (3e design, section 10.4): `unfounded`, the items a decision that found no breach marks
 * "manifestly unfounded" (lower-case uuids, sorted, without repeats; [] when none), and `replaced`, true only on a
 * correction that withdraws an announced suspension that has not started, to make room for another measure. A correction
 * may also keep the decision: the database decides from the corrected decision which of its two uses it is (a reply
 * answered, or a decision's marks withdrawn) and refuses one that is neither.
 */
export const CaseDecidedParams = z
  .strictObject({
    kind: z.enum(["interim", "final", "correction"]),
    stateVersion: Counter,
    throughSeq: Counter,
    reviewsDecisionId: LowerCaseUuid.nullable(),
    snapshotId: LowerCaseUuid,
    snapshotDigest: Sha256Hex,
    outcome: z.enum(["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
    ground: z.enum(["incompatible", "illegal"]).nullable(),
    ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(),
    rulesVersion: TextVersion,
    redressVersion: TextVersion,
    category: z.enum(TDB_CATEGORIES),
    categoryKeyword: z.enum(DECISION_KEYWORDS).nullable(),
    actions: z.array(DecisionAction).max(8),
    factsDigest: Sha256Hex.nullable(),
    reasonDigest: Sha256Hex.nullable(),
    legalReferenceDigest: Sha256Hex.nullable(),
    unfounded: z.array(LowerCaseUuid).max(UNFOUNDED_MAX),
    replaced: z.boolean(),
  })
  .superRefine((params, ctx) => {
    const refuse = (path: string, message: string) => ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: [path], message });
    const outcomes = { interim: ["restricted"], final: ["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident"], correction: ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] } as const;
    if (!(outcomes[params.kind] as readonly string[]).includes(params.outcome)) refuse("outcome", "a decision of this kind does not have this outcome");
    if (params.kind === "interim" && params.throughSeq !== 0) refuse("throughSeq", "a decision taken while deciding answers no item");
    if ((params.kind === "correction") !== (params.reviewsDecisionId !== null)) refuse("reviewsDecisionId", "a correction, and only a correction, names the decision it corrects");
    if (params.categoryKeyword !== null && params.ground !== "illegal") refuse("categoryKeyword", "a keyword goes only with the ground of the law");
    if (params.ground === "illegal" && params.ruleId !== null) refuse("ruleId", "a decision on the law cites no korbat rule");
    if (params.ground === "incompatible" && params.ruleId === null) refuse("ruleId", "a decision on the rules cites its rule");
    if (params.ground === "illegal" && params.legalReferenceDigest === null) refuse("legalReferenceDigest", "a decision on the law names its legal reference");
    if (params.outcome === "restricted" && (params.ground === null || params.factsDigest === null || params.reasonDigest === null)) {
      refuse("outcome", "a restriction carries its ground, its facts and its reason");
    }
    if (params.kind === "correction") {
      if (params.ground !== null || params.ruleId !== null || params.categoryKeyword !== null || params.factsDigest !== null || params.legalReferenceDigest !== null) {
        refuse("kind", "a correction states no ground of its own");
      }
      if (params.reasonDigest === null) refuse("reasonDigest", "a correction carries its reason");
    }
    for (const problem of actionProblems(params.actions, params.kind === "correction")) refuse("actions", problem);
    // 3e's refinements; the triggers check each again.
    if (params.actions.some((action) => MEASURES_OF_3E.includes(action.kind)) && !(params.kind === "final" && params.outcome === "restricted")) {
      refuse("actions", "a measure of 3e is taken only by a final decision that restricts");
    }
    if (params.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "strike") && (params.ground !== "incompatible" || params.ruleId === "R2")) {
      refuse("actions", "a strike goes only with a korbat rule other than R2");
    }
    if (params.outcome === "kept" && params.actions.length > 0) refuse("actions", "a kept correction holds no action");
    if (params.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "overrule") && params.outcome !== "reversed") refuse("actions", "a strike is overruled only with its whole finding: the outcome is reversed");
    if (params.unfounded.length > 0 && !(params.kind === "final" && params.outcome === "no_violation")) refuse("unfounded", "only a final decision that finds no breach marks reports");
    if (!sortedUnique(params.unfounded)) refuse("unfounded", "the marked items are sorted, without repeats");
    if (params.replaced && !(params.kind === "correction" && params.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "lift_suspension"))) {
      refuse("replaced", "only a correction that lifts a suspension withdraws it for another measure");
    }
  });
export type CaseDecidedParams = z.infer<typeof CaseDecidedParams>;

/**
 * POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review: the answer to the author's one appeal of the decision. It keeps the decision
 * or lifts measures of it, never restricts, and always gives its reason. A review withdraws no mark and replaces no
 * measure; it overrules a strike only when it reverses the decision whole.
 */
export const AppealsReviewedParams = z
  .strictObject({
    stateVersion: Counter,
    appealId: LowerCaseUuid,
    snapshotId: LowerCaseUuid,
    snapshotDigest: Sha256Hex,
    outcome: z.enum(["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]),
    rulesVersion: TextVersion,
    redressVersion: TextVersion,
    category: z.enum(TDB_CATEGORIES),
    actions: z.array(DecisionAction).max(8),
    reasonDigest: Sha256Hex,
  })
  .superRefine((params, ctx) => {
    for (const problem of actionProblems(params.actions, true)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["actions"], message: problem });
    if (params.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "overrule") && params.outcome !== "reversed") {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["actions"], message: "a strike is overruled only with its whole finding: the outcome is reversed" });
    }
  });
export type AppealsReviewedParams = z.infer<typeof AppealsReviewedParams>;

/** POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal: why the source of the item is revealed, as a category and the digest of the saved reason. */
export const IdentityRevealedParams = z.strictObject({ reasonCategory: z.enum(REVEAL_REASON_CATEGORIES), reasonDigest: Sha256Hex });
export type IdentityRevealedParams = z.infer<typeof IdentityRevealedParams>;

/**
 * Every action a staff key confirms, one at a time (3a design, section 7): the type of its target, the schema of the
 * target's id and the schema of its params. The step-up options, requireStaffStepUp, audit-verify and the console read it.
 * The params are hashed exactly as sent, so their schemas are strict: a member they do not know is refused, never dropped.
 */
export const STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS = {
  /** DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle: one of the person's own staff sessions, by its handle. */
  staff_session_revoked: { targetType: "staff_session", targetId: LowerCaseUuid, params: z.strictObject({}) },
  /** POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions: a decision on the case, by the case's id. */
  case_decided: { targetType: "case", targetId: LowerCaseUuid, params: CaseDecidedParams },
  /** POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review: the review of the appeal of a decision, by the decision's id. */
  appeals_reviewed: { targetType: "decision", targetId: LowerCaseUuid, params: AppealsReviewedParams },
  /** POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal: who sent an item, by the item's id. */
  identity_revealed: { targetType: "intake_item", targetId: LowerCaseUuid, params: IdentityRevealedParams },
} as const;
export type StaffStepUpAction = keyof typeof STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS;

export const StaffStepUpActionName = z.enum(Object.keys(STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS) as [StaffStepUpAction, ...StaffStepUpAction[]]);

/** The `{ action, target, params }` of one step-up action, each part checked by that action's own schemas. */
function stepUpRequest<A extends StaffStepUpAction>(action: A) {
  const spec = STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS[action];
  return z.strictObject({
    action: z.literal(action),
    target: z.strictObject({ type: z.literal(spec.targetType), id: spec.targetId }),
    params: spec.params,
  });
}

/** POST /api/staff/step-up/options: the action the route will execute, as it will execute it. */
export const StaffStepUpOptionsRequest = z.discriminatedUnion("action", [
  stepUpRequest("staff_session_revoked"),
  stepUpRequest("case_decided"),
  stepUpRequest("appeals_reviewed"),
  stepUpRequest("identity_revealed"),
]);
export type StaffStepUpOptionsRequest = z.infer<typeof StaffStepUpOptionsRequest>;

/** The options: a challenge bound to the session and the action, and an allow list holding only the session's key. */
export const StaffStepUpOptionsResponse = PasskeyOptionsResponse;
export type StaffStepUpOptionsResponse = z.infer<typeof StaffStepUpOptionsResponse>;

/** DELETE /api/staff/sessions/:handle: the action's params (none) with the step-up assertion added as `stepUp`. */
export const StaffSessionRevokeRequest = STAFF_STEP_UP_ACTIONS.staff_session_revoked.params.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON });
export type StaffSessionRevokeRequest = z.infer<typeof StaffSessionRevokeRequest>;

/** POST /api/staff/items/:item/reveal: the action's params with the step-up assertion added as `stepUp`. */
export const IdentityRevealRequest = IdentityRevealedParams.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON });
export type IdentityRevealRequest = z.infer<typeof IdentityRevealRequest>;

/**
 * POST /api/staff/cases/:case/decisions: the action's params with the step-up assertion added as `stepUp`. The route
 * answers 201 with the case as it now stands (CaseView), so the console shows what the decision left.
 */
export const CaseDecisionRequest = CaseDecidedParams.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON });
export type CaseDecisionRequest = z.infer<typeof CaseDecisionRequest>;

/**
 * POST /api/staff/decisions/:decision/review: the action's params with the step-up assertion added as `stepUp`. The
 * route answers 201 with the case as it now stands (CaseView), as a decision's does.
 */
export const AppealReviewRequest = AppealsReviewedParams.extend({ stepUp: AuthenticationResponseJSON });
export type AppealReviewRequest = z.infer<typeof AppealReviewRequest>;

/**
 * Which ceremony a WebAuthn challenge was issued for: its second byte, in either layout below. A challenge answers only
 * the ceremony it names. The API's codec writes these codes, and the console checks them before it asks for the key, so
 * no challenge of one ceremony is ever signed in another.
 */
export const CHALLENGE_PURPOSES = { signin: 1, register: 2, reauth: 3, staff_signin: 4, staff_register: 5, staff_step_up: 6 } as const;

/**
 * The layout of every challenge but the step-up's (1c's codec, 3a design, section 5): version, purpose, expiry (epoch
 * milliseconds, big-endian), nonce, a 16-byte binding (the first 16 bytes of the sha256 of the session's handle or the
 * staff enrolment's id it is bound to, zeros for the two sign-ins), then the first 16 bytes of an HMAC over the 42 bytes
 * before it, 58 bytes sent as unpadded base64url. The API's codec writes it, and the console checks the staff sign-in's
 * and the staff registration's before it asks for the key.
 */
export const CEREMONY_CHALLENGE = {
  bytes: 58,
  encodedLength: 78,
  version: 1,
  versionAt: 0,
  purposeAt: 1,
  expiryAt: 2,
  expiryBytes: 8,
  nonceAt: 10,
  nonceBytes: 16,
  bindingAt: 26,
  bindingBytes: 16,
  sealAt: 42,
  sealBytes: 16,
} as const;

/**
 * The step-up challenge's layout (3a design, section 5), which the API's codec writes, audit-verify reads back from a
 * stored assertion without the sealing key, and the console checks before it asks for the key: version, purpose, expiry
 * (epoch milliseconds, big-endian), nonce, the full 32-byte binding, then the first 16 bytes of an HMAC over the 58 bytes
 * before it, 74 bytes sent as unpadded base64url. The other ceremonies' challenges are 58 bytes with purposes 1 to 5 and a
 * 16-byte binding (CEREMONY_CHALLENGE), so neither layout is ever read as the other.
 */
export const STAFF_STEP_UP_CHALLENGE = {
  bytes: 74,
  encodedLength: 99,
  version: 1,
  purpose: CHALLENGE_PURPOSES.staff_step_up,
  versionAt: 0,
  purposeAt: 1,
  expiryAt: 2,
  expiryBytes: 8,
  nonceAt: 10,
  nonceBytes: 16,
  bindingAt: 26,
  bindingBytes: 32,
  sealAt: 58,
  sealBytes: 16,
} as const;

/** What a step-up confirms: an action, its target and its params, as the route will execute them, or as an audit row records them. */
export interface StaffStepUpActionInput {
  action: string;
  target: { type: string; id: string };
  params: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/**
 * The text an action's hash is taken over (3a design, section 7, Step-up): the sorted JSON of `{ action, target: { type,
 * id }, params }`. The step-up options take it from what the console sent, requireStaffStepUp from what the route is about
 * to do, audit-verify from the row's action, target and `metadata.params`, and the console from what it chose.
 */
export function stepUpActionText(input: StaffStepUpActionInput): string {
  return sortedJson({ action: input.action, target: { type: input.target.type, id: input.target.id }, params: input.params });
}

/**
 * The text a step-up challenge's binding is the sha256 of: the staff session's handle, a newline and the action's hash. A
 * confirmation made in one session, or for one action, therefore binds nothing else.
 */
export function stepUpBindingText(sessionHandle: string, actionHash: string): string {
  return `${sessionHandle}\n${actionHash}`;
}

/** The action's hash: the lower-case hex sha256 of stepUpActionText's UTF-8 bytes. */
export async function stepUpActionHash(input: StaffStepUpActionInput): Promise<string> {
  return hex(await sha256(stepUpActionText(input)));
}

/** The step-up challenge's binding: all 32 bytes of the sha256 of stepUpBindingText's UTF-8 bytes. */
export async function stepUpBinding(sessionHandle: string, actionHash: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  return sha256(stepUpBindingText(sessionHandle, actionHash));
}

/**
 * A step-up assertion as the audit row stores it in `step_up`: the three members `audit-verify` checks, base64url exactly
 * as the browser sent them, under the same bounds as the browser's answer.
 */
export const StaffStoredAssertion = z.strictObject(
  AuthenticationResponseJSON.shape.response.pick({ authenticatorData: true, clientDataJSON: true, signature: true }).shape,
);
export type StaffStoredAssertion = z.infer<typeof StaffStoredAssertion>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the audit log

/** How many rows one page of the audit log holds. */
export const STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

/**
 * One row of the audit log as the console shows it: its place and hash in the chain, when it joined the chain, the actor's
 * handle (null for the system actor or an account without one), the action, its target and the action's hash when a
 * step-up confirmed it. Never its metadata.
 */
export const AuditEntry = z.object({
  seq: ChainSeq,
  hash: Sha256Hex,
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  actorHandle: z.string().nullable(),
  action: z.string().min(1),
  targetType: z.string().nullable(),
  targetId: z.string().nullable(),
  actionHash: Sha256Hex.nullable(),
});
export type AuditEntry = z.infer<typeof AuditEntry>;

/** Newest first by place. `nextCursor` asks for the rows before this page's last one; null when there are none. */
export const AuditPage = z.object({ entries: z.array(AuditEntry).max(STAFF_AUDIT_PAGE_SIZE), nextCursor: ChainSeq.nullable() });
export type AuditPage = z.infer<typeof AuditPage>;

/**
 * GET /api/staff/audit: from the newest row, from before `cursor`, or the page whose newest row is at place `at` (the
 * keeper's "Go to place"); `action=staff_sign_in` is the reader's one filter, which the home screen's list of sign-ins reads.
 */
export const AuditPageQuery = z
  .object({ cursor: ChainSeqParam.optional(), at: ChainSeqParam.optional(), action: z.enum(["staff_sign_in"]).optional() })
  .refine((query) => query.cursor === undefined || query.at === undefined, { message: "ask for a cursor or a place, not both", path: ["at"] });
export type AuditPageQuery = z.infer<typeof AuditPageQuery>;
```

```json
{
  "version": "7",
  "dialect": "postgresql",

    {
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { check, index, integer, pgEnum, pgTable, primaryKey, real, smallint, text, uniqueIndex, uuid, type AnyPgColumn } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { apiRole, fullAccess, ts } from "./helpers";
import { profiles } from "./identity";

export const postState = pgEnum("post_state", ["visible", "withheld", "removed", "deleted_by_author"]);

/**
 * What moderation derives for a post from the measures in force (3c design, section 6.1): the strongest of them.
 * posts.state mirrors it unless the author deleted the post, so post_state gains no value.
 */
export const moderationLevel = pgEnum("moderation_level", ["visible", "withheld", "removed"]);

/** An image's own moderation state, beside its post's. Only an image is ever sealed: shown to nobody, its author included. */
export const mediaModerationState = pgEnum("media_moderation_state", ["visible", "withheld", "removed", "sealed"]);

/** A counter kept exact by the application: updated in the same transaction as the action it counts. */
const counter = (name: string) => integer(name).notNull().default(0);

export const posts = pgTable(
  "posts",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    authorId: uuid("author_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    body: text("body").notNull(),
    replyToId: uuid("reply_to_id").references((): AnyPgColumn => posts.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    quoteOfId: uuid("quote_of_id").references((): AnyPgColumn => posts.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    state: postState("state").notNull().default("visible"),
    likeCount: counter("like_count"),
    repostCount: counter("repost_count"),
    /** Replies that are not deleted. */
    replyCount: counter("reply_count"),
    /** Quotes that are not deleted. */
    quoteCount: counter("quote_count"),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** Set together with state = 'deleted_by_author'; the body is blanked at the same time. */
    deletedAt: ts("deleted_at"),
    /** Derived from the ledger of measures by a migrator-owned function, the only writer; the API role cannot update it. */
    moderationLevel: moderationLevel("moderation_level").notNull().default("visible"),
    /** Set, one way, when the R4 redaction erased the post's content; written only by a migrator-owned function. */
    erasedAt: ts("erased_at"),
    /**
     * Explore's resume rule (3e design, sections 6.1 and 6.4): when the post last left the level visible, when it last came
     * back, and the time its age and window are counted from after its hidden spans. Outside the API's column grants; a
     * later migration gives them their one writer, moderation_apply.
     */
    hiddenAt: ts("hidden_at"),
    restoredAt: ts("restored_at"),
    exploreFrom: ts("explore_from"),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("posts_author_created_idx").on(t.authorId, t.createdAt),
    /** Explore's restored posts. */
    index("posts_explore_from_idx").on(t.exploreFrom).where(sql`explore_from is not null`),
    index("posts_created_id_idx").on(t.createdAt, t.id),
    /** A thread's replies in order, and every lookup by parent. */
    index("posts_reply_to_created_idx").on(t.replyToId, t.createdAt, t.id),
    /** The public Latest timeline: visible top-level posts and quotes, newest first. */
    index("posts_latest_idx").on(t.createdAt, t.id).where(sql`reply_to_id is null and state = 'visible'`),
    index("posts_quote_of_idx").on(t.quoteOfId),
    check("posts_body_len", sql`char_length(${t.body}) <= 1000`),
    check("posts_counts_nonnegative", sql`${t.likeCount} >= 0 and ${t.repostCount} >= 0 and ${t.replyCount} >= 0 and ${t.quoteCount} >= 0`),
    fullAccess("posts_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * One Explore ranking (a "generation"), written by the refresh job (2c design, sections 6 and 7). The current ranking
 * is the highest generation; the job also keeps the one before it, so a reader paging through a ranking is not cut
 * off by the next round.
 */
export const exploreRuns = pgTable(
  "explore_runs",
  {
    /** Numbered by the database. One ranking every 5 minutes lasts 20,000 years in an integer. */
    generation: integer("generation").primaryKey().generatedAlwaysAsIdentity(),
    /** The refresh time the round was given; the ranking is computed as of this time. */
    asOf: ts("as_of").notNull(),
    /** The version of the formula the round ranked with (EXPLORE_V1.version in @korbat/contracts). */
    formula: smallint("formula").notNull(),
    /** Posts that passed the candidate predicate at as_of. */
    candidates: integer("candidates").notNull(),
    /** Posts the ranking holds; their positions run from 1 to this. */
    items: integer("items").notNull(),
    /** How long the round took. */
    tookMs: integer("took_ms").notNull(),
  },
  () => [fullAccess("explore_runs_api_all", apiRole)],
).enableRLS();

/**

 * the position is the order. A row goes with its ranking, its post or its author.
 */
export const exploreItems = pgTable(

    authorId: uuid("author_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
  },

    /** A post has one place in a ranking. */
    uniqueIndex("explore_items_generation_post_idx").on(t.generation, t.postId),

  ],
).enableRLS();

/** An upload is processing until the worker's result is in, then ready or failed for good. */
export const mediaStatus = pgEnum("media_status", ["processing", "ready", "failed"]);

/**
 * One uploaded image. The files live on the media-store volume under the row's id; no path is
 * stored. Only the API's media module reads or writes this table.
 */
export const postMedia = pgTable(
  "post_media",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    /** Who uploaded it. Only this account may attach it to a post. */
    ownerId: uuid("owner_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    status: mediaStatus("status").notNull().default("processing"),
    /** Why processing failed: one of the contracts' MediaFailure values. */
    error: text("error"),
    /** Set, together with the position, when the image is attached to a post. */
    postId: uuid("post_id").references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    position: integer("position"),
    /** Of the large size, after rotation. Set, together with the blurhash, when processing succeeds. */
    width: integer("width"),
    height: integer("height"),
    blurhash: text("blurhash"),
    altText: text("alt_text"),
    /** Filled by sub-project 3. Empty until then. */
    nsfwScore: real("nsfw_score"),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    // The three columns below are forced to their defaults at insert and written only by migrator-owned functions; the
    // API role holds no UPDATE on them (migration 0015).
    /** Derived from the ledger of measures, as the post's level is. */
    moderationState: mediaModerationState("moderation_state").notNull().default("visible"),
    /** The latest end of the image's unreleased holds (media_holds): while it lies ahead, every delete skips the row. */
    holdUntil: ts("hold_until"),
    /** Set when an R4 removal of the image became final and its content was erased. */
    erasedAt: ts("erased_at"),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("post_media_post_position_idx").on(t.postId, t.position),
    index("post_media_owner_created_idx").on(t.ownerId, t.createdAt),
    index("post_media_status_created_idx").on(t.status, t.createdAt),
    check("post_media_ready_has_dims", sql`${t.status} <> 'ready' or (${t.width} is not null and ${t.height} is not null and ${t.blurhash} is not null)`),
    check("post_media_attached_is_complete", sql`${t.postId} is null or (${t.status} = 'ready' and ${t.position} between 0 and 3 and ${t.altText} is not null)`),
    check("post_media_alt_len", sql`char_length(${t.altText}) <= 1000`),
    fullAccess("post_media_api_all", apiRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/** user -> user relation table (follows, blocks, mutes). */
function userPairTable(name: string, from: string, to: string) {
  return pgTable(
    name,
    {
      fromId: uuid(from).notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      toId: uuid(to).notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    },
    (t) => [
      primaryKey({ columns: [t.fromId, t.toId] }),
      /** Pages of either side, newest first, and every lookup by either side. */
      index(`${name}_to_created_idx`).on(t.toId, t.createdAt, t.fromId),
      index(`${name}_from_created_idx`).on(t.fromId, t.createdAt, t.toId),
      check(`${name}_not_self`, sql`${t.fromId} <> ${t.toId}`),
      fullAccess(`${name}_api_all`, apiRole),
    ],
  ).enableRLS();
}

/**
 * user -> post relation table (likes, reposts, bookmarks). `createdBrin` adds `<name>_created_brin`, a BRIN index on
 * created_at, for the tables whose recent rows the Explore refresh reads (2c design, section 6).
 */
function userPostTable(name: string, options: { createdBrin?: boolean } = {}) {
  return pgTable(
    name,
    {
      userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      postId: uuid("post_id").notNull().references(() => posts.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
      createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    },
    (t) => [
      primaryKey({ columns: [t.userId, t.postId] }),
      index(`${name}_post_idx`).on(t.postId),
      /** Per-account lists (your likes, your bookmarks) and the reposts half of the Following timeline. */
      index(`${name}_user_created_idx`).on(t.userId, t.createdAt),
      // Rows arrive roughly in time order, so a BRIN index of a few kilobytes finds the refresh's window as fast as a
      // btree of many megabytes. Unlikes, blocks and purges let later rows fill old pages and erode that order slowly.
      ...(options.createdBrin ? [index(`${name}_created_brin`).using("brin", t.createdAt)] : []),
      fullAccess(`${name}_api_all`, apiRole),
    ],
  ).enableRLS();
}

export const follows = userPairTable("follows", "follower_id", "followee_id");
export const blocks = userPairTable("blocks", "blocker_id", "blocked_id");
export const mutes = userPairTable("mutes", "muter_id", "muted_id");
export const likes = userPostTable("likes", { createdBrin: true });
export const reposts = userPostTable("reposts", { createdBrin: true });
/** Bookmarks are private and never count towards Explore, so they need no index by time. */
export const bookmarks = userPostTable("bookmarks");
```
